/**
 * AttendSure Web API Client - Strict /api/v1/ Enforcement, SWR Cache & JWT Layer
 * File: web/src/api/client.ts
 */

import axios, {
  AxiosError,
  CanceledError,
  type AxiosRequestConfig,
  type AxiosResponse,
  type InternalAxiosRequestConfig,
} from 'axios';
import { API_ROUTES } from './routes';

const FRESH_TTL_MS = 25_000;
const STALE_TTL_MS = 120_000;
const MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES = 150;

interface CacheEntry {
  freshUntil: number;
  staleUntil: number;
  response: AxiosResponse;
}

type CacheListener = (data: unknown) => void;

const responseCache = new Map<string, CacheEntry>();
const inflightGetMap = new Map<string, Promise<AxiosResponse>>();
const cacheListeners = new Map<string, Set<CacheListener>>();

// Maps any legacy unversioned path to its canonical /api/v1/ endpoint
const LEGACY_TO_V1_PREFIXES: ReadonlyArray<[RegExp, string]> = [
  [/^me\/?$/i, 'v1/accounts/me/'],
  [/^users(\/|$)/i, 'v1/accounts/users$1'],
  [/^faculties(\/|$)/i, 'v1/accounts/faculty$1'],
  [/^facultys(\/|$)/i, 'v1/accounts/faculty$1'],
  [/^faculty\/dropdown\/?$/i, 'v1/accounts/faculty/dropdown/'],
  [/^faculty\/(\d+)\/reset-device\/?$/i, 'v1/accounts/faculty/$1/reset-device/'],
  [/^faculty(\/|$)/i, 'v1/accounts/faculty$1'],
  [/^activity-logs(\/|$)/i, 'v1/accounts/audit-logs$1'],
  [/^settings\/school\/?$/i, 'v1/school/settings/'],
  [/^academic-years(\/|$)/i, 'v1/school/school-years$1'],
  [/^grade-levels(\/|$)/i, 'v1/school/grade-levels$1'],
  [/^rooms(\/|$)/i, 'v1/school/rooms$1'],
  [/^subjects(\/|$)/i, 'v1/school/subjects$1'],
  [/^sections(\/|$)/i, 'v1/school/sections$1'],
  [/^schedules(\/|$)/i, 'v1/school/periods$1'],
  [/^students(\/|$)/i, 'v1/students$1'],
  [/^gate-passes(\/|$)/i, 'v1/attendance/exit-passes$1'],
  [/^classroom\/adviser-matrix\/?$/i, 'v1/attendance/adviser-matrix/'],
  [/^classroom\/(student_list|class_list)\/?$/i, 'v1/attendance/classes/'],
  [/^geofence\/audit\/?$/i, 'v1/campus/audit/'],
  [/^geofence(\/|$)/i, 'v1/campus/boundary$1'],
  [/^enterprise\/emergency-roll-?call\/?$/i, 'v1/campus/roll-call/'],
  [/^enterprise\/sdg-impact\/?$/i, 'v1/reports/sdg-impact/'],
  [/^enterprise\/edfi-export\/?$/i, 'v1/reports/edfi-export/'],
  [/^enterprise\/sardo-early-warning\/?$/i, 'v1/reports/dropout-risk/'],
  [/^dashboard\/overview\/?$/i, 'v1/reports/dashboard/'],
  [/^system\/status\/?$/i, 'v1/reports/system-status/'],
  [/^reports(\/|$)/i, 'v1/reports$1'],
  [/^notifications(\/|$)/i, 'v1/messaging/notifications$1'],
  [/^chat\/threads\/?$/i, 'v1/messaging/threads/'],
  [/^chat\/messages\/?$/i, 'v1/messaging/messages/'],
  [/^core\/maintenance\/db-check\/?$/i, 'v1/health/db/'],
  [/^core\/maintenance\/flush-cache\/?$/i, 'v1/cache/flush/'],
  [/^core\/maintenance\/unlock-accounts\/?$/i, 'v1/accounts/unlock-accounts/'],
];

const notifyCacheListeners = (key: string, data: unknown): void => {
  const listeners = cacheListeners.get(key);
  if (!listeners) return;
  listeners.forEach((fn) => {
    try {
      fn(data);
    } catch {
      // Isolate listener errors
    }
  });
};

const pruneCacheIfNeeded = (): void => {
  if (responseCache.size <= MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES) return;
  const oldestKey = responseCache.keys().next().value;
  if (oldestKey) responseCache.delete(oldestKey);
};

export const clearApiClientCache = (): void => {
  responseCache.clear();
  inflightGetMap.clear();
};

/**
 * Evicts cached GET entries completely so immediate post-mutation refetches
 * always read fresh database state instead of stale SWR snapshots.
 */
export const invalidateApiCache = (): void => {
  responseCache.clear();
  inflightGetMap.clear();
};

const isLocalOrLanHost = (hostname: string): boolean =>
  hostname === 'localhost' ||
  hostname === '127.0.0.1' ||
  hostname.startsWith('192.168.') ||
  hostname.startsWith('10.') ||
  hostname.startsWith('172.') ||
  hostname.endsWith('.local');

export const resolveBaseUrl = (): string => {
  const envUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL;
  if (envUrl && typeof envUrl === 'string' && envUrl.trim()) {
    return envUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '').replace(/\/api(\/v1)?$/i, '');
  }

  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    const { protocol, hostname, port } = window.location;
    if (port === '80' || port === '443' || port === '5173' || !port) {
      if (
        hostname.includes('attendsure.ph') ||
        hostname.includes('attendsure.com.ph') ||
        hostname.includes('trycloudflare.com')
      ) {
        return `${protocol}//${hostname}`;
      }
    }
    if (isLocalOrLanHost(hostname)) {
      return `${protocol}//${hostname}:8000`;
    }
    return port && port !== '80' && port !== '443'
      ? `${protocol}//${hostname}:${port}`
      : `${protocol}//${hostname}`;
  }

  return 'http://127.0.0.1:8000';
};

export const normalizeApiPath = (rawUrl: string): string => {
  const trimmed = rawUrl.trim();
  if (/^(javascript|vbscript|data):/i.test(trimmed)) {
    throw new Error('Blocked unsafe URL protocol.');
  }
  if (trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://')) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  let clean = trimmed
    .replace(/^\/+/, '')
    .replace(/\.\.\//g, '')
    .replace(/^(api\/)+/i, '');

  if (!clean.startsWith('v1/')) {
    const qIdx = clean.indexOf('?');
    const pathPart = qIdx >= 0 ? clean.slice(0, qIdx) : clean;
    const queryPart = qIdx >= 0 ? clean.slice(qIdx) : '';

    let mapped = pathPart;
    for (const [pattern, replacement] of LEGACY_TO_V1_PREFIXES) {
      if (pattern.test(pathPart)) {
        mapped = pathPart.replace(pattern, replacement);
        break;
      }
    }
    clean = (mapped.startsWith('v1/') ? mapped : `v1/${mapped}`) + queryPart;
  }

  return `/api/${clean}`;
};

const serializeParams = (params?: Record<string, unknown>): string => {
  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return '';
  const entries = Object.entries(params)
    .filter(([k, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== '' && k !== 'nocache' && k !== '_t' && k !== 'silent')
    .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b));
  return entries.length > 0 ? JSON.stringify(entries) : '';
};

export const buildApiCacheKey = (url: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>): string => {
  const normUrl = normalizeApiPath(url);
  const userScope =
    localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user_id') ||
    localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') ||
    'guest';
  return `${userScope}:${normUrl}?${serializeParams(params)}`;
};

export function peekApiCache<T = unknown>(url: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>): T | undefined {
  const key = buildApiCacheKey(url, params);
  const hit = responseCache.get(key);
  if (!hit || hit.staleUntil <= Date.now()) return undefined;
  return hit.response.data as T;
}

export const subscribeApiCache = (
  url: string,
  params: Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
  listener: CacheListener
): (() => void) => {
  const key = buildApiCacheKey(url, params);
  let set = cacheListeners.get(key);
  if (!set) {
    set = new Set();
    cacheListeners.set(key, set);
  }
  set.add(listener);
  return () => {
    const current = cacheListeners.get(key);
    if (!current) return;
    current.delete(listener);
    if (current.size === 0) cacheListeners.delete(key);
  };
};

const clearStoredAuth = (): void => {
  const keys = [
    'attendsure_access',
    'attendsure_refresh',
    'attendsure_token',
    'auth_token',
    'token',
    'attendsure_username',
    'attendsure_faculty_name',
    'attendsure_role',
    'attendsure_user_id',
    'attendsure_user_photo',
    'attendsure_can_teach',
  ];
  keys.forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k));
  lastWarmupUser = '';
  clearApiClientCache();
};

const apiClient = axios.create({
  timeout: Number(import.meta.env.VITE_API_TIMEOUT_MS) || 10000,
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
});

apiClient.interceptors.request.use(
  (config: InternalAxiosRequestConfig) => {
    config.baseURL = resolveBaseUrl();
    config.url = normalizeApiPath(config.url || '');

    const method = (config.method || 'get').toLowerCase();
    if (method !== 'get') {
      invalidateApiCache();
    }

    if (config.headers && !config.headers.Authorization) {
      const jwtAccess = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_access')?.trim().replace(/[\r\n]/g, '');
      const legacyToken = (
        localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token') ||
        localStorage.getItem('auth_token') ||
        localStorage.getItem('token') ||
        ''
      )
        .trim()
        .replace(/[\r\n]/g, '');

      if (jwtAccess) {
        config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${jwtAccess}`;
      } else if (legacyToken) {
        config.headers.Authorization = `Token ${legacyToken}`;
      }
    }

    return config;
  },
  (error) => Promise.reject(error)
);

let refreshPromise: Promise<string | null> | null = null;

type RetriableConfig = InternalAxiosRequestConfig & {
  _jwtRetried?: boolean;
  _tokenRetried?: boolean;
};

apiClient.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => {
    const method = (response.config.method || 'get').toLowerCase();
    if (method !== 'get') {
      // Clear cache AFTER mutation commits so follow-up GETs never read pre-mutation snapshots
      invalidateApiCache();
    }
    return response;
  },
  async (error: AxiosError) => {
    const originalRequest = error.config as RetriableConfig | undefined;
    const reqUrl = originalRequest?.url || '';
    const isAuthRoute = reqUrl.includes('/login/') || reqUrl.includes('/token/') || reqUrl.includes('/public-branding/');

    if (error.response?.status === 401 && originalRequest && !isAuthRoute) {
      const refreshToken = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_refresh')?.trim();
      if (refreshToken && !originalRequest._jwtRetried) {
        originalRequest._jwtRetried = true;
        if (!refreshPromise) {
          refreshPromise = axios
            .post(`${resolveBaseUrl()}/api/v1/accounts/token/refresh/`, { refresh: refreshToken }, { timeout: 6000 })
            .then((res) => {
              const nextAccess = res.data?.access as string | undefined;
              const nextRefresh = res.data?.refresh as string | undefined;
              if (nextAccess) {
                localStorage.setItem('attendsure_access', nextAccess);
                if (nextRefresh) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_refresh', nextRefresh);
                return nextAccess;
              }
              return null;
            })
            .catch(() => null)
            .finally(() => {
              refreshPromise = null;
            });
        }

        const newAccess = await refreshPromise;
        if (newAccess) {
          originalRequest.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${newAccess}`;
          return apiClient(originalRequest);
        }
      }

      const fallbackToken = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token')?.trim();
      if (
        fallbackToken &&
        !originalRequest._tokenRetried &&
        String(originalRequest.headers?.Authorization || '').startsWith('Bearer ')
      ) {
        originalRequest._tokenRetried = true;
        localStorage.removeItem('attendsure_access');
        originalRequest.headers.Authorization = `Token ${fallbackToken}`;
        return apiClient(originalRequest);
      }

      clearStoredAuth();
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendsure:auth-expired'));
      }
    }

    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

interface GenericAbortSignal {
  readonly aborted: boolean;
  addEventListener?: (type: string, listener: () => void, options?: { once?: boolean }) => void;
  removeEventListener?: (type: string, listener: () => void) => void;
}

const withCallerAbort = <R>(promise: Promise<R>, signal?: GenericAbortSignal): Promise<R> => {
  if (!signal) return promise;
  if (signal.aborted) {
    return Promise.reject(new CanceledError('canceled'));
  }
  return new Promise<R>((resolve, reject) => {
    const onAbort = () => reject(new CanceledError('canceled'));
    signal.addEventListener?.('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    promise.then(
      (val) => {
        signal.removeEventListener?.('abort', onAbort);
        resolve(val);
      },
      (err) => {
        signal.removeEventListener?.('abort', onAbort);
        reject(err);
      }
    );
  });
};

const rawGet = apiClient.get.bind(apiClient);

const fetchAndPopulateCache = <T = unknown, D = unknown>(
  url: string,
  key: string,
  config?: AxiosRequestConfig<D>
): Promise<AxiosResponse<T>> => {
  const existing = inflightGetMap.get(key);
  if (existing) return existing as Promise<AxiosResponse<T>>;

  const sharedConfig: AxiosRequestConfig<D> = { ...(config || {}), signal: undefined };
  const req = rawGet<T, AxiosResponse<T>, D>(url, sharedConfig)
    .then((res) => {
      const now = Date.now();
      pruneCacheIfNeeded();
      responseCache.set(key, {
        freshUntil: now + FRESH_TTL_MS,
        staleUntil: now + STALE_TTL_MS,
        response: res,
      });
      notifyCacheListeners(key, res.data);
      return res;
    })
    .finally(() => {
      inflightGetMap.delete(key);
    });

  inflightGetMap.set(key, req);
  return req;
};

apiClient.get = function swrGet<T = any, R = AxiosResponse<T>, D = any>(
  url: string,
  config?: AxiosRequestConfig<D>
): Promise<R> {
  const paramsObj = (config?.params || undefined) as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  const forceNetwork = Boolean(paramsObj?._t || paramsObj?.nocache);
  const key = buildApiCacheKey(url, paramsObj);
  const now = Date.now();

  if (!forceNetwork) {
    const hit = responseCache.get(key);
    if (hit && hit.freshUntil > now) {
      return withCallerAbort(Promise.resolve(hit.response as unknown as R), config?.signal as GenericAbortSignal);
    }
    if (hit && hit.staleUntil > now) {
      void fetchAndPopulateCache<T, D>(url, key, config).catch(() => {});
      return withCallerAbort(Promise.resolve(hit.response as unknown as R), config?.signal as GenericAbortSignal);
    }
  }

  return withCallerAbort(
    fetchAndPopulateCache<T, D>(url, key, config) as unknown as Promise<R>,
    config?.signal as GenericAbortSignal
  );
};

export const prefetchApiGet = (url: string, params?: Record<string, unknown>): void => {
  const hasToken = Boolean(localStorage.getItem('attendsure_access') || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token'));
  if (!hasToken) return;
  const key = buildApiCacheKey(url, params);
  const hit = responseCache.get(key);
  if (hit && hit.freshUntil > Date.now()) return;
  void fetchAndPopulateCache(url, key, { params }).catch(() => {});
};

let lastWarmupUser = '';

export const warmupRoleEndpoints = (role: string, canHandleClasses: boolean): void => {
  const userScope = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') || '';
  if (!userScope || lastWarmupUser === userScope) return;
  lastWarmupUser = userScope;

  const upper = role.toUpperCase();
  const isLeader = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(upper);
  const now = new Date();

  const queue: Array<[string, Record<string, unknown>?]> = [
    [API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard, undefined],
    [API_ROUTES.students.metrics, undefined],
    [API_ROUTES.students.list, { page: 1, page_size: 25 }],
    [API_ROUTES.school.sections, { page_size: 300 }],
    [API_ROUTES.school.gradeLevels, { page_size: 200 }],
    [API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses, undefined],
    [API_ROUTES.reports.dtr, { month: now.getMonth() + 1, year: now.getFullYear() }],
    [API_ROUTES.messaging.threads, undefined],
    [API_ROUTES.reports.sdgImpact, undefined],
    [API_ROUTES.reports.dropoutRisk, undefined],
  ];

  if (canHandleClasses || isLeader) {
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, undefined]);
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, { summary: 1 }]);
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.attendance.adviserMatrix, undefined]);
  }

  if (isLeader) {
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.accounts.faculty, { page: 1, page_size: 25 }]);
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.accounts.facultyDropdown, undefined]);
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.school.periods, { page_size: 500 }]);
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.campus.boundary, undefined]);
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.school.settings, undefined]);
  }

  if (['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN'].includes(upper)) {
    queue.push([API_ROUTES.accounts.users, { page_size: 'ALL' }]);
  }

  queue.forEach(([endpoint, params], index) => {
    setTimeout(() => prefetchApiGet(endpoint, params), 80 + index * 90);
  });
};
export default apiClient;

export const escapeHtml = (raw: unknown): string => {
  return String(raw ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
};

const isSafeUserFacingText = (text: string): boolean => {
  const trimmed = text.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return false;
  if (/<[a-z][\s\S]*>/i.test(trimmed)) return false;
  if (/traceback|exception|file ".*\.py"|syntaxerror|typeerror|integrityerror/i.test(trimmed)) {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
};

export const extractApiError = (err: unknown, fallback = 'Request could not be completed. Please try again.'): string => {
  const anyErr = err as {
    response?: { data?: Record<string, unknown> | string; status?: number };
    message?: string;
  };
  const data = anyErr?.response?.data;
  if (typeof data === 'string' && isSafeUserFacingText(data)) {
    return data.trim().slice(0, 220);
  }
  if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
    for (const key of ['message', 'error', 'detail']) {
      const val = data[key];
      if (typeof val === 'string' && isSafeUserFacingText(val)) {
        return val.trim().slice(0, 220);
      }
    }
    const details = data.details && typeof data.details === 'object' ? (data.details as Record<string, unknown>) : data;
    for (const val of Object.values(details)) {
      if (Array.isArray(val) && typeof val[0] === 'string' && isSafeUserFacingText(val[0])) {
        return val[0].trim().slice(0, 220);
      }
      if (typeof val === 'string' && isSafeUserFacingText(val)) {
        return val.trim().slice(0, 220);
      }
    }
  }
  if (anyErr?.response?.status && anyErr.response.status >= 500) {
    return fallback;
  }
  if (typeof anyErr?.message === 'string' && isSafeUserFacingText(anyErr.message) && !anyErr.message.startsWith('Request failed with status')) {
    return anyErr.message.trim().slice(0, 220);
  }
  return fallback;
};

      `AttendSure_SubjectMatrix_${cleanSec}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`,
      headers,
      rows
    );
  };

  const renderStatusPill = (status: string, time: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'PRESENT':
        return (
          <span
            style={pillStyle(tokens.successLight, brand.success)}
            title={time ? `Scanned at ${time}` : 'Present'}
          >
            <CheckCircle2 size={11} /> Present
          </span>
        );
      case 'LATE':
        return (
          <span
            style={pillStyle(tokens.warningLight, brand.warning)}
            title={time ? `Marked late at ${time}` : 'Late'}
          >
            <Clock size={11} /> Late
          </span>
        );
      case 'EXCUSED':
        return (
          <span
            style={pillStyle(tokens.infoLight, brand.secondary)}
            title="Authorized excuse or approved exit pass"
          >
            <ShieldCheck size={11} /> Excused
          </span>
        );
      case 'CUTTING':
        return (
          <span
            style={{ ...pillStyle(tokens.dangerLight, brand.danger), fontWeight: 900 }}
            title="Cutting Alert: Student was present earlier today but missed this subject period"
          >
            <AlertTriangle size={11} /> Cutting Class
          </span>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <span
            style={pillStyle(tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, tokens.textMuted)}
            title="Not scanned in this period yet"
          >
            —
          </span>
        );
    }
  };

  if (loading && !refreshing) {
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
        <RefreshCw
          size={24}
          className="animate-spin"
          style={{ margin: '0 auto 8px', display: 'block', color: brand.primary }}
        />
        <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, fontWeight: 600 }}>
          Loading subject attendance matrix...
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error && !hasAdvisoryClass && availableSections.length === 0) {
    return (

        <AlertCircle size={34} color={brand.danger} style={{ margin: '0 auto 10px', display: 'block' }} />

        </h3>
        <p style={{ margin: '6px auto 16px', fontSize: fonts.size.sm, color: tokens.textSecondary, maxWidth: 420 }}>

        </p>

          type="button"

  }

          ...ui.card,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 12,

        }}
      >

          <div
            style={{
              width: 38,
              height: 38,
              borderRadius: 10,
              backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',

            }}
          >
            <BookOpen size={18} color={brand.primary} />

          <div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>

            options={[

              { value: 'CUTTING', label: 'Cutting Class', badge: summaryMetrics.cutting },
              { value: 'ABSENT', label: 'Not Seen Today', badge: summaryMetrics.absent },
            ]}
            value={filterMode}

          {summaryMetrics.cutting > 0 && (

              {summaryMetrics.cutting} Cutting Class Alert{summaryMetrics.cutting === 1 ? '' : 's'}

        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflowX: 'auto' }}>
        <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', minWidth: 860 }}>

              filteredMatrix.map((row) => (
                <tr
                  key={row.student_id}
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: row.cutting_count > 0 ? tokens.dangerLight : 'transparent',
                  }}
                >
                  <td
                    style={{
                      ...ui.td,
                      textAlign: 'center',
                      fontWeight: 800,
                      color: tokens.textMuted,
                      fontFamily: fonts.mono,
                    }}
                  >
                    {row.number}
                  </td>

                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                      <ProfileAvatar
                        photoUrl={row.photo_url}
                        name={row.student_name}
                        size={32}
                        iconSize={15}
                      />
                      <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
                        <strong style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, color: tokens.textPrimary, display: 'block' }}>
                          {row.student_name}
                        </strong>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>
                          LRN: {row.lrn}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </td>

                  <td style={ui.td}>
                    <span
                      style={{
                        fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                        fontWeight: 700,

                      }}
                    >
                      {row.campus_status}
                    </span>
                  </td>

                  {row.subjects.map((sub) => (
                    <td key={sub.schedule_id} style={{ ...ui.td, textAlign: 'center' }}>
                      {renderStatusPill(sub.status, sub.time)}
                    </td>
                  ))}

                  <td style={{ ...ui.td, textAlign: 'center' }}>
                    <div
                      style={{
                        fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
                        fontWeight: 800,
                        color:
                          row.total_subjects === 0
                            ? tokens.textMuted
                            : row.compliance_rate >= 80
                            ? brand.success
                            : brand.danger,
                      }}
                    >
                      {row.attended_count} / {row.total_subjects}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.64rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>

            ) : (
              <tr>
                <td
                  colSpan={4 + schedules.length}
                  style={{
                    padding: 36,
                    textAlign: 'center',
                    color: tokens.textMuted,
                    fontSize: fonts.size.base,
                  }}
                >
                  No students match the selected filter.
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const pillStyle = (bg: string, color: string): React.CSSProperties => ({
  display: 'inline-flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  gap: 4,
  padding: '2px 8px',
  borderRadius: 6,
  fontSize: '0.66rem',
  fontWeight: 700,
  backgroundColor: bg,
  color,
});

export default AdvisorySubjectMonitor;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient, { clearApiClientCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';

interface AuthPageProps {
  onAuthSuccess?: (session: UserSession) => void;
  onLoginSuccess?: (session: UserSession) => void;
  onBackToShowcase?: () => void;
}

const ALLOWED_WEB_ROLES = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD', 'FACULTY']);

const clearPreviousSessionStorage = (): void => {
  const keys = [
    'attendsure_access',
    'attendsure_refresh',
    'attendsure_token',
    'auth_token',
    'token',
    'attendsure_username',
    'attendsure_faculty_name',
    'attendsure_role',
    'attendsure_user_id',
    'attendsure_user_photo',
    'attendsure_can_teach',
  ];
  keys.forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k));
};

export const AuthPage: React.FC<AuthPageProps> = ({ onAuthSuccess, onLoginSuccess, onBackToShowcase }) => {
  const { school, updateSchoolInstantly, refreshSchool } = useSchool();
  const { mode, setThemeMode, tokens, brand, fonts } = useTheme();

  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [capsLockOn, setCapsLockOn] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [focusedField, setFocusedField] = useState<'username' | 'password' | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [cooldownSeconds, setCooldownSeconds] = useState<number>(0);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loginForm, setLoginForm] = useState<LoginPayload>({ username: '', password: '' });

  const usernameInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const loginAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    usernameInputRef.current?.focus();
    return () => {
      loginAbortRef.current?.abort();
      setLoginForm({ username: '', password: '' });
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (cooldownSeconds <= 0) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setCooldownSeconds((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - 1)), 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [cooldownSeconds]);

  const handleKeyEvent = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (typeof e.getModifierState === 'function') {
      setCapsLockOn(e.getModifierState('CapsLock'));
    }
  };

  const handleLoginSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (loading || cooldownSeconds > 0) return;

    const cleanUsername = loginForm.username.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '').trim().slice(0, 100);
    const rawPassword = loginForm.password.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').slice(0, 128);

    if (!cleanUsername || !rawPassword) {
      setErrorMsg('Please enter both your username and password.');
      return;
    }

    loginAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    loginAbortRef.current = controller;

    setErrorMsg(null);
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(
        API_ROUTES.accounts.login,
        {
          username: cleanUsername,
          password: rawPassword,
        },
        { signal: controller.signal }
      );
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      const data = res.data || {};
      const userObj = data.user || data;
      const role = String(userObj.role || userObj.system_role || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();

      if (!ALLOWED_WEB_ROLES.has(role)) {
        clearPreviousSessionStorage();
        clearApiClientCache();
        setLoginForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, password: '' }));
        setErrorMsg(
          'Parent accounts sign in on the AttendSure Mobile App. Please use a faculty or admin account here.'
        );
        return;
      }

      const token = String(data.token || data.access || '').trim();
      const access = String(data.access || '').trim();
      const refresh = String(data.refresh || '').trim();
      const username = String(userObj.username || cleanUsername).trim();
      const facultyName = String(userObj.faculty_name || userObj.full_name || username).trim();
      const userId = Number(userObj.id || userObj.user_id || 0);
      const canTeach = Boolean(
        userObj.can_teach || userObj.is_teaching || Number(userObj.assigned_class_count) > 0 || role === 'FACULTY'
      );
      const rawPhoto = (userObj.photo_url || userObj.photo) as string | null | undefined;
      const safeUserPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(rawPhoto) ? rawPhoto! : null;

      clearPreviousSessionStorage();
      clearApiClientCache();

      if (token) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_token', token);
      if (access) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_access', access);
      if (refresh) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_refresh', refresh);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_username', username);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_faculty_name', facultyName);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_role', role);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_can_teach', String(canTeach));
      if (userId) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_id', String(userId));
      if (safeUserPhoto) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', safeUserPhoto);

      if (userObj.school_name || userObj.school_id) {
        updateSchoolInstantly({
          school_name: String(userObj.school_name || ''),
          school_id: String(userObj.school_id || ''),
          school_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.school_logo) ? userObj.school_logo : school.school_logo,
          left_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.left_logo) ? userObj.left_logo : school.left_logo,
          right_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.right_logo) ? userObj.right_logo : school.right_logo,
        });
      }
      refreshSchool().catch(() => {});

      setLoginForm({ username: '', password: '' });

      const session: UserSession = {
        user_id: userId,
        token,
        username,
        faculty_name: facultyName,
        role,
      };

      onAuthSuccess?.(session);
      onLoginSuccess?.(session);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string; response?: { status?: number } };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      const status = anyErr?.response?.status;
      if (status === 429) {
        setCooldownSeconds(30);
      }
      setLoginForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, password: '' }));
      setErrorMsg(extractApiError(err, 'Wrong username or password. Please try again.'));
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const safeSchoolLogo = isSafeImageUrl(school.school_logo) ? school.school_logo : null;
  const schoolTitle = school.school_name?.trim() || 'Official School Portal';

    school.school_id?.trim() && school.school_id !== '55555' && school.school_id !== '000000'
      ? school.school_id.trim()
      : '';

  const features = [
    {
      icon: <QrCode size={16} color="#7dd3fc" />,
      title: 'Classroom QR Scan',
      desc: 'Fast USB QR scanner check-in on classroom laptops, with automatic offline sync.',
    },
    {
      icon: <Smartphone size={16} color="#6ee7b7" />,
      title: 'Campus GPS Check-In',
      desc: 'Faculty verify arrival via on-device facial recognition and campus GPS.',
    },
    {
      icon: <FileSpreadsheet size={16} color="#fcd34d" />,
      title: 'Official DepEd Forms',
      desc: 'Ready-to-print SF1, SF2, SF4, and CSC Form 48.',
    },
    {
      icon: <BellRing size={16} color="#f9a8d4" />,
      title: 'Parent Mobile Alerts',
      desc: 'Instant arrival, cutting, and exit pass push notices.',
    },
  ];

  const themeChoices: { value: ThemeMode; title: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[] = [
    { value: 'light', title: 'Light Mode', icon: <Sun size={13} /> },
    { value: 'dark', title: 'Dark Mode', icon: <Moon size={13} /> },
    { value: 'high-contrast', title: 'Daylight High-Contrast Mode', icon: <Eye size={13} /> },
  ];

/**
 * AttendSure - Theme-Adaptive Brand Emblem Badge
 * File: web/src/components/branding/AttendSureBadge.tsx
 */

import React, { memo, useState } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { sanitizeText, type ThemeMode } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { BRAND_ASSETS } from './BrandAssets';

export interface AttendSureBadgeProps {
  size?: number;
  animate?: boolean;
  shape?: 'circle' | 'squircle';
  mode?: ThemeMode;
  alt?: string;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const MIN_BADGE_PX = 16;
const MAX_BADGE_PX = 320;

const clampBadgeSize = (rawSize?: number): number => {
  const parsed = Number(rawSize);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return 96;
  return Math.min(MAX_BADGE_PX, Math.max(MIN_BADGE_PX, Math.round(parsed)));
};

export const AttendSureBadge: React.FC<AttendSureBadgeProps> = memo(
  ({
    size = 96,
    animate = false,
    shape = 'circle',
    mode: overrideMode,
    alt = 'AttendSure',
    className,
    style,
  }) => {
    const { mode: contextMode } = useTheme();
    const [imageFailed, setImageFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);

    const activeMode = overrideMode || contextMode;
    const safeSize = clampBadgeSize(size);
    const iconSize = Math.round(safeSize * 0.62);
    const safeAlt = sanitizeText(alt, 60) || 'AttendSure';
    const radiusValue = shape === 'circle' ? '50%' : `${Math.max(8, Math.round(safeSize * 0.26))}px`;

    const borderColor =
      activeMode === 'dark'
        ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.55)'
        : activeMode === 'high-contrast'
        ? '#002b4d'
        : '#cbd5e1';

    const badgeShadow =
      activeMode === 'dark'
        ? '0 8px 24px -4px rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.35), inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff'
        : activeMode === 'high-contrast'
        ? '0 0 0 1.5px #002b4d'
        : '0 8px 22px -4px rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.16), inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff';

    return (
      <div
        className={className}
        role="img"
        aria-label={safeAlt}
        style={{
          width: `${safeSize}px`,
          height: `${safeSize}px`,
          borderRadius: radiusValue,
          background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%)',
          borderWidth: activeMode === 'high-contrast' ? 2 : 1.5,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor,
          boxShadow: badgeShadow,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          animation: animate ? 'attendsure-badge-pulse 2.6s ease-in-out infinite' : 'none',
          flexShrink: 0,
          userSelect: 'none',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
          ...style,
        }}
      >
        {!imageFailed ? (
          <img
            src={BRAND_ASSETS.attendsureLogo}
            alt={safeAlt}
            width={iconSize}
            height={iconSize}
            decoding="async"
            draggable={false}
            onError={() => setImageFailed(true)}
            style={{
              width: `${iconSize}px`,
              height: `${iconSize}px`,
              objectFit: 'contain',
              display: 'block',
            }}
          />
        ) : (
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 64 64"
            width={iconSize}
            height={iconSize}
            fill="none"
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <path d="M32 8L12 52H22.5L32 30.5L41.5 52H52L32 8Z" fill="#004b87" />
            <rect x="14" y="42" width="36" height="10" rx="3" fill="#0284c7" />
          </svg>
        )}

        {animate && (
          <style>{`
            @keyframes attendsure-badge-pulse {
              0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
              50% { transform: scale(1.035); }
            }
            @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
              div[role="img"] { animation: none !important; }
            }
          `}</style>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }
);

AttendSureBadge.displayName = 'AttendSureBadge';

export default AttendSureBadge;

export interface AttendSureBrandBadgeProps {
  size?: number;
  shape?: 'squircle' | 'circle';

export const AttendSureBrandBadge: React.FC<AttendSureBrandBadgeProps> = ({
  size = 40,
  shape = 'squircle',
  mode = 'light',
  style,

  const [imgFailed, setImgFailed] = useState(false);
  const innerSize = Math.round(size * 0.58);
  const radius = shape === 'circle' ? '50%' : Math.max(8, Math.round(size * 0.27));

  const borderColor =
    mode === 'dark'
      ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.55)'
      : mode === 'high-contrast'
      ? '#002b4d'
      : '#cbd5e1';

  const shadow =
    mode === 'dark'
      ? '0 4px 14px rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.28), inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff'
      : mode === 'high-contrast'
      ? 'none'
      : '0 2px 8px rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.12), inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff';

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: radius,
        background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%)',
        borderWidth: mode === 'high-contrast' ? 1.5 : 1,
        borderStyle: 'solid',
        borderColor,
        boxShadow: shadow,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        flexShrink: 0,
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
        ...style,
      }}
    >
      {!imgFailed ? (
        <img
          src={attendsureLogoSvg}
          alt="AttendSure"
          decoding="async"
          onError={() => setImgFailed(true)}
          style={{
            width: innerSize,
            height: innerSize,
            objectFit: 'contain',
            display: 'block',
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width={innerSize} height={innerSize} fill="none" aria-label="AttendSure">
          <path d="M32 8L12 52H22.5L32 30.5L41.5 52H52L32 8Z" fill="#004b87" />
          <rect x="14" y="42" width="36" height="10" rx="3" fill="#0284c7" />
        </svg>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { memo, useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { School } from 'lucide-react';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl, sanitizeText } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { BRAND_ASSETS } from './BrandAssets';

export interface SchoolTenantBadgeProps {
  showDivision?: boolean;
  showSchoolId?: boolean;
  compact?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const formatDivisionText = (division?: string, region?: string): string => {
  const cleanDivision = sanitizeText(division || '', 80);
  if (cleanDivision) {
    return /division/i.test(cleanDivision) ? cleanDivision : `Division of ${cleanDivision}`;
  }
  return sanitizeText(region || '', 60);
};

export const SchoolTenantBadge: React.FC<SchoolTenantBadgeProps> = memo(
  ({
    showDivision = true,
    showSchoolId = false,
    compact = false,
    className,
    style,
  }) => {
    const { school, loading } = useSchool();
    const { mode, tokens, brand, fonts } = useTheme();

    const [sealFailed, setSealFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);
    const [fallbackFailed, setFallbackFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);

    const safeSchoolLogo = useMemo(
      () => (isSafeImageUrl(school.school_logo) ? school.school_logo : null),
      [school.school_logo]
    );

    useEffect(() => {
      setSealFailed(false);
    }, [safeSchoolLogo]);

    const schoolName = useMemo(() => {
      const cleaned = sanitizeText(school.school_name || '', 120);
      if (cleaned) return cleaned;
      return loading ? 'Loading school...' : 'School Not Configured';
    }, [school.school_name, loading]);

    const divisionLabel = useMemo(
      () => (showDivision ? formatDivisionText(school.division, school.region) : ''),
      [showDivision, school.division, school.region]
    );

    const validSchoolId = useMemo(() => {
      if (!showSchoolId) return '';
      const rawId = sanitizeText(school.school_id || '', 20);
      return rawId && rawId !== '55555' && rawId !== '000000' ? rawId : '';
    }, [showSchoolId, school.school_id]);

    const activeImageSrc =
      safeSchoolLogo && !sealFailed
        ? safeSchoolLogo
        : !fallbackFailed
        ? BRAND_ASSETS.attendsureLogo
        : null;

    const sealBoxSize = compact ? 22 : 26;
    const sealImgSize = compact ? 16 : 20;

    return (
      <div
        className={className}

          divisionLabel
            ? `${schoolName} • ${divisionLabel}`
            : schoolName
        }
        style={{

          gap: compact ? 8 : 10,
          padding: compact ? '4px 11px 4px 6px' : '5px 14px 5px 7px',
          maxWidth: '100%',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderWidth: mode === 'high-contrast' ? 1.5 : 1,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
          borderRadius: 9999,
          boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
          fontFamily: fonts.sans,

        <div
          style={{
            width: sealBoxSize,
            height: sealBoxSize,
            borderRadius: '50%',
            backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderStyle: 'solid',
            borderColor: mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)' : '#e2e8f0',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          {activeImageSrc ? (
            <img
              src={activeImageSrc}
              alt={`${schoolName} Seal`}
              width={sealImgSize}
              height={sealImgSize}

              referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
              draggable={false}

                  setFallbackFailed(true);

              style={{
                width: sealImgSize,
                height: sealImgSize,
                objectFit: 'contain',
                display: 'block',
              }}
            />
          ) : (
            <School size={compact ? 13 : 15} color="#004b87" aria-hidden="true" />

        <span
          style={{

/**

 * File: web/src/components/branding/TechBlazerSignature.tsx

import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { sanitizeText } from '../../theme/tokens';

export interface TechBlazerSignatureProps {
  size?: number;
  textColor?: string;
  label?: string;
  layout?: 'stacked' | 'inline';
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

const MIN_ICON_PX = 14;
const MAX_ICON_PX = 96;

const clampIconSize = (rawSize?: number): number => {
  const parsed = Number(rawSize);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return 20;
  return Math.min(MAX_ICON_PX, Math.max(MIN_ICON_PX, Math.round(parsed)));
};

const isSafeCssColor = (value?: string): boolean => {
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') return false;
  const clean = value.trim();
  return (
    /^#([0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$/.test(clean) ||
    /^(rgb|rgba|hsl|hsla)\([0-9.,%\s/]+\)$/.test(clean) ||
    /^var\(--[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+(?:\s*,\s*#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8})?\)$/.test(clean)
  );
};

export const TechBlazerSignature: React.FC<TechBlazerSignatureProps> = memo(
  ({
    size = 20,
    textColor,
    label = 'from',
    layout = 'stacked',
    className = '',

    const safeSize = clampIconSize(size);
    const tileSize = Math.round(safeSize * 1.35);
    const wordmarkFontPx = Math.max(11, Math.round(safeSize * 0.88));
    const safeLabel = sanitizeText(label, 24);
    const resolvedTextColor = isSafeCssColor(textColor) ? textColor!.trim() : tokens.textPrimary;

    const tileBorderColor =
      mode === 'dark'
        ? 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)'
        : mode === 'high-contrast'
        ? '#002b4d'
        : '#e2e8f0';

    return (
      <div
        className={className}
        aria-label={`${safeLabel ? `${safeLabel} ` : ''}TECHBLAZER`}
        style={{
          display: 'inline-flex',
          flexDirection: layout === 'inline' ? 'row' : 'column',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          gap: layout === 'inline' ? 7 : 4,
          userSelect: 'none',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
          ...style,
        }}
      >
        {safeLabel && (
          <span
            style={{
              fontFamily: fonts.sans,
              fontSize: '0.72rem',
              color: tokens.textMuted,
              letterSpacing: '0.04em',
              fontWeight: 600,
              textTransform: 'lowercase',
              lineHeight: 1.2,
            }}
          >
            {safeLabel}
          </span>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              width: `${tileSize}px`,
              height: `${tileSize}px`,
              borderRadius: Math.max(6, Math.round(tileSize * 0.26)),
              background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%)',

/**
 * AttendSure - Fault Isolation Error Boundary
 * File: web/src/components/common/ErrorBoundary.tsx
 *
 * Prevents isolated page issues from crashing the entire web portal.
 */

import React, { Component } from 'react';
import type { ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, RefreshCw, Copy, Check, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react';

export interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  featureName?: string;
  fallback?: ReactNode | ((props: { error: Error; resetError: () => void }) => ReactNode);
  onReset?: () => void;
  onError?: (error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) => void;
  resetKeys?: unknown[];
}

interface State {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  errorInfo: ErrorInfo | null;
  copied: boolean;
  showDetails: boolean;
}

const IS_DEV = Boolean(import.meta.env.DEV);

export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<ErrorBoundaryProps, State> {
  private copyTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  public state: State = {
    hasError: false,
    error: null,
    errorInfo: null,
    copied: false,
    showDetails: false,
  };

  public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): Partial<State> {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    this.setState({ errorInfo });
    this.props.onError?.(error, errorInfo);
  }

  public componentDidUpdate(prevProps: ErrorBoundaryProps) {
    if (!this.state.hasError) return;

    if (this.props.resetKeys && prevProps.resetKeys) {
      const hasChanged = this.props.resetKeys.some(
        (key, index) => key !== prevProps.resetKeys?.[index]
      );
      if (hasChanged) {
        this.handleReset();
      }
    }
  }

  public componentWillUnmount() {
    if (this.copyTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.copyTimer);
      this.copyTimer = null;
    }
  }

  private handleReset = () => {
    this.props.onReset?.();
    this.setState({
      hasError: false,
      error: null,
      errorInfo: null,
      copied: false,
      showDetails: false,
    });
  };

  private handleCopyDiagnostic = async () => {
    const lines = [
      `Feature: ${this.props.featureName || 'Application Section'}`,
      `Time: ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
      `Error: ${this.state.error?.name || 'Error'}`,
    ];
    if (IS_DEV) {
      lines.push(`Message: ${this.state.error?.message || ''}`);
      lines.push(`Stack: ${this.state.error?.stack || 'None'}`);
    }
    const errorText = lines.join('\n');

    let success = false;
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(errorText);
        success = true;
      } catch {
        success = false;
      }
    }

    if (!success) {
      try {
        const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textArea.value = errorText;
        textArea.style.position = 'fixed';
        textArea.style.left = '-999999px';
        textArea.style.top = '-999999px';
        document.body.appendChild(textArea);
        textArea.focus();
        textArea.select();
        success = document.execCommand('copy');
        textArea.remove();
      } catch {
        success = false;
      }
    }

    if (success) {
      this.setState({ copied: true });
      if (this.copyTimer) clearTimeout(this.copyTimer);
      this.copyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.setState({ copied: false });
        this.copyTimer = null;
      }, 2500);
    }
  };

  public render() {
    if (this.state.hasError && this.state.error) {
      if (typeof this.props.fallback === 'function') {
        return this.props.fallback({
          error: this.state.error,
          resetError: this.handleReset,
        });
      }

      if (this.props.fallback) {
        return this.props.fallback;
      }

      const featureTitle = this.props.featureName || 'Section';

      return (
        <div style={errorContainerStyle}>
          <div style={errorCardStyle}>
            <div style={iconBadgeStyle}>
              <AlertTriangle size={24} color="var(--danger, #dc2626)" />
            </div>

            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', width: '100%' }}>
              <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 6px 0', fontSize: '1.05rem', fontWeight: 800, color: 'var(--text-primary, #0f172a)' }}>
                {featureTitle} Temporarily Unavailable
              </h3>
              <p style={{ margin: '0 0 14px 0', fontSize: '0.82rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary, #64748b)', lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
                A temporary problem occurred while displaying this section. Other AttendSure tabs, classroom QR scanning, and background tasks are still running normally.
              </p>

              {IS_DEV && (
                <div style={debugCodeStyle}>
                  {this.state.error.message || 'Unexpected rendering error.'}
                </div>
              )}

              {IS_DEV && this.state.showDetails && (
                <div style={stackTraceContainerStyle}>
                  <pre style={stackTracePreStyle}>
                    {this.state.error.stack || 'No extended details available.'}
                    {this.state.errorInfo?.componentStack || ''}
                  </pre>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div style={actionsRowStyle}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={this.handleReset}
                style={primaryBtnStyle}
              >
                <RefreshCw size={14} />
                <span>Try Again</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={this.handleCopyDiagnostic}
                style={secondaryBtnStyle}
                title="Copy report reference"
              >
                {this.state.copied ? <Check size={14} color="var(--success, #059669)" /> : <Copy size={14} />}
                <span>{this.state.copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy Details'}</span>
              </button>

              {IS_DEV && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => this.setState((prev) => ({ showDetails: !prev.showDetails }))}
                  style={secondaryBtnStyle}
                >
                  <span>{this.state.showDetails ? 'Hide Details' : 'Details'}</span>
                </button>
              )}

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
                style={secondaryBtnStyle}
                title="Reload the page"
              >
                <RotateCcw size={14} />
                <span>Reload</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

export default ErrorBoundary;

const errorContainerStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: 'flex',
  alignItems: 'center',
  justifyContent: 'center',
  width: '100%',
  minHeight: '280px',
  padding: '24px 16px',
  boxSizing: 'border-box',
  backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-app, #f8fafc)',
};

  currentConfig: PageSetupConfig;

  onApply: (config: PageSetupConfig, setAsDefault: boolean) => void;
  reportTitle?: string;
}

const PRESET_COLORS = [
  { label: 'Standard White', value: '#ffffff' },
  { label: 'Soft Ivory', value: '#fdfbf7' },
  { label: 'Clean Slate', value: '#f8fafc' },
  { label: 'Document Cream', value: '#fffdf5' },
];

export const PageSetupModal: React.FC<PageSetupModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  currentConfig,
  onLiveChange,
  onApply,
  reportTitle = 'Report',
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<PageSetupConfig>({
    ...currentConfig,
    headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
  });
  const [setAsDefault, setSetAsDefault] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const initialConfigRef = useRef<PageSetupConfig>(currentConfig);
  const wasOpenRef = useRef<boolean>(false);

  // Only snapshot initialConfigRef and reset checkbox when modal opens (not on every live edit)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && !wasOpenRef.current) {
      const snapshot: PageSetupConfig = {
        ...currentConfig,
        margins: { ...currentConfig.margins },
        headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
      };
      initialConfigRef.current = snapshot;
      setDraft(snapshot);
      setSetAsDefault(false);
    }
    wasOpenRef.current = isOpen;
  }, [isOpen, currentConfig]);

  const updateDraft = useCallback(
    (newDraft: PageSetupConfig) => {
      const standardizedDraft: PageSetupConfig = {
        ...newDraft,
        headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
      };
      setDraft(standardizedDraft);
      onLiveChange?.(standardizedDraft);
    },
    [onLiveChange]
  );

  const handleCancel = useCallback(() => {
    onLiveChange?.(initialConfigRef.current);
    onClose();
  }, [onLiveChange, onClose]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleCancel();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, handleCancel]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleOrientationChange = (orientation: PageOrientation) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, orientation });
  };

  const handleLayoutModeChange = (layoutMode: LayoutMode) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, layoutMode });
  };

  const handlePaperSizeChange = (paperSize: PaperSizeKey) => {
    updateDraft({ ...draft, paperSize });
  };

  const handlePageColorChange = (pageColor: string) => {

  };

      ...initialConfigRef.current,
      margins: { ...initialConfigRef.current.margins },

  };

  const handleSave = () => {

    onClose();
  };

  const selectedPaper = PAPER_SIZES[draft.paperSize] || PAPER_SIZES.folio;
  const isLandscape = draft.orientation === 'landscape';

  };

  const closeButtonStyle: React.CSSProperties = {

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable Server Pagination Bar & Safe CSV Exporter
 * File: web/src/components/common/Pagination.tsx
 *
 * Cybersecurity & Stability Hardening:
 * 1. OWASP CSV Formula Injection Defense: Neutralizes cells starting with =, +, -, @, |, \t, \r.
 * 2. Asynchronous Memory Cleanup: Delays URL.revokeObjectURL by 1s to prevent premature download aborts.
 * 3. Strict Numeric Math: shields against NaN / divide-by-zero during rapid page size switching.
 * 4. WCAG Accessible Controls: Adds aria-label descriptors to all buttons and select inputs.
 */

import React, { useId } from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, ChevronsLeft, ChevronsRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

/** Safe upper ceiling representing "All" records without exhausting server RAM */
export const ALL_ROWS_SIZE = 10000;

export const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS: number[] = [
  25,
  50,
  100,
  250,
  500,
  1000,
  ALL_ROWS_SIZE,
];

/**
 * Cybersecurity Helper: Sanitizes cell values to prevent CSV Formula / DDE Injection
 * in Microsoft Excel, LibreOffice, and Google Sheets.
 * Blocks: =, +, -, @, |, \t, \r
 */
export const sanitizeCsvCell = (val: string | number | boolean | undefined | null): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '""';
  
  // Escape internal double quotes by doubling them per RFC 4180
  const clean = String(val).replace(/"/g, '""').trim();
  
  // Neutralize formula trigger characters with a leading single quote
  if (/^[=+\-@\t\r|]/.test(clean)) {
    return `"'${clean}"`;
  }
  
  return `"${clean}"`;
};

/**
 * Reusable CSV Downloader for any table module.
 * Embeds UTF-8 BOM (\uFEFF) for proper display of special characters in Excel.
 */
export const exportToCsv = (
  filename: string,
  headers: string[],
  rows: (string | number | boolean | undefined | null)[][]
): boolean => {
  if (!rows || rows.length === 0) return false;

  const csvLines = [
    headers.map((h) => sanitizeCsvCell(h)).join(','),
    ...rows.map((row) => row.map((cell) => sanitizeCsvCell(cell)).join(',')),
  ];

  // UTF-8 BOM prefix ensures correct rendering in Excel
  const csvContent = '\uFEFF' + csvLines.join('\r\n');
  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv') ? filename : `${filename}.csv`;
  link.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);

  // Defer revocation by 1 second to ensure browser has completed file stream
  setTimeout(() => {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 1000);

  return true;
};

export interface PaginationProps {
  currentPage: number;
  totalPages: number;
  totalCount: number;
  pageSize: number;
  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
  onPageSizeChange?: (size: number) => void;
  pageSizeOptions?: number[];
  itemLabel?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

export const Pagination: React.FC<PaginationProps> = ({
  currentPage,
  totalPages,
  totalCount,
  pageSize,
  onPageChange,
  onPageSizeChange,
  pageSizeOptions = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS,
  itemLabel = 'records',
  disabled = false,
  className,
  style,
}) => {
  const selectId = useId();
  const { tokens } = useTheme();

  if (totalCount <= 0) return null;

  // Defensive Numeric shields
  const safePageSize = Math.max(1, Number(pageSize) || 25);
  const isAllSelected = safePageSize >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE;
  const safeTotalPages = isAllSelected ? 1 : Math.max(1, Number(totalPages) || 1);
  const safeCurrentPage = isAllSelected
    ? 1
    : Math.min(Math.max(1, Number(currentPage) || 1), safeTotalPages);

  const startRecord = isAllSelected ? 1 : (safeCurrentPage - 1) * safePageSize + 1;
  const endRecord = isAllSelected ? totalCount : Math.min(safeCurrentPage * safePageSize, totalCount);

  const isPrevDisabled = disabled || isAllSelected || safeCurrentPage <= 1;
  const isNextDisabled = disabled || isAllSelected || safeCurrentPage >= safeTotalPages;

  const containerStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: 'flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    padding: '12px 18px',
    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
    borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
    boxSizing: 'border-box',
    gap: 12,
    flexWrap: 'wrap',
  };

  const btnStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: 'flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    padding: '6px',
    border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderInput}`,
    borderRadius: 6,
    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
    color: tokens.textPrimary,
    transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
  };

        <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{endRecord.toLocaleString()}</strong> of{' '}
        <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{totalCount.toLocaleString()}</strong> {itemLabel}
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        {onPageSizeChange && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, marginRight: 8 }}>
            <label htmlFor={selectId} style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
              Rows per page:
            </label>
            <select
              id={selectId}
              value={safePageSize}
              disabled={disabled}
              aria-label="Rows per page selector"
              onChange={(e) => {
                const nextSize = Number(e.target.value);
                if (!isNaN(nextSize) && nextSize > 0) {
                  onPageSizeChange(nextSize);
                }
              }}

                ...selectStyle,

            fontWeight: 600,

/**
 * AttendSure - Reusable User & Faculty Avatar
 * Replaces duplicate implementations across FacultyTab, AttendanceLogsTab, DTRTab, and MyAssignedClassesTab.
 * File: web/src/components/common/ProfileAvatar.tsx

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { User } from 'lucide-react';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';

interface ProfileAvatarProps {
  photoUrl?: string | null;
  name?: string;
  size?: number;
  iconSize?: number;
}

export const ProfileAvatar: React.FC<ProfileAvatarProps> = ({
  photoUrl,
  name = 'Member',
  size = 38,
  iconSize = 19,
}) => {
  const [imageFailed, setImageFailed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setImageFailed(false);
  }, [photoUrl]);

  const hasPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(photoUrl);

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        borderRadius: '50%',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface-subtle, #f1f5f9)',
        border: '1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e2e8f0)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
      title={name}
    >
      {hasPhoto && !imageFailed ? (
        <img
          src={photoUrl!}
          alt={name}
          style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
          onError={() => setImageFailed(true)}
        />
      ) : (
        <User size={iconSize} color="var(--text-muted, #94a3b8)" />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
