export interface ScannedStudent {
  student_id: number;
  student_name: string;
  lrn: string;
  section: string;
  status: string;
  scanned_at: string;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  attendance_note?: string;
  is_duplicate?: boolean;
}

interface ClassPeriodOption {
  id: number;
  schedule_id?: number | null;
  name: string;
  grade_level: string;
  subject_code: string;
  subject_title: string;
  time_display: string;
}

interface OfflineScanEntry {
  qr_token: string;
  period_id: number | null;
  scanned_at: string;
}

export interface ClassroomScannerProps {
  onClose?: () => void;
  isModal?: boolean;
}

const OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY = 'attendsure_offline_qr_queue';

const loadOfflineQueue = (): OfflineScanEntry[] => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as OfflineScanEntry[]) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
};

const playFeedbackChime = (type: 'SUCCESS' | 'WARNING' | 'ERROR') => {
  try {
    const AudioCtx =
      window.AudioContext ||
      (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtx) return;
    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = type === 'SUCCESS' ? 'sine' : 'triangle';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(type === 'SUCCESS' ? 1046 : 250, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.22);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.onended = () => {
      void ctx.close().catch(() => {});
    };
    osc.start();
    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.22);
  } catch {
    // Browser autoplay policy blocked audio
  }
};

const MAX_QR_INPUT_LENGTH = 256;
const sanitizeQrInput = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .slice(0, MAX_QR_INPUT_LENGTH);

export const ClassroomScanner: React.FC<ClassroomScannerProps> = ({ onClose, isModal = false }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const warmPeriods = useMemo(() => {
    const cached = peekApiCache<ClassPeriodOption[]>(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, { summary: 1 });
    return Array.isArray(cached) ? cached.filter((p) => p.id > 0) : [];
  }, []);

  const [scannerMode, setScannerMode] = useState<'USB_GUN' | 'CAMERA'>('USB_GUN');
  const [soundEnabled, setSoundEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [syncingOffline, setSyncingOffline] = useState(false);
  const [inputCode, setInputCode] = useState('');

  const [periods, setPeriods] = useState<ClassPeriodOption[]>(() => warmPeriods);
  const [selectedPeriodId, setSelectedPeriodId] = useState<number | null>(() =>
    warmPeriods.length > 0 ? warmPeriods[0].id : null
  );
  const [activeStudent, setActiveStudent] = useState<ScannedStudent | null>(null);
  const [sessionList, setSessionList] = useState<ScannedStudent[]>([]);
  const [offlineQueue, setOfflineQueue] = useState<OfflineScanEntry[]>(loadOfflineQueue);
  const [cameraMessage, setCameraMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const loadingRef = useRef(false);
  const cooldownRef = useRef(false);
  const processScanRef = useRef<(rawCode: string) => Promise<void>>(async () => {});
  const keyBuffer = useRef('');
  const lastKeyTime = useRef(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const frameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const focusTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const cameraCooldownTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const scanAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  loadingRef.current = loading;

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      scanAbortRef.current?.abort();
      if (focusTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusTimerRef.current);
      if (cameraCooldownTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(cameraCooldownTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get<ClassPeriodOption[]>(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, {
        params: { summary: 1 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      })
      .then((res: AxiosResponse<ClassPeriodOption[]>) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const rawList: ClassPeriodOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : [];
        const validList = rawList.filter((p) => p.id > 0);
        setPeriods(validList);
        if (validList.length > 0) setSelectedPeriodId((prev) => prev ?? validList[0].id);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  const syncOfflineScans = useCallback(async () => {
    const queued = loadOfflineQueue();
    if (queued.length === 0) return;
    setSyncingOffline(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.attendance.offlineSync, { scans: queued });
      if (!mountedRef.current) return;
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY);
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage error
      }
      setOfflineQueue([]);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Offline Scans Synced',
        message: `Synced ${res.data?.synced_count ?? 0} scan(s) (${res.data?.duplicate_count ?? 0} duplicate).`,
        type: 'success',
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (!mountedRef.current) return;
      showAlert({ title: 'Sync Notice', message: extractApiError(err, 'Still offline.'), type: 'warning' });
    } finally {
      if (mountedRef.current) setSyncingOffline(false);
    }
  }, [showAlert]);

  const handleProcessScan = useCallback(
    async (rawCode: string) => {
      const clean = sanitizeQrInput(rawCode).trim();
      if (!clean || loadingRef.current) return;

      scanAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      scanAbortRef.current = controller;

      loadingRef.current = true;
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.post(
          API_ROUTES.attendance.scan,
          {
            qr_text: clean,
            period_id: selectedPeriodId && selectedPeriodId > 0 ? selectedPeriodId : undefined,
          },
          { signal: controller.signal }
        );
        if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;

        const d = res.data || {};
        const item: ScannedStudent = {
          student_id: d.student_id,
          student_name: d.student_name,
          lrn: d.lrn,
          section: d.section,
          status: d.status || 'PRESENT',
          scanned_at: d.scanned_at,
          photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(d.photo_url) ? d.photo_url : null,
          attendance_note: d.attendance_note,
          is_duplicate: Boolean(d.is_duplicate),
        };

        setActiveStudent(item);
        if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime(item.is_duplicate ? 'WARNING' : 'SUCCESS');
        if (!item.is_duplicate) {
          setSessionList((prev) => [item, ...prev.filter((p) => p.lrn !== item.lrn)]);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const netErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string; response?: unknown };
        if (
          controller.signal.aborted ||
          !mountedRef.current ||
          netErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
          netErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
          netErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
        ) {
          return;
        }
        if (!netErr?.response) {
          const nextQueue: OfflineScanEntry[] = [
            ...loadOfflineQueue(),
            {
              qr_token: clean,
              period_id: selectedPeriodId && selectedPeriodId > 0 ? selectedPeriodId : null,
              scanned_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            },
          ];
          try {
            localStorage.setItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextQueue));
          } catch {
            // Ignore storage quota error
          }
          setOfflineQueue(nextQueue);
          if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime('WARNING');
          showAlert({
            title: 'Saved to Offline Queue',
            message: `Internet unavailable. Queued "${clean.slice(0, 20)}" for automatic sync.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
        } else {
          if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime('ERROR');
          showAlert({ title: 'Scan Rejected', message: extractApiError(err), type: 'warning' });
        }
      } finally {
        loadingRef.current = false;
        if (mountedRef.current && !controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setInputCode('');
          if (focusTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusTimerRef.current);
          focusTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
            if (scannerMode === 'USB_GUN') {
              inputRef.current?.focus();
            }
          }, 40);
        }
      }
    },
    [selectedPeriodId, soundEnabled, showAlert, scannerMode]
  );

  processScanRef.current = handleProcessScan;

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const tag = (document.activeElement as HTMLElement)?.tagName;
      if (tag === 'INPUT' && document.activeElement !== inputRef.current) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastKeyTime.current > 120) keyBuffer.current = '';
      lastKeyTime.current = now;
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && keyBuffer.current.length >= 4) {
        e.preventDefault();
        void processScanRef.current(keyBuffer.current);
        keyBuffer.current = '';
      } else if (e.key.length === 1 && keyBuffer.current.length < MAX_QR_INPUT_LENGTH) {
        const ch = e.key.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '');
        if (ch) keyBuffer.current += ch;
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (scannerMode !== 'CAMERA') {
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
      if (frameRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
      if (cameraCooldownTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(cameraCooldownTimerRef.current);
      cooldownRef.current = false;
      return;
    }

    setCameraMessage(null);

    if (!window.isSecureContext || !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      const portSuffix = window.location.port ? `:${window.location.port}` : '';
      setCameraMessage(
        `Browser security blocks webcam access on non-HTTPS domains (${window.location.origin}). Open http://localhost${portSuffix} in your browser to use your laptop webcam, or paste a signed QR string in USB QR Scanner mode.`
      );
      return;
    }

    let active = true;
    const startCameraStream = async () => {
      let stream: MediaStream;
      try {
        stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          video: { facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' }, width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } },
          audio: false,
        });
      } catch {
        stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true, audio: false });
      }

      if (!active) {
        stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
        return;
      }

      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        await videoRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
      }

      if (!canvasRef.current) {
        canvasRef.current = document.createElement('canvas');
      }
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });

      const scanFrame = async () => {
        if (!active) return;
        const video = videoRef.current;
        if (
          video &&
          ctx &&
          video.readyState >= video.HAVE_ENOUGH_DATA &&
          video.videoWidth > 0 &&
          video.videoHeight > 0 &&
          !loadingRef.current &&
          !cooldownRef.current
        ) {
          canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
          canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
          ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          const decoded = jsQR(imageData.data, imageData.width, imageData.height, {
            inversionAttempts: 'dontInvert',
          });

          if (decoded?.data) {
            cooldownRef.current = true;
            await processScanRef.current(decoded.data);
            if (cameraCooldownTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(cameraCooldownTimerRef.current);
            cameraCooldownTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
              cooldownRef.current = false;
            }, 1400);
          }
        }
        if (active) {
          frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            void scanFrame();
          });
        }
      };

      frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        void scanFrame();
      });
    };

    startCameraStream().catch((err: unknown) => {
      if (!active) return;
      const errName = (err as { name?: string })?.name || '';
      if (errName === 'NotFoundError' || errName === 'DevicesNotFoundError') {
        setCameraMessage('No webcam was detected on this laptop. Check if your camera is enabled in Windows Settings.');
      } else if (errName === 'NotReadableError' || errName === 'TrackStartError') {
        setCameraMessage('Your webcam is currently in use by another app (such as Zoom, Teams, or Camera). Close the other app and try again.');
      } else {
        setCameraMessage(
          'Camera permission was blocked. Click the lock/tune icon in your browser address bar, set Camera to Allow, and refresh.'
        );
      }
    });

    return () => {
      active = false;
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
      if (frameRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
      if (cameraCooldownTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(cameraCooldownTimerRef.current);
      cooldownRef.current = false;
    };
  }, [scannerMode]);

  return (
    <div
      style={
        isModal
          ? {
              position: 'fixed',
              inset: 0,
              zIndex: 9999,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(15,23,42,0.65)',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: 16,
            }
          : { width: '100%' }
      }
    >
      <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden', width: '100%', maxWidth: isModal ? 900 : '100%' }}>
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',

                { value: 'CAMERA', label: 'Device Camera', icon: <Camera size={14} /> },
              ]}
              value={scannerMode}
              onChange={setScannerMode}
            />

            {periods.length > 0 && (
              <select
                aria-label="Select class period"
                value={selectedPeriodId || ''}

                  style={{

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '1.02rem', fontWeight: 900, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                      {activeStudent.student_name}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 2 }}>
                      LRN: {activeStudent.lrn} &bull; {activeStudent.section}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textMuted, marginTop: 4, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5 }}>
                      <Clock size={12} /> {activeStudent.scanned_at}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span
                    style={ui.badge(
                      activeStudent.is_duplicate ? tokens.warningLight : tokens.successLight,
                      activeStudent.is_duplicate ? brand.warning : brand.success
                    )}
                  >
                    {activeStudent.is_duplicate ? 'DUPLICATE' : activeStudent.status}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {activeStudent.attendance_note && (
                  <div
                    style={{
                      marginTop: 10,
                      paddingTop: 8,
                      borderTopWidth: 1,
                      borderTopStyle: 'dashed',
                      borderTopColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
                      fontSize: '0.74rem',
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      color: activeStudent.attendance_note.includes('CUTTING') ? brand.danger : brand.success,
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      gap: 6,
                    }}
                  >
                    <ShieldCheck size={14} /> {activeStudent.attendance_note}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div
                key="waiting-scan-card"
                style={{
                  ...ui.card,
                  borderStyle: 'dashed',
                  borderColor: tokens.borderStrong,
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  padding: 24,
                }}
              >
                <QrCode size={30} color={tokens.textMuted} style={{ margin: '0 auto 6px', display: 'block' }} />
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                  Waiting for First QR Scan
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <div
              style={{
                padding: '12px 16px',
                borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                alignItems: 'center',
              }}
            >
              <strong style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>SESSION SCANS ({sessionList.length})</strong>
              {sessionList.length > 0 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSessionList([])}
                  style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                >
                  Clear
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            <div style={{ height: 340, overflowY: 'auto', padding: 12, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8 }}>
              {sessionList.length === 0 ? (
                <div style={{ margin: 'auto', textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
                  <Info size={22} style={{ margin: '0 auto 6px', display: 'block' }} /> Scanned students appear here live.
                </div>
              ) : (
                sessionList.map((item, idx) => (
                  <div key={`${item.lrn}-${idx}`} style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>

                        #{idx + 1} {item.student_name}

                        LRN: {item.lrn} &bull; {item.section}

                    </div>

                        <CheckCircle2 size={11} /> {item.status}
                      </span>
                      <div style={{ fontSize: '0.64rem', color: tokens.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>{item.scanned_at}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ClassroomScanner;

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

interface DemoRoleOption {
  role: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
}

interface StartupShowcasePageProps {
  onOpenSignIn: () => void;
  onDemoLoginSuccess: (session: UserSession, targetTab?: NavItemKey) => void;
}

const clearPreviousSessionStorage = (): void => {
  [
    'attendsure_access',
    'attendsure_refresh',
    'attendsure_token',
    'auth_token',
    'token',
    'attendsure_username',
    'attendsure_faculty_name',
    'attendsure_role',
    'attendsure_user_id',
    'attendsure_user_photo',
    'attendsure_can_teach',
  ].forEach((k) => localStorage.removeItem(k));
};

export const StartupShowcasePage: React.FC<StartupShowcasePageProps> = ({
  onOpenSignIn,
  onDemoLoginSuccess,
}) => {
  const { mode, setThemeMode, tokens, brand, fonts } = useTheme();
  const { school, updateSchoolInstantly, refreshSchool } = useSchool();
  const { complianceMode, toggleComplianceMode, isGlobalMode, locale, setLocale, t } = useCompliance();

  const [demoEnabled, setDemoEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [demoRoles, setDemoRoles] = useState<DemoRoleOption[]>([]);
  const [launchingRole, setLaunchingRole] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [demoError, setDemoError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const loginAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.demoStatus, { timeout: 4000, signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!active || controller.signal.aborted || !res.data) return;
        setDemoEnabled(Boolean(res.data.enabled));
        const roles: DemoRoleOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data.roles) ? res.data.roles : [];
        // Keep web-compatible staff roles on the Web Portal launcher
        setDemoRoles(roles.filter((r) => r.role.toLowerCase() !== 'parent'));
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (active && !controller.signal.aborted) setDemoEnabled(false);
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
      controller.abort();
      loginAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const handleLaunchDemo = async (role: string, targetTab: NavItemKey = 'dashboard') => {
    if (launchingRole) return;
    loginAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    loginAbortRef.current = controller;

    setDemoError(null);
    setLaunchingRole(`${role}:${targetTab}`);

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(
        API_ROUTES.accounts.demoLogin,
        { role },
        { signal: controller.signal }
      );
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      const data = res.data || {};
      const userObj = data.user || data;
      const resolvedRole = String(userObj.role || userObj.system_role || 'ADMIN').toUpperCase();
      const token = String(data.token || data.access || '').trim();
      const access = String(data.access || '').trim();
      const refresh = String(data.refresh || '').trim();
      const username = String(userObj.username || `demo_${role}`).trim();
      const facultyName = String(userObj.faculty_name || userObj.full_name || username).trim();
      const userId = Number(userObj.id || userObj.user_id || 0);
      const canTeach = Boolean(
        userObj.can_teach || userObj.is_teaching || Number(userObj.assigned_class_count) > 0 || resolvedRole === 'FACULTY'
      );
      const rawPhoto = (userObj.photo_url || userObj.photo) as string | null | undefined;
      const safeUserPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(rawPhoto) ? rawPhoto! : null;

      clearPreviousSessionStorage();
      clearApiClientCache();

      if (token) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_token', token);
      if (access) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_access', access);
      if (refresh) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_refresh', refresh);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_username', username);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_faculty_name', facultyName);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_role', resolvedRole);
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_can_teach', String(canTeach));
      if (userId) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_id', String(userId));
      if (safeUserPhoto) localStorage.setItem('attendsure_user_photo', safeUserPhoto);

      if (userObj.school_name || userObj.school_id) {
        updateSchoolInstantly({
          school_name: String(userObj.school_name || ''),
          school_id: String(userObj.school_id || ''),
          school_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.school_logo) ? userObj.school_logo : school.school_logo,
          left_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.left_logo) ? userObj.left_logo : school.left_logo,
          right_logo: isSafeImageUrl(userObj.right_logo) ? userObj.right_logo : school.right_logo,
        });
      }
      refreshSchool().catch(() => {});

      onDemoLoginSuccess(
        {
          user_id: userId,
          token,
          username,
          faculty_name: facultyName,
          role: resolvedRole,
        },
        targetTab
      );
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      setDemoError(
        extractApiError(
          err,
          'Demo workspace is currently unavailable. Please try again later or use Staff Sign In.'
        )
      );
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setLaunchingRole(null);
      }
    }

      : 'radial-gradient(circle at 12% 14%, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.24) 0%, transparent 42%), radial-gradient(circle at 88% 22%, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.18) 0%, transparent 40%), linear-gradient(148deg, #023e73 0%, #004b87 48%, #042544 100%)';

  const purpleAccent = mode === 'dark' ? '#c084fc' : '#7c3aed';

  const sdgPillars = [

            date_str: String(found.date_str || found.date || ''),
            day_of_week: String(found.day_of_week || found.weekday || ''),
            is_weekend: Boolean(found.is_weekend || found.status === 'WEEKEND'),
            am_arrival: String(found.am_arrival || ''),
            am_departure: String(found.am_departure || ''),
            pm_arrival: String(found.pm_arrival || ''),
            pm_departure: String(found.pm_departure || ''),
            undertime_hours: found.undertime_hours ?? '',
            undertime_minutes: found.undertime_minutes ?? '',
            is_loafing: Boolean(found.is_loafing),
            loafing_excused: Boolean(found.loafing_excused),
            loafing_remarks: String(found.loafing_remarks || ''),
          });
        } else {
          rows31.push({
            day: dayNum,
            date_str: '',
            day_of_week: '',
            is_weekend: false,
            am_arrival: '',
            am_departure: '',
            pm_arrival: '',
            pm_departure: '',
            undertime_hours: '',
            undertime_minutes: '',
            is_loafing: false,
            loafing_excused: false,
            loafing_remarks: '',
          });
        }
      }

      const resolvedMonthNum = Number(raw.month_number || selectedMonth);
      const resolvedMonthName =
        typeof raw.month === 'string' && isNaN(Number(raw.month))
          ? raw.month
          : MONTH_NAMES[resolvedMonthNum - 1] || 'Month';

      const regHrs = String(raw.regular_days_hours ?? raw.regular_hours ?? '');
      const satHrs = String(raw.saturdays_hours ?? raw.saturday_hours ?? '');

      if (!isInteracting.current) {
        setRegularHours(regHrs);
        setSaturdayHours(satHrs);
      }

      if (!isFaculty && raw.faculty_id && !selectedFacultyId) {
        setSelectedFacultyId(String(raw.faculty_id));
      }

      return {
        faculty_id: Number(raw.faculty_id || 0),
        faculty_name: String(raw.faculty_name || ''),
        employee_id: String(raw.employee_id || ''),
        department: String(raw.department || ''),
        month: resolvedMonthName,
        month_number: resolvedMonthNum,
        year: Number(raw.year || selectedYear),
        regular_days_hours: regHrs,
        saturdays_hours: satHrs,
        school_head: String(raw.school_head || raw.school?.school_head || ''),
        school_head_title: String(raw.school_head_title || raw.school?.principal_title || ''),
        dtr_submitted: Boolean(raw.dtr_submitted ?? raw.is_submitted),
        dept_head_approved: Boolean(raw.dept_head_approved ?? raw.is_dept_head_approved),
        can_approve_dept: Boolean(
          raw.can_approve_dept ?? ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(currentUserRole)
        ),
        can_clear_loafing: Boolean(
          raw.can_clear_loafing ?? ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL'].includes(currentUserRole)
        ),
        rows: rows31,
        total_undertime_hours: Number(raw.total_undertime_hours || 0),
        total_undertime_minutes: Number(raw.total_undertime_minutes || 0),
        days_present: Number(raw.days_present || 0),
      };
    },
    [selectedFacultyId, selectedMonth, selectedYear, currentUserRole, isFaculty]
  );

  const fetchDTR = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      if (!isFaculty && !selectedFacultyId && facultyList.length > 0) return;

      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const endpoint =
        !isFaculty && selectedFacultyId
          ? `${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${selectedFacultyId}/`
          : API_ROUTES.reports.dtr;

      const baseParams = { month: selectedMonth, year: selectedYear };
      const cached = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<any>(endpoint, baseParams) : undefined;
      if (cached) {
        setDtrData(normalizeDtrPayload(cached));
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<any>(endpoint, {
          params: {
            ...baseParams,
            ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setDtrData(normalizeDtrPayload(res.data || {}));
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load Daily Time Record.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [isFaculty, selectedFacultyId, selectedMonth, selectedYear, facultyList.length, normalizeDtrPayload]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchDTR(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void fetchDTR(true, true);
      }
    }, 20000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [fetchDTR]);

  const handleSubmitDTR = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Certify & Submit DTR',
      message: `Certify and submit your Daily Time Record for ${dtrData.month} ${dtrData.year} to your Department Head for review?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Certify & Submit',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionProcessing(true);
        try {
          await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${dtrData.faculty_id}/`, {
            action: 'SUBMIT_DTR',
            faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
            month: dtrData.month_number,
            year: dtrData.year,
            regular_days_hours: sanitizeInput(regularHours, 100),
            saturdays_hours: sanitizeInput(saturdayHours, 100),
          });
          setHoursDirty(false);
          showAlert({
            title: 'DTR Submitted',
            message: 'Your Daily Time Record was submitted for Department Head approval.',
            type: 'success',
          });
          void fetchDTR(true, true);
        } catch (err) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Submission Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not submit DTR.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionProcessing(false);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleApproveByDeptHead = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Approve Official DTR',
      message: `Approve the Daily Time Record for ${dtrData.faculty_name} (${dtrData.month} ${dtrData.year})? This removes the DRAFT watermark and unlocks printing.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Approve DTR',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionProcessing(true);
        try {
          await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${dtrData.faculty_id}/`, {
            action: 'APPROVE_DEPT_HEAD',
            faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
            month: dtrData.month_number,
            year: dtrData.year,
            regular_days_hours: sanitizeInput(regularHours, 100),
            saturdays_hours: sanitizeInput(saturdayHours, 100),
          });
          setHoursDirty(false);
          showAlert({
            title: 'DTR Approved',
            message: `Official DTR for ${dtrData.faculty_name} is now unlocked for printing.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
          void fetchDTR(true, true);
        } catch (err) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Approval Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not approve DTR.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionProcessing(false);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleExcuseAlertByPrincipal = async () => {
    if (!dtrData || !selectedAlertRow) return;
    const cleanReason = sanitizeInput(excuseRemarks, 240);
    if (!cleanReason) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Reason Required',
        message: 'Please enter official remarks explaining why this off-campus alert is excused.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setActionProcessing(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.reports.dtr}${dtrData.faculty_id}/`, {
        action: 'EXCUSE_LOAFING',
        faculty_id: dtrData.faculty_id,
        date_str: selectedAlertRow.date_str,
        month: dtrData.month_number,
        year: dtrData.year,
        remarks: cleanReason,
      });
      showAlert({
        title: 'Alert Excused',
        message: `Off-campus alert on ${selectedAlertRow.date_str} has been marked as excused.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
      setSelectedAlertRow(null);
      setExcuseRemarks('');
      void fetchDTR(true, true);
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Action Denied',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Only authorized leadership can excuse campus alerts.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setActionProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadPdf = async () => {
    if (!printAreaRef.current || !dtrData) return;
    if (!dtrData.dept_head_approved) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Approval Required',
        message: 'Department Head approval is required before exporting official PDF copies.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setExportingPdf(true);
    try {
      const safeName = (dtrData.faculty_name || 'Faculty').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_');
      await exportElementToLocalPdf({
        element: printAreaRef.current,
        filename: `CSC_Form_48_${safeName}_${dtrData.month}_${dtrData.year}.pdf`,
        pageWidthInches: 8.5,
        pageHeightInches: 14.0,
        orientation: 'portrait',
        marginsInches: [0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.15],
      });
    } catch {
      window.print();
    } finally {
      setExportingPdf(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    if (!dtrData?.dept_head_approved) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Printing Locked',
        message: 'Printing is locked until the Department Head approves this record.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }
    window.print();
  };

  const resolvedSchoolHead = (dtrData?.school_head || school.principal_name || '').trim();
  const resolvedSchoolHeadTitle = (dtrData?.school_head_title || school.principal_title || '').trim();

  const renderDTRCopy = () => {
    if (!dtrData) return null;

    return (
      <div style={formCardContainer}>
        {!dtrData.dept_head_approved && (
          <div style={draftWatermarkStyle}>
            <div style={{ transform: 'rotate(-32deg)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center' }}>
              <div style={draftWatermarkText}>DRAFT</div>
              <div style={draftWatermarkSub}>PENDING DEPT HEAD APPROVAL</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 2 }}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '7.5pt', fontStyle: 'italic', fontFamily: "'Times New Roman', Times, serif" }}>
            Civil Service Form No. 48
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '11.5pt', fontWeight: 900, textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.6px', marginTop: 1 }}>
            DAILY TIME RECORD
          </div>

          <div style={{ marginTop: 8, borderBottom: '1.2px solid #000', paddingBottom: 1, minHeight: 18 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '9.2pt', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
              {dtrData.faculty_name}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '6.5pt', fontStyle: 'italic', marginTop: 1 }}>(Name)</div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ fontSize: '6.8pt', marginBottom: 4, lineHeight: 1.25 }}>
          <div style={{ borderBottom: '0.8px solid #000', paddingBottom: 2 }}>
            <span>
              For the month of <u>&nbsp;<strong>{dtrData.month}</strong>&nbsp;</u>, {dtrData.year}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginTop: 3 }}>
            <div style={{ width: '46%', fontSize: '6.2pt', lineHeight: 1.15 }}>
              Official hours of arrival<br />
              and departure
            </div>
            <div style={{ width: '54%', fontSize: '6.2pt', lineHeight: 1.15 }}>
              <div>Regular Days: <u>{regularHours || '\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0'}</u></div>
              <div style={{ marginTop: 1 }}>Saturdays: <u>{saturdayHours || '\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0\u00A0'}</u></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <table style={dtrTable}>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th rowSpan={2} style={{ width: '10%', ...dtrTh }}>Days</th>
              <th colSpan={2} style={dtrTh}>A. M.</th>
              <th colSpan={2} style={dtrTh}>P. M.</th>
              <th colSpan={2} style={dtrTh}>
                UNDER<br />TIME
              </th>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>ARRIVAL</th>
              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>DEPAR-<br />TURE</th>
              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>ARRIVAL</th>
              <th style={{ width: '17.5%', ...dtrThSub }}>DEPAR-<br />TURE</th>
              <th style={{ width: '10%', ...dtrThSub }}>Hours</th>
              <th style={{ width: '10%', ...dtrThSub }}>Minutes</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {dtrData.rows.map((row) => {
              const hasOpenAlert = Boolean(row.is_loafing && !row.loafing_excused);

              return (

                  }}

                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    {row.day}
                    {row.is_loafing && (

                        style={{
                          marginLeft: 2,
                          fontSize: '5.2pt',
                          color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#059669',
                          cursor: dtrData.can_clear_loafing ? 'pointer' : 'default',
                        }}
                      >
                        {hasOpenAlert ? '(!)' : '(✓)'}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.am_arrival}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.am_departure}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.pm_arrival}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 700 : 400 }}>
                    {row.pm_departure}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 800 : 400 }}>
                    {row.undertime_hours}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, color: hasOpenAlert ? '#dc2626' : '#000', fontWeight: hasOpenAlert ? 800 : 400 }}>
                    {row.undertime_minutes}

              );

            <tr style={{ height: 16, borderTop: '1.2px solid #000', fontWeight: 800 }}>

              <td colSpan={4} style={{ ...dtrTdCenter, fontSize: '5.6pt' }}>
                Days Present: <strong>{dtrData.days_present}</strong> &bull; Undertime:
              </td>
              <td style={dtrTdCenter}>{dtrData.total_undertime_hours || ''}</td>
              <td style={dtrTdCenter}>{dtrData.total_undertime_minutes || ''}</td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 6, fontSize: '5.8pt', textAlign: 'justify', lineHeight: 1.25 }}>
          I CERTIFY on my honor that the above is a true and correct report of the hours of work performed, record of which was made daily at the time of arrival and departure from office.
        </div>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 16, textAlign: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #000', width: '82%', margin: '0 auto' }} />
          <div style={{ fontSize: '5.6pt', fontStyle: 'italic', marginTop: 1 }}>
            (Signature of Faculty / Employee)
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ marginTop: 10, textAlign: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #000', width: '82%', margin: '0 auto', minHeight: 14 }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '7.5pt', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
              {resolvedSchoolHead}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: '6.4pt', fontWeight: 700, marginTop: 1 }}>
            {resolvedSchoolHeadTitle || 'In-Charge'}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 4, fontSize: '5.6pt', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
          (See Instructions on back)
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const renderInstructionsCopy = () => (
    <div style={formCardContainer}>
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 8, borderBottom: '1px solid #000', paddingBottom: 4 }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: '11pt', fontWeight: 900, letterSpacing: '0.8px' }}>INSTRUCTIONS</div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ fontSize: '6.0pt', textAlign: 'justify', lineHeight: 1.35, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
        <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>
          Civil Service Form No. 48, after completion, should be filed in the records of the Bureau or Office which submits the monthly report on Civil Service Form No. 3 to the Bureau of Civil Service.
        </p>
        <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>
          In the space provided for the purpose on the other side will be indicated the office hours the employee is required to observe, as for example, &ldquo;Regular days, 8:00 to 12:00 and 1:00 to 4:00; Saturdays, 8:00 to 1:00.&rdquo;
        </p>
        <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>
          Attention is invited to paragraph 3, Civil Service Rule XV, Executive Order No. 5, series of 1909, which reads as follows:
        </p>
        <blockquote style={{ margin: '0 0 0 8px', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #000', paddingLeft: 6, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
          &ldquo;Each chief of a Bureau or Office shall require a daily record of attendance of all the officers and employees under him entitled to leave of absence or vacation (including faculty) to be kept on the proper form and also a systematic office record showing for each day all absences from duty from any cause whatever. At the beginning of each month he shall report to the Commissioner on the proper form of all absences from any cause whatever, including the exact amount of undertime of each person for each day. Falsification of time records will render the offending officer or employee liable to summary removal from the service and criminal prosecution.&rdquo;
        </blockquote>
        <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 0 0', fontSize: '5.7pt' }}>
          <strong>(NOTE:</strong> A record made from memory at sometime subsequent to the occurrence of an event is not reliable. Non-observance of office hours deprives the employee of leave privileges although he may have rendered overtime service. Where service is rendered outside of the Office for the whole morning or afternoon, notation to that effect should be made clearly.)
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
      <div
        style={{
          ...ui.card,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '12px 16px',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <ProfileAvatar
              photoUrl={activeFaculty?.photo_url}
              name={activeFaculty?.full_name || dtrData?.faculty_name || 'Faculty'}
              size={36}
              iconSize={18}
            />

            {isFaculty ? (
              <div
                style={{
                  ...ui.subtleBox,
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,
                  padding: '6px 12px',
                  fontSize: '0.82rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                }}
                title="Locked to your personal time record"
              >
                <Lock size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                <span>
                  {dtrData?.faculty_name || 'My Time Record'}
                  {dtrData?.employee_id ? ` (${dtrData.employee_id})` : ''}
                </span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <select
                aria-label="Select faculty member"
                value={selectedFacultyId}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedFacultyId(e.target.value)}
                style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', minWidth: 220, fontWeight: 700 }}
              >
                {facultyList.map((f) => (
                  <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                    {f.full_name} ({f.employee_id})
                  </option>

              </select>
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
            <Calendar size={15} color={brand.primary} />
            <select
              aria-label="Select month"
              value={selectedMonth}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedMonth(Number(e.target.value))}
              style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', padding: '6px 10px' }}
            >
              {MONTH_NAMES.map((m, idx) => (
                <option key={m} value={idx + 1}>
                  {m}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <select
            aria-label="Select year"

const cleanInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 120): string => {
  const stripped = String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '')
    .replace(/[<>]/g, '');
  return sanitizeText(stripped, maxLength);
};

const getSafeAvatarUrl = (faculty: Pick<Faculty, 'photo_url' | 'photo'>): string | null => {
  const candidate = faculty.photo_url || faculty.photo || null;
  return isSafeImageUrl(candidate) ? candidate : null;
};

const getInitials = (name: string): string => {
  const words = cleanInput(name, 80)
    .replace(/,/g, ' ')
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length >= 2) return `${words[0][0]}${words[1][0]}`.toUpperCase();
  return (words[0] || 'F').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
};

const getUserScopedCacheKey = (): string => {
  const scope = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user_id') || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') || 'default';
  return `${CACHE_STORAGE_KEY}_${scope}`;
};

const readCachedFacultyList = (): { items: Faculty[]; count: number } | null => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(getUserScopedCacheKey());
    if (!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { items?: Faculty[]; count?: number; savedAt?: number };
    if (!Array.isArray(parsed.items)) return null;
    return {
      items: parsed.items,
      count: typeof parsed.count === 'number' ? parsed.count : parsed.items.length,
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

const writeCachedFacultyList = (items: Faculty[], count: number): void => {
  try {
    const compact = items.slice(0, 100).map((item) => ({
      ...item,
      photo: item.photo && item.photo.length > 500 ? null : item.photo,
    }));
    localStorage.setItem(
      getUserScopedCacheKey(),
      JSON.stringify({ items: compact, count, savedAt: Date.now() })
    );
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage quota restrictions
  }
};
