  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState<number>(1);
  const [totalCount, setTotalCount] = useState<number>(() => initialCache?.count || 0);

  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [editingFaculty, setEditingFaculty] = useState<Faculty | null>(null);
  const [inspectingFaculty, setInspectingFaculty] = useState<Faculty | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [resettingDeviceId, setResettingDeviceId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<FacultyFormState>(INITIAL_FORM_DATA);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const fileReaderRef = useRef<FileReader | null>(null);
  const mountedRef = useRef<boolean>(true);
  const activeAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const copyTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const prevSearchRef = useRef<string>(search);
  const hasLoadedItemsRef = useRef<boolean>((initialCache?.items.length || 0) > 0);
  const isInteractingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  isInteractingRef.current = isModalOpen || Boolean(inspectingFaculty);

  const handleCopy = useCallback(async (text: string, key: string) => {
    const cleanValue = cleanInput(text, 120);
    if (!cleanValue) return;

    let copied = false;
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(cleanValue);
        copied = true;
      } catch {
        copied = false;
      }
    }

    if (!copied) {
      try {
        const helper = document.createElement('textarea');
        helper.value = cleanValue;
        helper.style.position = 'fixed';
        helper.style.left = '-99999px';
        document.body.appendChild(helper);
        helper.focus();
        helper.select();
        copied = document.execCommand('copy');
        helper.remove();
      } catch {
        copied = false;
      }
    }

    if (copied) {
      if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
      setCopiedKey(key);
      copyTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadFacultyList = useCallback(
    async (
      page = 1,
      size = 25,
      query = '',
      deptVal = '',
      silent = false,
      bypassCache = false
    ) => {
      activeAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      activeAbortRef.current = controller;

      const cleanQuery = cleanInput(query, 80);
      const cleanDept = cleanInput(deptVal, 100);
      const isAll = size >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE;

      try {
        if (!silent) {
          if (!hasLoadedItemsRef.current) setLoading(true);
          setRefreshing(true);
        }
        setErrorMessage(null);

        const [listOutcome, dropdownOutcome] = await Promise.allSettled([
          apiClient.get<PaginatedResponse<Faculty> | Faculty[]>(FACULTY_ENDPOINT, {
            params: {
              page: isAll ? 1 : page,
              page_size: isAll ? 'ALL' : size,
              search: cleanQuery || undefined,
              department: cleanDept || undefined,
              ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
            },
            signal: controller.signal,
          }),
          apiClient.get<Faculty[]>(FACULTY_DROPDOWN_ENDPOINT, {
            params: { include_all: 1 },
            signal: controller.signal,
          }),
        ]);

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        if (listOutcome.status === 'fulfilled') {
          const payload = listOutcome.value.data;
          if (payload && !Array.isArray(payload) && Array.isArray(payload.results)) {
            setFacultyList(payload.results);
            hasLoadedItemsRef.current = payload.results.length > 0;
            setTotalCount(payload.count);
            setTotalPages(isAll ? 1 : payload.total_pages || Math.ceil(payload.count / size) || 1);
            setCurrentPage(isAll ? 1 : payload.current_page || page);
            if (!cleanQuery && !cleanDept && page === 1) {
              writeCachedFacultyList(payload.results, payload.count);
            }
          } else if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
            setFacultyList(payload);
            hasLoadedItemsRef.current = payload.length > 0;
            setTotalCount(payload.length);
            setTotalPages(1);
            setCurrentPage(1);
            if (!cleanQuery && !cleanDept) {
              writeCachedFacultyList(payload, payload.length);
            }
          }
          setLastUpdated(new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }));
        } else {
          const reason = listOutcome.reason as { name?: string; code?: string };
          if (reason?.name === 'CanceledError' || reason?.name === 'AbortError' || reason?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
            return;
          }
          if (!silent) {
            setErrorMessage(
              extractApiError(
                listOutcome.reason,
                'Could not load the faculty directory right now. Please check your connection and try again.'
              )
            );
          }
        }

        if (dropdownOutcome.status === 'fulfilled' && Array.isArray(dropdownOutcome.value.data)) {
          const foundDepts = Array.from(
            new Set(
              dropdownOutcome.value.data
                .map((item) => cleanInput(item.department || '', 100))
                .filter(Boolean)
            )
          ).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
          setDirectoryDepartments(foundDepts);
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    []
  );

  // Clean up pending requests, readers, and timers on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      activeAbortRef.current?.abort();
      fileReaderRef.current?.abort();
      if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Reload when search (debounced), department filter, or page size changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const searchChanged = prevSearchRef.current !== search;
    prevSearchRef.current = search;
    const delay = searchChanged ? 280 : 0;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setCurrentPage(1);
      void loadFacultyList(1, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, false, false);
    }, delay);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [search, departmentFilter, pageSize, loadFacultyList]);

  // Gentle background refresh only while page is visible and user is not inside a modal
  useEffect(() => {
    const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && !isInteractingRef.current) {
        void loadFacultyList(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true, true);
      }
    }, 15000);
    return () => clearInterval(intervalId);
  }, [currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, loadFacultyList]);

  // Merge built-in departments with any live database departments
  const departmentOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const combined = new Set<string>(DEFAULT_DEPARTMENTS);
    directoryDepartments.forEach((d) => combined.add(d));
    facultyList.forEach((f) => {
      if (f.department?.trim()) combined.add(f.department.trim());
    });
    if (formData.department.trim()) combined.add(formData.department.trim());
    return Array.from(combined).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
  }, [directoryDepartments, facultyList, formData.department]);

  // Preserve any custom position already stored in the database when editing
  const positionGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const knownRanks = new Set(DEFAULT_POSITION_GROUPS.flatMap((g) => g.ranks));
    const currentPos = formData.position.trim();
    if (!currentPos || knownRanks.has(currentPos)) {
      return DEFAULT_POSITION_GROUPS;
    }
    return [
      { category: 'Current Assignment', ranks: [currentPos] },
      ...DEFAULT_POSITION_GROUPS,
    ];
  }, [formData.position]);

  const displayedFaculty = useMemo(() => {
    return facultyList.filter((item) => {
      if (statusFilter === 'ACTIVE') return item.is_active;
      if (statusFilter === 'INACTIVE') return !item.is_active;
      if (statusFilter === 'BOUND') return Boolean(item.bound_device_id);
      if (statusFilter === 'UNBOUND') return !item.bound_device_id;
      return true;
    });
  }, [facultyList, statusFilter]);

  const activeFacultyCount = useMemo(
    () => facultyList.filter((f) => f.is_active).length,
    [facultyList]
  );

  const boundPhonesCount = useMemo(
    () => facultyList.filter((f) => Boolean(f.bound_device_id && f.bound_device_id.trim())).length,
    [facultyList]
  );

  const uniqueDepartmentCount = useMemo(() => {
    const source = directoryDepartments.length > 0 ? directoryDepartments : facultyList.map((f) => f.department);
    return new Set(source.filter(Boolean)).size;
  }, [directoryDepartments, facultyList]);

  const handlePageChange = (nextPage: number) => {
    if (nextPage < 1 || nextPage > totalPages) return;
    setCurrentPage(nextPage);
    void loadFacultyList(nextPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, false, false);
  };

  const handlePageSizeChange = (nextSize: number) => {
    if (nextSize === pageSize) return;
    setPageSize(nextSize);
    setCurrentPage(1);
  };

  const handleManualRefresh = () => {
    void refreshSchool();
    void loadFacultyList(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, false, true);
  };

  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const suffix = pageSize >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE ? 'All' : `Page${currentPage}_${pageSize}rows`;
    const exported = exportToCsv(
      `AttendSure_Faculty_${suffix}.csv`,
      [
        'Employee ID',
        'Full Name',
        'Position',
        'Department',
        'Handles Classes',
        'Email',
        'Phone Number',
        'Linked Mobile Device',
        'Status',
      ],
      displayedFaculty.map((f) => [
        f.employee_id,
        f.full_name,
        f.position,
        f.department,
        f.can_teach ? 'YES' : 'NO',
        f.email || '',
        f.contact_number || '',
        f.bound_device_id ? f.device_model || 'Linked Phone' : 'Not Linked',
        f.is_active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE',
      ])
    );

    if (exported) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'CSV Downloaded',
        message: `Saved ${displayedFaculty.length} faculty records to a CSV file.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
    } else {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Nothing to Export',
        message: 'There are no faculty records matching your current filters.',
        type: 'info',
      });
    }
  };

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'];
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Unsupported Image',
        message: 'Please choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP photo.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Photo Too Large',
        message: 'Profile photos must be 2.5 MB or smaller.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      return;
    }

    fileReaderRef.current?.abort();
    const reader = new FileReader();
    fileReaderRef.current = reader;
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      if (!mountedRef.current || reader.readyState !== FileReader.DONE) return;
      const result = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      if (!isSafeImageUrl(result)) {
        showAlert({
          title: 'Invalid Image',
          message: 'Could not verify the selected image file.',
          type: 'error',
        });
        return;
      }
      setPhotoPreview(result);
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: result }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleRemovePhoto = () => {
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: '' }));
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
  };

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingFaculty(null);
    setFormData(INITIAL_FORM_DATA);
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (faculty: Faculty) => {
    setEditingFaculty(faculty);
    setFormData({
      employee_id: faculty.employee_id || '',
      first_name: faculty.first_name || '',
      middle_name: faculty.middle_name || '',
      last_name: faculty.last_name || '',
      suffix: faculty.suffix || '',
      position: faculty.position || 'Faculty I',
      department: faculty.department || 'Junior High School',
      contact_number: faculty.contact_number || '',
      email: faculty.email || '',
      can_teach: faculty.can_teach ?? true,
      is_active: faculty.is_active ?? true,
      photo: null,
    });
    setPhotoPreview(getSafeAvatarUrl(faculty));
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;

    const cleanEmployeeId = cleanInput(formData.employee_id, 50).toUpperCase();
    const cleanFirstName = cleanInput(formData.first_name, 100);
    const cleanMiddleName = cleanInput(formData.middle_name, 100);
    const cleanLastName = cleanInput(formData.last_name, 100);
    const cleanSuffix = SUFFIX_OPTIONS.includes(formData.suffix) ? formData.suffix : '';
    const cleanEmail = cleanInput(formData.email, 150).toLowerCase();
    const cleanPhone = cleanInput(formData.contact_number, 30).replace(/[^\d+\-()\s]/g, '').replace(/[\s()-]/g, '');

    if (!cleanEmployeeId || !cleanFirstName || !cleanLastName) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Missing Information',
        message: 'Please enter the Employee ID, First Name, and Last Name.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (cleanEmail && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(cleanEmail)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Invalid Email Address',
        message: 'Please enter a valid email address or leave the email box blank.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      employee_id: cleanEmployeeId,
      first_name: cleanFirstName,
      middle_name: cleanMiddleName,
      last_name: cleanLastName,
      suffix: cleanSuffix,
      position: cleanInput(formData.position, 100),
      department: cleanInput(formData.department, 100),
      email: cleanEmail,
      contact_number: cleanPhone,
      can_teach: Boolean(formData.can_teach),
      is_active: Boolean(formData.is_active),
    };

    if (formData.photo !== null) {
      payload.photo = formData.photo === '' ? null : formData.photo;
    }

    try {
      if (editingFaculty) {
        const res = await apiClient.put<Faculty>(`${FACULTY_ENDPOINT}${editingFaculty.id}/`, payload);
        setFacultyList((prev) => prev.map((f) => (f.id === editingFaculty.id ? res.data : f)));
        showAlert({
          title: 'Profile Saved',
          message: `Updated details for ${cleanFirstName} ${cleanLastName}.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      } else {
        const res = await apiClient.post<Faculty>(FACULTY_ENDPOINT, payload);
        setFacultyList((prev) => [res.data, ...prev]);
        showAlert({
          title: 'Faculty Added',
          message: `${cleanFirstName} ${cleanLastName} has been added to the directory.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      }
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      void loadFacultyList(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true, true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Could Not Save',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Unable to save this faculty record. Please check the details and try again.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetDeviceBinding = (faculty: Faculty) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Reset Phone Lock',
      message: `Unlink the current mobile phone for ${faculty.full_name}? Their next GPS & facial check-in will automatically pair their new phone.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Reset Phone Lock',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setResettingDeviceId(faculty.id);
        try {
          const res = await apiClient.post<{ message?: string }>(`${FACULTY_ENDPOINT}${faculty.id}/reset-device/`, {
            faculty_id: faculty.id,
          });
          setFacultyList((prev) =>
            prev.map((item) =>
              item.id === faculty.id
                ? { ...item, bound_device_id: null, device_model: null, device_bound_at: null }
                : item
            )
          );
          if (inspectingFaculty?.id === faculty.id) {
            setInspectingFaculty((prev) =>
              prev ? { ...prev, bound_device_id: null, device_model: null, device_bound_at: null } : null
            );
          }
          showAlert({
            title: 'Phone Lock Cleared',
            message: res.data?.message || `Cleared the bound phone for ${faculty.full_name}.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Reset Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not reset the phone lock for this faculty member.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setResettingDeviceId(null);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const promptDelete = (faculty: Faculty) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Remove Faculty Member',
      message: `Permanently remove ${faculty.full_name || faculty.first_name} (${faculty.employee_id}) from the AttendSure faculty directory?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Remove Faculty',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${FACULTY_ENDPOINT}${faculty.id}/`);
          setFacultyList((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.id !== faculty.id));
          if (inspectingFaculty?.id === faculty.id) setInspectingFaculty(null);
          showAlert({
            title: 'Faculty Removed',
            message: `Removed ${faculty.full_name || faculty.first_name} from the directory.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
          void loadFacultyList(currentPage, pageSize, search, departmentFilter, true, true);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Could Not Remove',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Unable to remove this faculty record right now.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const styles = useMemo(
    () => ({
      page: {
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column' as const,
        gap: 16,
        padding: 'clamp(12px, 2.2vw, 20px)',
        maxWidth: 1400,
        margin: '0 auto',
        fontFamily: fonts.sans,
      },
      headerCard: {
        ...ui.card,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        flexWrap: 'wrap' as const,
        gap: 12,
      },
      statsGrid: {
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 205px), 1fr))',
        gap: 12,
      },
      controlsBar: {
        ...ui.card,
        padding: '12px 16px',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column' as const,
        gap: 10,
      },
      controlsTopRow: {
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        alignItems: 'center',
        flexWrap: 'wrap' as const,
        gap: 10,
      },
      searchWrap: {
        position: 'relative' as const,
        flex: '1 1 220px',
        maxWidth: 320,
      },
      searchInput: {
        ...ui.input,
        paddingLeft: 34,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
      },
      deptSelect: {
        ...ui.input,
        width: 'auto',
        minWidth: 210,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        cursor: 'pointer',
      },
      filterPillsRow: {
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 6,
        flexWrap: 'wrap' as const,
      },
      tableCard: {
        ...ui.card,
        padding: 0,
        overflow: 'hidden',
      },
      actionBtn: {
        width: 30,
        height: 30,
        borderRadius: radius.sm,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderStyle: 'solid' as const,
        borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        color: tokens.textSecondary,
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        cursor: 'pointer',
      },
      modalBodySurface: {
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        color: tokens.textPrimary,
        margin: -20,
        padding: 20,
        fontFamily: fonts.sans,
      },
      formGrid2: {
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr))',
        gap: 10,
      },
      nameGrid: {
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(115px, 1fr))',
        gap: 10,
      },
    }),
    [tokens, fonts, radius, ui]
  );

  const filterPillOptions: { key: StatusFilter; label: string }[] = [
    { key: 'ALL', label: `All (${facultyList.length})` },
    { key: 'ACTIVE', label: `Active (${activeFacultyCount})` },
    { key: 'INACTIVE', label: `Inactive (${Math.max(0, facultyList.length - activeFacultyCount)})` },
    { key: 'BOUND', label: `Phone Linked (${boundPhonesCount})` },
    { key: 'UNBOUND', label: `Unlinked (${Math.max(0, facultyList.length - boundPhonesCount)})` },
  ];

  const activeSchoolName = school.school_name?.trim() || 'AttendSure School Campus';

  const inspectingQrValue = inspectingFaculty
    ? `ATTENDSURE-FACULTY:${inspectingFaculty.employee_id}`
    : '';

  return (
    <div style={styles.page}>
      {/* Top Directory Header */}
      <div style={styles.headerCard}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, minWidth: 0 }}>
          <AttendSureBrandBadge size={42} mode={mode} />
          <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
            <h2
              style={{
                margin: 0,
                fontSize: fonts.size.lg,
                fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
                fontFamily: fonts.display,
              }}
            >
              Faculty Directory
            </h2>
            <p style={{ margin: '2px 0 0', fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
              Manage faculty profiles, class list assignments, and 1-to-1 mobile check-in phone bindings.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {lastUpdated && (
            <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>
              Synced {lastUpdated}
            </span>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleManualRefresh}
            loading={refreshing}
            icon={<RefreshCw size={13} />}
          >
            Refresh
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleExportCsv}
            icon={<Download size={13} />}
          >
            Export CSV
          </Button>
          {canManageFaculty && (
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleOpenCreate}
              icon={<Plus size={14} />}
            >
              Add Faculty
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Recoverable Network Error Banner */}
      {errorMessage && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            gap: 10,
            padding: '10px 14px',
            borderRadius: radius.lg,
            backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
            border: `1px solid ${brand.danger}`,
            color: brand.danger,
            fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
            fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold,
          }}
        >
          <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <AlertCircle size={16} />
            {errorMessage}
          </span>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={handleManualRefresh}>
            Try Again
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Telemetry Summary Cards */}
      <div style={styles.statsGrid}>
        <StatsCard
          label="Total Faculty"
          value={(totalCount || facultyList.length).toLocaleString()}
          helpText="Registered classroom & support personnel"
          badge={<Users size={17} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="Active Faculty"
          value={activeFacultyCount.toLocaleString()}
          valueColor={brand.success}
          helpText="Cleared for daily mobile GPS check-in"
          badge={<ShieldCheck size={17} color={brand.success} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="Mobile Phones Linked"
          value={`${boundPhonesCount} / ${facultyList.length}`}
          valueColor={brand.primary}
          helpText="1-to-1 bound for face & GPS verification"
          badge={<Smartphone size={17} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="Departments"

      {/* Search, Department Selector & Status Filter Pills */}

        <div style={styles.controlsTopRow}>

                            display: 'flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            justifyContent: 'center',

                            fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                            flexShrink: 0,

                          {avatarUrl ? (
                            <img
                              src={avatarUrl}

                            getInitials(faculty.full_name || faculty.first_name)

                          onClick={() => void handleCopy(faculty.employee_id, `emp-${faculty.id}`)}

                            display: 'inline-flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 5,
                            padding: '3px 8px',
                            borderRadius: radius.sm,
                            border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                            color: tokens.textPrimary,
                            fontFamily: fonts.mono,
                            fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                            fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold,
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                          }}
                        >
                          {copiedKey === `emp-${faculty.id}` ? (
                            <Check size={11} color={brand.success} />
                          ) : (
                            <Copy size={11} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                          )}
                          <span>{faculty.employee_id}</span>
                        </button>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div style={{ fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                          {faculty.full_name}
                        </div>
                        {faculty.can_teach && (
                          <span
                            style={{
                              display: 'inline-flex',
                              alignItems: 'center',
                              gap: 4,
                              marginTop: 3,
                              fontSize: '0.66rem',
                              fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold,
                              color: brand.secondary,
                            }}
                          >
                            <BookOpen size={10} /> Handles Class Lists
                          </span>

                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div style={{ fontWeight: fonts.weight.semibold, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>

                      <td style={{ ...ui.td, textAlign: 'right' }}>

                          >
                            <QrCode size={14} />
                          </button>

                          {canManageFaculty && (

                              <button

                                type="button"

        <Pagination

          totalCount={totalCount}

          onPageSizeChange={handlePageSizeChange}

          style={{
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
            borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,

      {/* Add / Edit Faculty Modal */}
      {isModalOpen && (

          isOpen={isModalOpen}

          title={editingFaculty ? `Edit Faculty: ${editingFaculty.full_name}` : 'Add New Faculty Member'}

        >
          <div style={styles.modalBodySurface}>
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
              {/* Profile Photo Picker */}
              <div
                style={{
                  ...ui.subtleBox,
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'space-between',
                  gap: 12,
                  flexWrap: 'wrap',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12 }}>
                  <div
                    style={{
                      width: 54,
                      height: 54,
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      overflow: 'hidden',
                      backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                      border: `1.5px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center',
                      flexShrink: 0,

                    <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                      Directory Profile Photo

                    <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                      Optional JPG, PNG, or WebP (max 2.5 MB). Facial check-in runs privately on-device.

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                  <input
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
                    ref={fileInputRef}
                    onChange={handlePhotoSelect}
                    style={{ display: 'none' }}
                  />
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="sm"
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}

                    Choose Photo
                  </Button>
                  {photoPreview && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleRemovePhoto}
                      style={{
                        background: 'none',
                        border: 'none',
                        color: brand.danger,
                        fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                        fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold,

                      Remove
                    </button>

              {/* Employee ID & Contact Email */}

                      setFormData({ ...formData, employee_id: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })

                  <label htmlFor="faculty-email" style={ui.label}>
                    Email Address
                  </label>

                    id="faculty-email"
                    type="email"
                    maxLength={150}

              <div style={styles.nameGrid}>
                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="faculty-first-name" style={ui.label}>
                    First Name *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="faculty-first-name"
                    type="text"
                    required
                    maxLength={100}
                    value={formData.first_name}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, first_name: e.target.value })}
                    style={ui.input}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="faculty-middle-name" style={ui.label}>

                  </label>

                    id="faculty-middle-name"
                    type="text"
                    maxLength={100}
                    value={formData.middle_name}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, middle_name: e.target.value })}
                    style={ui.input}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label htmlFor="faculty-last-name" style={ui.label}>
                    Last Name *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="faculty-last-name"
                    type="text"
                    required
                    maxLength={100}
                    value={formData.last_name}

              <div style={styles.formGrid2}>

                  </label>

                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, position: e.target.value })}

      {inspectingFaculty && (

          onClose={() => setInspectingFaculty(null)}

          maxWidth="420px"
        >
          <div style={styles.modalBodySurface}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center' }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  maxWidth: 310,

                  overflow: 'hidden',
                  boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,

                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg,
                    color: '#ffffff',
                    padding: '12px 14px',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 10,
                    textAlign: 'left',

                  <AttendSureBrandBadge size={34} mode="light" />

                      ATTENDSURE FACULTY PASS

                    <div
                      style={{
                        fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                        color: '#e0f2fe',
                        whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
                        overflow: 'hidden',
                        textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
                      }}

                      {activeSchoolName}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div style={{ padding: '16px 14px' }}>
                  <div
                    style={{
                      width: 68,
                      height: 68,
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      margin: '0 auto 10px',
                      overflow: 'hidden',
                      border: `2px solid ${brand.primary}`,
                      backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                      color: brand.primary,
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center',
                      fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold,
                      fontSize: fonts.size.lg,
                    }}
                  >
                    {getSafeAvatarUrl(inspectingFaculty) ? (
                      <img
                        src={getSafeAvatarUrl(inspectingFaculty)!}
                        alt={inspectingFaculty.full_name}
                        style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}
                      />
                    ) : (
                      getInitials(inspectingFaculty.full_name || inspectingFaculty.first_name)
                    )}

                  <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.md, fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                    {inspectingFaculty.full_name}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, color: tokens.textSecondary, marginTop: 2 }}>
                    {inspectingFaculty.position}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                    {inspectingFaculty.department}
                  </div>

                  {inspectingQrValue && (
                    <div
                      style={{
                        margin: '12px auto',
                        width: 120,
                        height: 120,
                        padding: 6,
                        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                        borderRadius: radius.md,
                        border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                        display: 'flex',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        justifyContent: 'center',
                      }}
                    >
                      <QrCodeSvg
                        value={inspectingQrValue}
                        size={108}
                        label={`Faculty verification QR code for ${inspectingFaculty.full_name}`}
                        style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div
                    style={{
                      fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
                      fontFamily: fonts.mono,
                      fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold,
                      color: tokens.textPrimary,
                    }}
                  >
                    ID: {inspectingFaculty.employee_id}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                    padding: '10px 12px',
                    borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                    fontSize: fonts.size.xs,
                    color: tokens.textSecondary,
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    gap: 4,
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: fonts.weight.bold, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                    Mobile Check-In:{' '}
                    {inspectingFaculty.bound_device_id
                      ? inspectingFaculty.device_model || 'Linked Phone Active'

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginTop: 16 }}>

                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="md"
                    onClick={() => handleResetDeviceBinding(inspectingFaculty)}
                    loading={resettingDeviceId === inspectingFaculty.id}
                    icon={<RotateCcw size={14} />}
                  >
                    Reset Phone Lock
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button variant="primary" size="md" onClick={() => setInspectingFaculty(null)}>
                  Close
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default FacultyTab;

/**
 * AttendSure - Campus Exit Passes & Exit Clearances

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { ModuleTableLayout } from './ModuleTableLayout';
import { QrCodeSvg } from '../common/QrCodeSvg';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { CheckCircle2, Printer, QrCode, FileText, Plus, FileCheck, FileX, ExternalLink, Edit2, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface GatePass {
  id: number;
  pass_number: string;
  bearer_type: 'STUDENT' | 'FACULTY';
  student?: number | null;
  student_name?: string;
  student_lrn?: string;
  faculty?: number | null;
  faculty_name?: string;
  faculty_emp_id?: string;
  pass_type: string;
  reason: string;
  valid_from: string;
  valid_to: string;
  valid_until?: string;
  status: 'PENDING' | 'ACTIVE' | 'USED' | 'DECLINED' | 'EXPIRED' | 'REVOKED';
  attachment_url?: string | null;
  adviser_name?: string;
  approved_by?: string;
}

interface StudentOption {
  id: number;
  lrn: string;
  full_name: string;
}

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 250): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const isSafeProofUrl = (url?: string | null): boolean => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const trimmed = url.trim().toLowerCase();
  return trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://') || trimmed.startsWith('/media/');
};

export const GatePassesTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { school } = useSchool();
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { mode, tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const successBtnBg = mode === 'dark' ? '#059669' : brand.success;

  const userRole = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const isPrincipalOrAdmin = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL'].includes(userRole);
  const isRestrictedRole = userRole === 'PARENT';

  const [passes, setPasses] = useState<GatePass[]>(() => {
    const cached = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses);
    return cached?.results ?? (Array.isArray(cached) ? cached : []);
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses));
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [debouncedSearch, setDebouncedSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  const [selectedPass, setSelectedPass] = useState<GatePass | null>(null);
  const [reviewingPass, setReviewingPass] = useState<GatePass | null>(null);
  const [editingPass, setEditingPass] = useState<GatePass | null>(null);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const [students, setStudents] = useState<StudentOption[]>([]);
  const [loadingStudents, setLoadingStudents] = useState(false);
  const [passFormType, setPassFormType] = useState<'STUDENT' | 'FACULTY'>('STUDENT');

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    student_id: '',
    pass_type: 'Medical / Health Emergency',
    reason: '',
    valid_from: '',
    valid_to: '',
  });

  const [attachedFile, setAttachedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [declineReason, setDeclineReason] = useState('');
  const [showDeclineModal, setShowDeclineModal] = useState(false);

  const passesAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const studentsAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedSearch(sanitizeInput(search, 80));
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [search]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      passesAbortRef.current?.abort();
      studentsAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const fetchPasses = useCallback(
    async (bypassCache = false) => {
      passesAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      passesAbortRef.current = controller;

      const baseParams = {
        search: debouncedSearch || undefined,
        status: statusFilter !== 'ALL' ? statusFilter : undefined,
      };
      const cached = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses, baseParams) : undefined;
      if (cached) {
        const cachedList = cached?.results ?? (Array.isArray(cached) ? cached : []);
        setPasses(cachedList);
        setLoading(false);
      } else {
        setLoading(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<any>(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses, {
          params: {
            ...baseParams,
            ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const list = res.data?.results ?? (Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : []);
        setPasses(list);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Failed to fetch exit passes.'));
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [debouncedSearch, statusFilter]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchPasses(false);
  }, [fetchPasses]);

  const fetchStudents = async () => {
    studentsAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    studentsAbortRef.current = controller;

    const cached = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.students.dropdown);
    if (cached) {
      const list = cached?.results ?? (Array.isArray(cached) ? cached : []);
      setStudents(list);
      setLoadingStudents(false);
    } else {
      setLoadingStudents(true);
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get<any>(API_ROUTES.students.dropdown, {
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      const list = res.data?.results ?? (Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : []);
      setStudents(list);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
        return;
      }
      setStudents([]);
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setLoadingStudents(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const toInputDate = (d: Date) => {
    const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
  };

  const handleOpenCreateModal = (type: 'STUDENT' | 'FACULTY') => {
    setEditingPass(null);
    setPassFormType(type);
    const now = new Date();

    setFormData({
      student_id: '',
      pass_type: type === 'STUDENT' ? 'Clinic / Medical Clearance' : 'Official DepEd Travel Order',
      reason: '',
      valid_from: toInputDate(now),
      valid_to: toInputDate(new Date(now.getTime() + 4 * 3600000)),
    });
    setAttachedFile(null);

    if (type === 'STUDENT') {
      void fetchStudents();
    }
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEditModal = (pass: GatePass) => {
    setEditingPass(pass);
    setPassFormType(pass.bearer_type || (pass.student ? 'STUDENT' : 'FACULTY'));
    const fromDt = pass.valid_from ? new Date(pass.valid_from) : new Date();
    const toDt = (pass.valid_until || pass.valid_to) ? new Date(pass.valid_until || pass.valid_to) : new Date(Date.now() + 4 * 3600000);

    setFormData({
      student_id: pass.student ? String(pass.student) : '',
      pass_type: pass.pass_type || '',
      reason: pass.reason || '',
      valid_from: isNaN(fromDt.getTime()) ? toInputDate(new Date()) : toInputDate(fromDt),
      valid_to: isNaN(toDt.getTime()) ? toInputDate(new Date(Date.now() + 4 * 3600000)) : toInputDate(toDt),
    });
    setAttachedFile(null);

    if (pass.bearer_type === 'STUDENT' || pass.student) {
      void fetchStudents();
    }
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmitPass = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (attachedFile && attachedFile.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'File Too Large',
        message: 'Proof attachment must be 5 MB or smaller.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const cleanPassType = sanitizeInput(formData.pass_type, 100);
      const cleanReason = sanitizeInput(formData.reason, 500);
      if (!cleanPassType || !cleanReason) {
        showAlert({ title: 'Details Required', message: 'Please enter a valid clearance category and reason.', type: 'warning' });
        setSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      const payload = new FormData();
      payload.append('bearer_type', passFormType);
      payload.append('pass_type', cleanPassType);
      payload.append('reason', cleanReason);
      payload.append('valid_from', new Date(formData.valid_from).toISOString());
      payload.append('valid_until', new Date(formData.valid_to).toISOString());
      payload.append('valid_to', new Date(formData.valid_to).toISOString());
      if (attachedFile) {
        payload.append('attachment', attachedFile);
      }

      if (passFormType === 'STUDENT') {
        if (!formData.student_id) {
          showAlert({ title: 'Student Required', message: 'Please select a student.', type: 'warning' });
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        payload.append('student', formData.student_id);
      }

      if (editingPass) {
        await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${editingPass.id}/`, payload, {
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
        });
        showAlert({
          title: 'Exit Pass Updated',
          message: `Exit pass #${editingPass.pass_number} has been updated.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses, payload, {
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
        });

        showAlert({
          title: passFormType === 'FACULTY' ? 'Travel Pass Submitted' : 'Student Exit Permit Issued',
          message:
            passFormType === 'FACULTY'
              ? 'Travel pass submitted to Principal/Admin for approval.'
              : 'Student exit permit generated and parent notified via mobile push.',
          type: 'success',
        });
      }

      setIsModalOpen(false);
      setEditingPass(null);
      await fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Submission Error',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Unable to submit exit pass.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeletePass = (pass: GatePass) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Exit Pass',
      message: `Are you sure you want to permanently remove pass #${pass.pass_number}?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${pass.id}/`);
          setPasses((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== pass.id));
          showAlert({ title: 'Pass Deleted', message: `Pass #${pass.pass_number} has been removed.`, type: 'success' });
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({ title: 'Delete Failed', message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not delete exit pass.'), type: 'error' });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleApprove = async (passId: number) => {
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${passId}/approve/`);
      showAlert({ title: 'Pass Approved', message: 'Travel pass approved and active for campus departure.', type: 'success' });
      setReviewingPass(null);
      await fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to approve pass.'), type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleDecline = async () => {
    if (!reviewingPass) return;
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${reviewingPass.id}/decline/`, {
        reason: sanitizeInput(declineReason, 300) || 'Declined upon document authenticity review.',
      });
      showAlert({ title: 'Pass Declined', message: 'Exit pass has been declined.', type: 'info' });
      setShowDeclineModal(false);
      setDeclineReason('');
      setReviewingPass(null);
      await fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to decline pass.'), type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleMarkUsed = async (passId: number) => {
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${passId}/mark-used/`);
      showAlert({ title: 'Exit Confirmed', message: 'Bearer departure confirmed.', type: 'success' });
      await fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Notice', message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to confirm exit.'), type: 'warning' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16, padding: 'clamp(14px, 2.5vw, 24px)', boxSizing: 'border-box', width: '100%' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, padding: 14, borderRadius: 12, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {['ALL', 'PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'USED', 'DECLINED'].map((st) => (
            <button
              key={st}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter(st)}
              style={{
                padding: '6px 14px',
                borderRadius: 20,
                fontSize: '0.74rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                border: `1px solid ${statusFilter === st ? brand.buttonBg : tokens.borderStrong}`,
                backgroundColor: statusFilter === st ? brand.buttonBg : tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                color: statusFilter === st ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textSecondary,
              }}
            >
              {st === 'PENDING' ? 'Pending Review' : st}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {!isRestrictedRole && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => handleOpenCreateModal('FACULTY')}>
              <FileText size={15} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} /> Request Official Travel Pass
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="md"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleOpenCreateModal('STUDENT')}
            >
              <Plus size={15} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} /> Issue Student Exit Pass
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <ModuleTableLayout
        title="Campus Exit Passes & Exit Clearances"
        subtitle="Adviser student permits and official faculty travel authorizations."
        searchPlaceholder="Search pass #, student, faculty, reason..."
        searchValue={search}
        onSearchChange={setSearch}
        loading={loading}
        error={error}
        data={passes}
        keyExtractor={(p) => p.id}
        columns={[
          {
            header: 'Pass Reference #',
            render: (p) => (
              <div>
                <strong style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', color: brand.primary }}>{p.pass_number}</strong>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>{p.bearer_type} CLEARANCE</div>
              </div>
            ),
          },
          {
            header: 'Authorized Bearer',
            render: (p) => (
              <div>
                <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary, fontSize: '0.86rem' }}>
                  {p.bearer_type === 'STUDENT' ? p.student_name : p.faculty_name}
                </strong>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                  {p.bearer_type === 'STUDENT' ? `LRN: ${p.student_lrn || '—'}` : `Emp ID: ${p.faculty_emp_id || '—'}`}
                </div>
              </div>
            ),
          },
          {
            header: 'Class Adviser / Issuer',
            render: (p) => (
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                <strong>{p.adviser_name || 'Staff User'}</strong>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.66rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Issuing Authority</div>
              </div>
            ),
          },
          {
            header: 'Reason & Proof File',
            render: (p) => (
              <div style={{ maxWidth: 220 }}>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{p.pass_type}</span>
                <p style={{ margin: '2px 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{p.reason}</p>
                {isSafeProofUrl(p.attachment_url) ? (
                  <a
                    href={p.attachment_url!}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, marginTop: 4 }}
                  >
                    <ExternalLink size={11} /> View Attached Proof
                  </a>
                ) : (
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>No file attached</span>
                )}
              </div>
            ),
          },
          {
            header: 'Status',
            render: (p) => {
              const colorMap: Record<string, string> = {
                PENDING: '#f59e0b',
                ACTIVE: '#10b981',
                USED: '#0284c7',
                DECLINED: '#ef4444',
                EXPIRED: '#64748b',
              };
              return (
                <span
                  style={{
                    padding: '3px 8px',
                    borderRadius: 10,
                    fontSize: '0.68rem',
                    fontWeight: 800,
                    backgroundColor: `${colorMap[p.status] || '#64748b'}20`,
                    color: colorMap[p.status] || '#64748b',
                  }}
                >
                  {p.status}
                </span>
              );
            },
          },
          {
            header: 'Actions',
            align: 'right',
            render: (p) => (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedPass(p)}
                  title="View Slip"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, borderRadius: 6, padding: '6px 8px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                >
                  <QrCode size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                </button>

                {isPrincipalOrAdmin && p.status === 'PENDING' && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setReviewingPass(p)}
                    style={{ backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg, color: '#ffffff', border: 'none', borderRadius: 6, padding: '6px 10px', fontSize: '0.72rem', fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                  >
                    Review Authenticity
                  </button>
                )}

                {!isRestrictedRole && p.status === 'ACTIVE' && (
                  <button

                    onClick={() => handleMarkUsed(p.id)}
                    title="Confirm Exit"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.successLight, border: `1px solid ${brand.success}`, borderRadius: 6, padding: '6px 8px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 size={14} color={brand.success} />
                  </button>
                )}

                {!isRestrictedRole && (isPrincipalOrAdmin || p.status !== 'USED') && (
                  <>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleOpenEditModal(p)}
                      title="Edit Exit Pass"
                      aria-label={`Edit pass ${p.pass_number}`}
                      style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, borderRadius: 6, padding: '6px 8px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                    >
                      <Edit2 size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleDeletePass(p)}
                      title="Delete Exit Pass"
                      aria-label={`Delete pass ${p.pass_number}`}
                      style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight, border: `1px solid ${brand.danger}`, borderRadius: 6, padding: '6px 8px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                    >
                      <Trash2 size={14} color={brand.danger} />
                    </button>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            ),
          },
        ]}
      />

      <Modal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsModalOpen(false);
          setEditingPass(null);
        }}
        title={
          editingPass
            ? `Edit Exit Pass #${editingPass.pass_number}`
            : passFormType === 'FACULTY'
              ? 'Request Official Travel Pass'
              : 'Issue Student Exit Permit'
        }
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmitPass} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          {passFormType === 'STUDENT' ? (
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Select Student Learner *</label>
              {loadingStudents ? (
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textMuted, padding: '8px 0' }}>Loading student list...</div>
              ) : (
                <select
                  required
                  value={formData.student_id}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, student_id: e.target.value })}
                  style={ui.input}
                >
                  <option value="">-- Choose Student --</option>
                  {students.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>

              </div>

              <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => setSelectedPass(null)}>

              <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => window.print()}>
                <Printer size={15} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} /> Print Slip
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
