  const [health, setHealth] = useState<MaintenanceHealthStatus>({
    database: 'ONLINE',
    dbLatencyMs: 0,
    scannersOnline: 0,
    scannersTotal: 0,
    pushPending: 0,
    pushFailed: 0,
    pushSentToday: 0,
    lastChecked: '',
  });

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    school_id: '',
    school_name: '',
    region: '',
    division: '',
    district: '',
    academic_year: '',
    address: '',
    contact_number: '',
    email: '',
    website: '',
    principal_faculty: '' as string | number,
    principal_name: '',
    principal_title: '',
    principal_photo_url: null as string | null,
    principal_employee_id: '',
    principal_department: '',
    principal_contact_number: '',
    principal_email: '',
    superintendent_name: '',
    school_logo: null as string | null,
    left_logo: null as string | null,
    right_logo: null as string | null,
    latitude: '',
    longitude: '',
    geofence_radius_meters: 150,
  });

  const [freshLogos, setFreshLogos] = useState({
    school_logo: false,
    left_logo: false,
    right_logo: false,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      initAbortRef.current?.abort();
      diagAbortRef.current?.abort();
      logsAbortRef.current?.abort();
      if (saveSuccessTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(saveSuccessTimerRef.current);
        saveSuccessTimerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const applySchoolPayload = useCallback((s: any) => {
    if (!s || typeof s !== 'object') return;
    setFormData({
      school_id: s.school_id || '',
      school_name: s.school_name || '',
      region: s.region || '',
      division: s.division || '',
      district: s.district || '',
      academic_year: s.academic_year || s.school_year || '',
      address: s.address || s.street_address || '',
      contact_number: s.contact_number || s.telephone || '',
      email: s.email || '',
      website: s.website || '',
      principal_faculty: s.principal_faculty ?? '',
      principal_name: s.principal_name || '',
      principal_title: s.principal_title || '',
      principal_photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(s.principal_photo_url) ? s.principal_photo_url : null,
      principal_employee_id: s.principal_employee_id || '',
      principal_department: s.principal_department || '',
      principal_contact_number: s.principal_contact_number || '',
      principal_email: s.principal_email || '',
      superintendent_name: s.superintendent_name || '',
      school_logo: isSafeImageUrl(s.school_logo) ? s.school_logo : null,
      left_logo: isSafeImageUrl(s.left_logo) ? s.left_logo : null,
      right_logo: isSafeImageUrl(s.right_logo) ? s.right_logo : null,
      latitude: s.latitude !== undefined && s.latitude !== null && s.latitude !== '' ? String(s.latitude) : '',
      longitude: s.longitude !== undefined && s.longitude !== null && s.longitude !== '' ? String(s.longitude) : '',
      geofence_radius_meters: s.geofence_radius_meters ? Number(s.geofence_radius_meters) : 150,
    });
  }, []);

  const fetchDiagnostics = useCallback(async () => {
    diagAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    diagAbortRef.current = controller;

    const [dbRes, sysRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
      apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.health.db, { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal }),
      apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.reports.systemStatus, { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal }),
    ]);

    if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

    const dbData = dbRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? dbRes.value.data : null;
    const sysData = sysRes.status === 'fulfilled' ? sysRes.value.data : null;

    setHealth({
      database: dbData?.database === 'CONNECTED' || dbData?.status === 'CONNECTED' ? 'ONLINE' : 'OFFLINE',
      dbLatencyMs: Number(dbData?.latency_ms) || 0,
      scannersOnline: Number(sysData?.online_count) || 0,
      scannersTotal: Number(sysData?.total_scanners) || 0,
      pushSentToday: Number(sysData?.sent_today ?? sysData?.push_delivered_today) || 0,
      pushPending: Number(sysData?.pending_queue) || 0,
      pushFailed: Number(sysData?.failed_today) || 0,
      lastChecked: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }),
    });
  }, []);

  const fetchUserActivities = useCallback(async () => {
    logsAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    logsAbortRef.current = controller;

    setLogsLoading(true);
    try {
      const params: Record<string, string | number> = { nocache: 1 };
      const cleanSearch = sanitizeInput(logSearch, 80);
      if (cleanSearch) params.search = cleanSearch;
      if (logActionFilter !== 'ALL') params.action = logActionFilter;
      if (logDateFilter) params.date = logDateFilter;

      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.auditLogs, {
        params,
        timeout: 8000,
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      if (res.data) {
        const rawList = res.data.records || res.data.results || (Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : []);
        setActivityLogs(rawList);
        setIsSuperAdmin(Boolean(res.data.is_admin));
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
        return;
      }
      setActivityLogs([]);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Activity Log Notice',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not load activity logs.'),
        type: 'warning',
      });
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setLogsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [logSearch, logActionFilter, logDateFilter, showAlert]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    initAbortRef.current = controller;

    const warmSchool = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.school.settings);
    if (warmSchool) {
      applySchoolPayload(warmSchool);
      setLoading(false);
    }

    const loadInitialData = async () => {
      if (!warmSchool) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const [schoolRes, facultyRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
          apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.settings, { timeout: 6000, signal: controller.signal }),
          apiClient
            .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.facultyDropdown, {
              params: { include_all: 'true' },
              timeout: 6000,
              signal: controller.signal,
            })
            .catch(() => apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.faculty, { timeout: 6000, signal: controller.signal })),
        ]);

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        if (schoolRes.status === 'fulfilled' && schoolRes.value.data) {
          applySchoolPayload(schoolRes.value.data);
        }

        if (facultyRes.status === 'fulfilled' && facultyRes.value.data) {
          const fList = Array.isArray(facultyRes.value.data)
            ? facultyRes.value.data
            : facultyRes.value.data?.results || [];
          setFacultyList(fList);
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    void loadInitialData();
    void fetchDiagnostics();

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [applySchoolPayload, fetchDiagnostics]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeSubTab === 'LOGS' || activeSubTab === 'ALL') {
      void fetchUserActivities();
    }
  }, [activeSubTab, fetchUserActivities]);

  const handleFacultyChange = (facultyIdStr: string) => {
    if (!facultyIdStr) {
      setFormData((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        principal_faculty: '',
        principal_name: '',
        principal_title: '',
        principal_photo_url: null,
        principal_employee_id: '',
        principal_department: '',
        principal_contact_number: '',
        principal_email: '',
      }));
      return;
    }

    const fid = Number(facultyIdStr);
    const chosen = facultyList.find((f) => f.id === fid);

    if (chosen) {
      setFormData((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        principal_faculty: fid,
        principal_name: chosen.full_name || `${chosen.first_name} ${chosen.last_name}`.trim(),
        principal_title: chosen.position || 'School Principal',
        principal_photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(chosen.photo_url) ? chosen.photo_url ?? null : null,
        principal_employee_id: chosen.employee_id || '',
        principal_department: chosen.department || 'Administration',
        principal_contact_number: chosen.contact_number || '',
        principal_email: chosen.email || '',
      }));
    }
  };

  const selectedFacultyObj = facultyList.find(
    (f) => String(f.id) === String(formData.principal_faculty)
  );

  const rawPrincipalPhoto = selectedFacultyObj?.photo_url || formData.principal_photo_url || null;
  const activePrincipalPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(rawPrincipalPhoto) ? rawPrincipalPhoto : null;
  const activePrincipalEmpId = selectedFacultyObj?.employee_id || formData.principal_employee_id || '';
  const activePrincipalDept = selectedFacultyObj?.department || formData.principal_department || 'Administration';
  const activePrincipalContact = selectedFacultyObj?.contact_number || formData.principal_contact_number || '';
  const activePrincipalEmail = selectedFacultyObj?.email || formData.principal_email || '';

  const handleLogoUpload = async (
    field: 'school_logo' | 'left_logo' | 'right_logo',
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (!['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Invalid Image Format',
        message: 'Only PNG, JPG, and WebP images are allowed.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_BYTES) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Image File Too Large',
        message: 'Please choose an image under 5 MB.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    const compressed = await compressImageToDataUrl(file, 360, 0.78);
    if (compressed && isSafeImageUrl(compressed)) {
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: compressed }));
      setFreshLogos((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: true }));
    }
  };

  const runMaintenanceAction = (
    actionKey: string,
    title: string,
    description: string,
    apiCall: () => Promise<any>
  ) => {
    showConfirm({
      title,
      message: `${description} Do you want to proceed?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Run Fix Now',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionLoading(actionKey);
        try {
          const res = await apiCall();
          showAlert({
            title: 'Task Finished Successfully',
            message: res?.data?.message || `${title} completed with zero errors.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
          void fetchDiagnostics();
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Action Notice',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Action could not be completed. Please try again.'),
            type: 'warning',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionLoading(null);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const exportActivityCSV = () => {
    if (activityLogs.length === 0) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Empty Export', message: 'No activity logs available to export.', type: 'warning' });
      return;
    }

    const headers = ['Timestamp', 'User Account', 'Action', 'Module', 'Details', 'IP Address', 'Status'];
    const rows = activityLogs.map((r) => [
      r.timestamp,
      r.user,
      r.action,
      r.module,
      r.details,
      r.ip_address,
      r.status,
    ]);

    exportToCsv(
      `AttendSure_User_Activities_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`,
      headers,
      rows
    );
  };

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveSuccess(false);

    const hasLat = String(formData.latitude).trim() !== '';
    const hasLng = String(formData.longitude).trim() !== '';
    const lat = hasLat ? Number(formData.latitude) : null;
    const lng = hasLng ? Number(formData.longitude) : null;
    const radius = Number(formData.geofence_radius_meters);

    if (lat !== null && (isNaN(lat) || lat < -90 || lat > 90)) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Latitude', message: 'Latitude must be between -90 and 90 degrees.', type: 'error' });
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    if (lng !== null && (isNaN(lng) || lng < -180 || lng > 180)) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Longitude', message: 'Longitude must be between -180 and 180 degrees.', type: 'error' });
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    if (isNaN(radius) || radius < 20 || radius > 5000) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Boundary Radius', message: 'Radius must be between 20 and 5000 meters.', type: 'error' });
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    const validFacultyId =
      formData.principal_faculty && !isNaN(Number(formData.principal_faculty))
        ? Number(formData.principal_faculty)
        : null;

    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      school_id: sanitizeInput(formData.school_id, 40),
      school_name: sanitizeInput(formData.school_name, 160),
      region: sanitizeInput(formData.region, 80),
      division: sanitizeInput(formData.division, 120),
      district: sanitizeInput(formData.district, 120),
      academic_year: sanitizeInput(formData.academic_year, 20),
      address: sanitizeInput(formData.address, 250),
      contact_number: sanitizeInput(formData.contact_number, 40),
      email: sanitizeInput(formData.email, 150),
      website: sanitizeInput(formData.website, 200),
      principal_faculty: validFacultyId,
      principal_name: sanitizeInput(formData.principal_name, 150),
      principal_title: sanitizeInput(formData.principal_title, 120),
      superintendent_name: sanitizeInput(formData.superintendent_name, 150),
      latitude: lat,
      longitude: lng,
      geofence_radius_meters: radius,
    };

    if (freshLogos.school_logo) payload.school_logo = formData.school_logo;
    if (freshLogos.left_logo) payload.left_logo = formData.left_logo;
    if (freshLogos.right_logo) payload.right_logo = formData.right_logo;

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put(API_ROUTES.school.settings, payload, { timeout: 15000 });
      updateSchoolInstantly(res.data || payload);
      if (isSafeImageUrl(res.data?.principal_photo_url)) {
        setFormData((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          principal_photo_url: res.data.principal_photo_url,
        }));
      }
      setFreshLogos({ school_logo: false, left_logo: false, right_logo: false });
      setSaveSuccess(true);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Settings Saved',
        message: 'School profile and campus boundary saved to the database.',
        type: 'success',
        autoCloseDuration: 2500,
      });
      if (saveSuccessTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(saveSuccessTimerRef.current);
      saveSuccessTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setSaveSuccess(false);
        saveSuccessTimerRef.current = null;
      }, 3000);
      await refreshSchool();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Save Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not save school settings. Please check your permissions and inputs.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const cardStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
    borderRadius: 14,

    color: tokens.textSecondary,
    marginBottom: 4,
  };

  const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    ...ui.input,
    borderRadius: 8,
    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
    fontSize: '0.82rem',
  };

  const previewBoxStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
    border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
    borderRadius: 12,
    padding: '16px',
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', height: '60vh' }}>
        <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={30} color={brand.primary} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      ref={scrollContainerRef}
      style={{
        width: '100%',
        height: '100%',
        overflowY: 'auto',
        overflowX: 'hidden',
        boxSizing: 'border-box',

        padding: 'clamp(14px, 2.5vw, 24px)',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          maxWidth: '1080px',

          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          gap: 16,
        }}
      >
        {/* Navigation Selector */}
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12 }}>
          <div>
            <h1 style={{ fontSize: '1.25rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, margin: 0 }}>
              School Settings &amp; Maintenance Center
            </h1>

              Manage school profiles, official report seals, self-service maintenance diagnostics, and activity logs.
            </p>

          <div
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
              padding: 3,
              borderRadius: 10,
              border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
              gap: 4,
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
            }}
          >
            {(
              [
                { key: 'MAINTENANCE', label: 'One-Click System Fixes', icon: <Wrench size={14} /> },
                { key: 'SETTINGS', label: 'School Profile & Settings', icon: <Building2 size={14} /> },
                { key: 'LOGS', label: 'User Activity Logs', icon: <History size={14} /> },
                { key: 'ALL', label: 'Show All', icon: <Layers size={14} /> },
              ] as const
            ).map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab.key}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveSubTab(tab.key)}
                style={{
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,
                  padding: '6px 14px',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  border: 'none',
                  backgroundColor: activeSubTab === tab.key ? tokens.bgSurface : 'transparent',
                  color: activeSubTab === tab.key ? brand.primary : tokens.textSecondary,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  fontSize: '0.78rem',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  boxShadow: activeSubTab === tab.key ? tokens.cardShadow : 'none',
                }}
              >
                {tab.icon}
                <span>{tab.label}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* SECTION 1: SELF-SERVICE MAINTENANCE CENTER */}
        {(activeSubTab === 'MAINTENANCE' || activeSubTab === 'ALL') && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
            <div style={{ ...cardStyle, borderLeft: `4px solid ${health.database === 'ONLINE' ? brand.success : brand.danger}` }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12 }}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
                    <span
                      style={{
                        width: 10,
                        height: 10,
                        borderRadius: '50%',
                        backgroundColor: health.database === 'ONLINE' ? brand.success : brand.danger,
                        boxShadow: `0 0 8px ${health.database === 'ONLINE' ? brand.success : brand.danger}`,
                      }}
                    />
                    <strong style={{ fontSize: '0.94rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                      {health.database === 'ONLINE' ? 'System Database is Healthy & Online' : 'Attention: Database Disconnected'}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, marginTop: 3, display: 'block' }}>
                    Response time: {health.dbLatencyMs}ms &bull; Last checked at {health.lastChecked || 'Just now'}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  size="sm"
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => void fetchDiagnostics()}
                  icon={<RefreshCw size={13} />}
                >
                  Check Status Now
                </Button>
              </div>

              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'grid',
                  gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 200px), 1fr))',
                  gap: 10,
                  marginTop: 14,
                  paddingTop: 12,
                  borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                }}
              >
                <div style={telemetryStatBox(tokens)}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.66rem', color: tokens.textMuted, fontWeight: 700 }}>DATABASE HEALTH</span>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '1.05rem', fontWeight: 800, color: health.database === 'ONLINE' ? brand.success : brand.danger }}>
                    {health.database === 'ONLINE' ? 'Active (Connected)' : 'Disconnected'}

                    {health.scannersOnline} of {health.scannersTotal} Online

                    {health.pushSentToday.toLocaleString()} Delivered

                    {health.pushFailed} Failed / {health.pushPending} Waiting

                    runMaintenanceAction(

                  [

                    { field: 'right_logo', label: '3. Right Seal (Division / School Seal)', alt: 'Right Seal', uploadText: 'Upload Seal', emptyText: 'No seal uploaded' },
                  ] as const
                ).map((item) => {
                  const val = formData[item.field];
                  const safeUrl = isSafeImageUrl(val) ? val : null;
                  return (
                    <div key={item.field} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
                      <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                        {item.label}
                      </span>

                          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                          border: `1px dashed ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                          borderRadius: 8,
                          display: 'flex',
                          alignItems: 'center',
                          justifyContent: 'center',
                          padding: 6,

                            padding: '5px 10px',

                            border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                            borderRadius: 6,
                            fontSize: '0.72rem',
                            fontWeight: 700,
                            color: brand.primary,
                            cursor: 'pointer',
                            display: 'inline-flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 5,
                          }}
                        >

                          <input
                            type="file"
                            accept="image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp"
                            onChange={(e) => void handleLogoUpload(item.field, e)}
                            style={{ display: 'none' }}
                          />
                        </label>
                        {safeUrl && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, [item.field]: null }));
                              setFreshLogos((p) => ({ ...p, [item.field]: true }));
                            }}
                            style={{
                              padding: '5px 10px',
                              backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
                              border: `1px solid ${brand.danger}`,
                              borderRadius: 6,
                              fontSize: '0.72rem',
                              fontWeight: 700,
                              color: brand.danger,
                              cursor: 'pointer',
                              display: 'inline-flex',
                              alignItems: 'center',
                              gap: 5,
                            }}
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={12} /> Remove
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Save Button Bar */}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, marginTop: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {saveSuccess && (
                <span style={{ color: brand.success, fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 700, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
                  <CheckCircle2 size={15} /> Configuration saved successfully.
                </span>
              )}
              <Button
                variant="primary"
                size="md"
                type="submit"
                disabled={saving}
                icon={saving ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={15} /> : <Save size={15} />}
              >
                Save School Configuration
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

  activeReportId?: string;

const sanitizeSearchText = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);

const parseGuardianFields = (name?: string, rel?: string) => {
  const roles = ['MOTHER', 'FATHER', 'AUNT', 'UNCLE', 'GRANDMOTHER', 'GRANDFATHER', 'GUARDIAN'];
  const cleanName = String(name || '').trim();
  const cleanRel = String(rel || '').trim();

  if (roles.includes(cleanName.toUpperCase()) && !roles.includes(cleanRel.toUpperCase())) {
    return { gName: cleanRel, gRel: cleanName };
  }
  return {
    gName: cleanName,
    gRel: cleanRel.toLowerCase() === 'mather' ? 'Mother' : cleanRel,
  };
};

const splitAddressParts = (st: SF1LearnerRow) => {
  const street = st.house_street_sitio || st.house_street || '';
  const brgy = st.barangay || '';
  const city = st.municipality_city || '';
  const prov = st.province || '';

  if (street || brgy || city || prov) {
    return { street, brgy, city, prov };
  }

  const parts = String(st.address || '')
    .split(',')
    .map((p) => p.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

  return {
    street: parts[0] || '',
    brgy: parts[1] || '',
    city: parts[2] || '',
    prov: parts[3] || '',
  };
};

export const SF1ReportTab: React.FC<SF1ReportTabProps> = ({

    ? cachedSectionsPayload
    : cachedSectionsPayload?.results || [];

  const [sections, setSections] = useState<SectionOption[]>(initialSections);
  const [selectedSectionId, setSelectedSectionId] = useState<string>(
    sectionId ? String(sectionId) : initialSections[0] ? String(initialSections[0].id) : ''
  );

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [groupingMode, setGroupingMode] = useState<'COMBINED' | 'SEPARATED'>('COMBINED');

  const [reportData, setReportData] = useState<SF1ReportResponse | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isExportingPdf, setIsExportingPdf] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [auditMeta, setAuditMeta] = useState(() => buildAuditStamp('SF1'));

  const { widthIn: pageWidthInches, heightIn: pageHeightInches } = useMemo(
    () => resolvePaperDimensionsInches(pageConfig),

    const next = buildAuditStamp('SF1', reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
    setAuditMeta(next);

    }

  useEffect(() => {

    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.school.sections, {
        params: { page_size: 250 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const list: SectionOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.results || [];
        setSections(list);
        if (list.length > 0) {
          setSelectedSectionId((prev) => prev || String(list[0].id));
        } else {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load class sections.'));
        setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const fetchSF1 = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      if (!selectedSectionId) return;

      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const endpoint = `${API_ROUTES.reports.sf1}${encodeURIComponent(selectedSectionId)}/`;
      const warmHit = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<SF1ReportResponse>(endpoint) : undefined;

      if (warmHit) {
        setReportData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {

      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<SF1ReportResponse>(endpoint, {
          params: bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : undefined,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const payload = res.data;
        setReportData(payload);
        const stamp = buildAuditStamp('SF1', payload?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
        setAuditMeta(stamp);
        void logOfficialReportAudit({
          reportName: 'SF1',
          trackingId: stamp.trackingId,
          printedAt: stamp.printedAt,
          action: 'VIEW',
          sectionId: selectedSectionId,
        });
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load DepEd SF1 School Register.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [selectedSectionId, globalSchool.school_id]

  useEffect(() => {

  }, [fetchSF1]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforePrint = () => {
      refreshAuditMeta();
      setIsPrinting(true);
    };
    const handleAfterPrint = () => {
      setIsPrinting(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
    window.addEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
      window.removeEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    };
  }, [refreshAuditMeta]);

  const cleanSearch = useMemo(() => sanitizeSearchText(searchQuery).toLowerCase(), [searchQuery]);

  const { maleLearners, femaleLearners, combinedLearners } = useMemo(() => {

    const rawFemales = Array.isArray(reportData.females)
      ? reportData.females
      : rawAll.filter((s) => !String(s.sex || '').toUpperCase().startsWith('M'));

    const match = (s: SF1LearnerRow) =>
      !cleanSearch ||
      String(s.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) ||
      String(s.lrn || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch);

    const sortedAll = [...rawAll].filter(match).sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || ''));
    const sortedM = [...rawMales].filter(match).sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || ''));
    const sortedF = [...rawFemales].filter(match).sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || ''));

    return {
      maleLearners: sortedM,
      femaleLearners: sortedF,
      combinedLearners: sortedAll,

  const activeLearnerList = useMemo(

    });
    await exportElementToExcel(reportRef.current, getBaseFilename(), meta, usePicker);
  };

  const handleExportWord = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData || !reportRef.current) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF1',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'WORD',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });
    await exportElementToWord(reportRef.current, getBaseFilename(), meta, usePicker);
  };

  const handleExportJson = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF1',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'JSON',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });
    await exportReportJson(getBaseFilename(), meta, reportData, usePicker);
  };

  const renderLearnerRow = (st: SF1LearnerRow, rowNum: number) => {
    const addr = splitAddressParts(st);
    const { gName, gRel } = parseGuardianFields(st.guardian_name, st.guardian_relationship || st.guardian_rel);
    return (
      <tr key={`${st.id || st.lrn}-${rowNum}`}>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{rowNum}</td>
        <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700 }}>{st.lrn}</td>
        <td style={{ ...tdLeft, fontWeight: 700 }}>{st.name}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.sex}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.birthdate}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.age}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.mother_tongue}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.ethnic_group}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.religion}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{addr.street}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{addr.brgy}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{addr.city}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{addr.prov}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{st.father_name}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{st.mother_maiden_name}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{gName}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{gRel}</td>
        <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>{st.parent_contact}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.remarks}</td>
      </tr>
    );
  };

  const schoolName = reportData?.school_name || globalSchool.school_name || '';
  const schoolId = reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id || '';
  const schoolHead = reportData?.school_head || globalSchool.principal_name || '';

  return (
    <div
      className="report-tab-root"
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        width: '100%',
        height: '100%',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgApp,
      }}
    >
      <div className="no-print">
        <ReportHeaderBar
          activeReportId={activeReportId}
          onSelectReport={onSelectReport}
          documentTitle={
            reportData
              ? `SF1_Register_${reportData.section_name}_${reportData.academic_year}`
              : 'DepEd_SF1_School_Register'
          }
          subtitle="Official DepEd School Form 1 (SF1) School Register"
          isSavingPdf={isExportingPdf}
          onOpenPageSetup={() => setIsPageSetupOpen(true)}
          onPrint={handleDirectPrint}
          onSavePdf={() => void handleExportPdf(false)}
          onSavePdfAs={() => void handleExportPdf(true)}
          onDownloadExcel={() => void handleExportExcel(false)}
          onSaveExcelAs={() => void handleExportExcel(true)}
          onDownloadCsv={() => void handleExportCsv(false)}
          onSaveCsvAs={() => void handleExportCsv(true)}
          onDownloadWord={() => void handleExportWord(false)}
          onSaveWordAs={() => void handleExportWord(true)}
          onDownloadJson={() => void handleExportJson(false)}
          onSaveJsonAs={() => void handleExportJson(true)}
        />
      </div>

      <ReportViewerShell
        loading={loading}
        loadingMessage="Generating Official DepEd SF1 School Register..."
        error={error}
        hasData={Boolean(reportData)}
        isPrinting={isPrinting}
        isExportingPdf={isExportingPdf}
        pageWidthInches={pageWidthInches}
        pageHeightInches={pageHeightInches}
        pageConfig={pageConfig}
        sheetClassName="sf1-sheet-page"
        documentId="sf1-official-document"
        reportRef={reportRef}
        leftToolbarContent={
          <>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <BookOpen size={15} color={brand.primary} />
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>Section:</span>
              <select
                aria-label="Select Class Section"
                value={selectedSectionId}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedSectionId(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  padding: '5px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                }}
              >
                {sections.map((s) => (
                  <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                    {s.grade_level_name ? `${s.grade_level_name} - ` : ''}
                    {s.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,
                  padding: '4px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput,
                }}
              >
                <Search size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  maxLength={80}
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search name or LRN..."
                  style={{
                    border: 'none',
                    outline: 'none',
                    background: 'transparent',
                    color: tokens.textPrimary,
                    fontSize: '0.78rem',
                    width: 155,
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                padding: 2,
                borderRadius: 6,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
              }}
            >
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setGroupingMode('COMBINED')}
                style={{
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 5,
                  padding: '4px 9px',
                  borderRadius: 5,
                  border: 'none',
                  fontSize: '0.72rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  backgroundColor: groupingMode === 'COMBINED' ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent',
                  color: groupingMode === 'COMBINED' ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textSecondary,
                }}
              >
                <Users size={12} /> One List
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setGroupingMode('SEPARATED')}
                style={{
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 5,
                  padding: '4px 9px',
                  borderRadius: 5,
                  border: 'none',
                  fontSize: '0.72rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  backgroundColor: groupingMode === 'SEPARATED' ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent',
                  color: groupingMode === 'SEPARATED' ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textSecondary,
                }}
              >
                <Split size={12} /> By Sex
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void fetchSF1(true, true)}
              disabled={loading || refreshing}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '5px 10px',
                borderRadius: 6,
                fontSize: '0.76rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
              }}
            >
              <RefreshCw size={13} className={refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
              <span>Refresh</span>
            </button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {reportData &&
          paginatedLearners.map((pageRows, pageIdx) => {
            const isFirstPage = pageIdx === 0;
            const isLastPage = pageIdx === paginatedLearners.length - 1;
            const totalSheetCount = paginatedLearners.length;
            const startIdx = paginatedLearners.slice(0, pageIdx).reduce((sum, rows) => sum + rows.length, 0);

            const pageMales = pageRows.filter((s) => String(s.sex || '').toUpperCase().startsWith('M'));
            const pageFemales = pageRows.filter((s) => !String(s.sex || '').toUpperCase().startsWith('M'));

            return (
              <div
                key={pageIdx}
                className="sf1-sheet-page"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: pageConfig.pageColor || '#ffffff',
                  color: '#000000',
                  width: isPrinting ? '100%' : `${pageWidthInches}in`,
                  minHeight: pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless' ? 'auto' : `${pageHeightInches}in`,
                  paddingTop: `${pageConfig.margins.top}in`,
                  paddingRight: `${pageConfig.margins.right}in`,
                  paddingBottom: `${pageConfig.margins.bottom}in`,
                  paddingLeft: `${pageConfig.margins.left}in`,
                  marginBottom: isPrinting || isLastPage ? 0 : '20px',
                  boxShadow: isPrinting ? 'none' : '0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22)',
                  border: isPrinting ? 'none' : '1px solid #cbd5e1',
                  boxSizing: 'border-box',
                  fontFamily: 'Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif',
                  display: 'flex',
                  flexDirection: 'column',
                  justifyContent: 'space-between',
                }}
              >
                <div>
                  {isFirstPage ? (
                    <DepEdReportHeader
                      formTitle="School Form 1 (SF 1) School Register"
                      formSubtitle="(This replaces Form 1, Master List & STS Form 2-Family Background and Profile)"
                      formType="SF1"
                      reportData={reportData}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div
                      style={{
                        display: 'flex',
                        justifyContent: 'space-between',
                        alignItems: 'center',
                        borderBottom: '1.5px solid #000',
                        paddingBottom: 4,
                        marginBottom: 6,
                        fontSize: '7.5pt',
                        fontWeight: 700,
                      }}
                    >
                      <span>
                        School Form 1 (SF1) School Register — {schoolName} ({schoolId})
                      </span>
                      <span>
                        {reportData.grade_level} - {reportData.section_name} | SY {reportData.academic_year} (Page {pageIdx + 1} of {totalSheetCount})
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <table style={sf1MainTable}>
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ ...thCell, width: '2.2%' }}>#</th>
                        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ ...thCell, width: '7.0%' }}>LRN</th>
                        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ ...thCell, width: '12.5%' }}>
                          NAME<br />
                          <span style={subThText}>(Last Name, First Name, Middle Name)</span>
                        </th>
                        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ ...thCell, width: '2.4%' }}>
                          Sex<br />
                          <span style={subThText}>(M/F)</span>
                        </th>
                        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ ...thCell, width: '5.2%' }}>
                          BIRTH DATE<br />
                          <span style={subThText}>(mm/dd/yyyy)</span>
                        </th>
                        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ ...thCell, width: '2.6%' }}>
                          AGE as of<br />1st Friday<br />June
                        </th>
                        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ ...thCell, width: '4.8%' }}>MOTHER<br />TONGUE</th>
                        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ ...thCell, width: '4.6%' }}>
                          IP<br />
                          <span style={subThText}>(Ethnic Group)</span>
                        </th>
                        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ ...thCell, width: '4.6%' }}>RELIGION</th>
                        <th colSpan={4} style={thCell}>ADDRESS</th>
                        <th colSpan={2} style={thCell}>PARENTS</th>
                        <th colSpan={2} style={thCell}>
                          GUARDIAN <span style={subThText}>(If not Parent)</span>
                        </th>
                        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ ...thCell, width: '6.0%' }}>
                          Contact Number<br />of Parent or<br />Guardian
                        </th>
                        <th rowSpan={2} style={{ ...thCell, width: '5.4%' }}>
                          REMARKS<br />
                          <span style={subThText}>(Refer to legend)</span>
                        </th>
                      </tr>
                      <tr>
                        <th style={{ ...thCell, width: '6.5%' }}>House #/ Street/<br />Sitio/ Purok</th>
                        <th style={{ ...thCell, width: '5.5%' }}>Barangay</th>
                        <th style={{ ...thCell, width: '5.8%' }}>Municipality/<br />City</th>
                        <th style={{ ...thCell, width: '5.2%' }}>Province</th>
                        <th style={{ ...thCell, width: '6.3%' }}>Father&apos;s Name</th>
                        <th style={{ ...thCell, width: '6.3%' }}>Mother&apos;s Maiden Name</th>
                        <th style={{ ...thCell, width: '4.0%' }}>Name</th>
                        <th style={{ ...thCell, width: '3.5%' }}>Relation-<br />ship</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>

                    <tbody>
                      {pageRows.length === 0 ? (
                        <tr>
                          <td colSpan={19} style={{ ...tdCenter, padding: '16px', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
                            No learners enrolled in Section {reportData.section_name} yet.
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ) : groupingMode === 'COMBINED' ? (
                        pageRows.map((st, idx) => renderLearnerRow(st, startIdx + idx + 1))
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          {pageMales.length > 0 && (
                            <>
                              <tr style={{ backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9', fontWeight: 800 }}>
                                <td colSpan={19} style={{ ...tdLeft, color: '#0284c7', paddingLeft: 6 }}>
                                  MALE ({maleCount})
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                              {pageMales.map((st) => {
                                const mIdx = maleLearners.findIndex((m) => m.id === st.id || m.lrn === st.lrn);
                                return renderLearnerRow(st, mIdx >= 0 ? mIdx + 1 : 1);
                              })}
                            </>
                          )}
                          {pageFemales.length > 0 && (
                            <>
                              <tr style={{ backgroundColor: '#fdf2f8', fontWeight: 800 }}>
                                <td colSpan={19} style={{ ...tdLeft, color: '#db2777', paddingLeft: 6 }}>
                                  FEMALE ({femaleCount})
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                              {pageFemales.map((st) => {
                                const fIdx = femaleLearners.findIndex((f) => f.id === st.id || f.lrn === st.lrn);
                                return renderLearnerRow(st, fIdx >= 0 ? fIdx + 1 : 1);
                              })}
                            </>
                          )}
                        </>
                      )}

                      {isLastPage && activeLearnerList.length > 0 && (
                        <>
                          <tr style={{ backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', fontWeight: 800 }}>
                            <td colSpan={3} style={{ ...tdLeft, paddingLeft: 8 }}>TOTAL MALE</td>
                            <td style={tdCenter}>{maleCount}</td>
                            <td colSpan={15} style={tdLeft} />
                          </tr>
                          <tr style={{ backgroundColor: '#f8fafc', fontWeight: 800 }}>
                            <td colSpan={3} style={{ ...tdLeft, paddingLeft: 8 }}>TOTAL FEMALE</td>
                            <td style={tdCenter}>{femaleCount}</td>
                            <td colSpan={15} style={tdLeft} />
                          </tr>
                          <tr style={{ backgroundColor: '#e2e8f0', fontWeight: 900 }}>
                            <td colSpan={3} style={{ ...tdLeft, paddingLeft: 8 }}>COMBINED TOTAL</td>
                            <td style={tdCenter}>{totalCount}</td>
                            <td colSpan={15} style={tdLeft} />
                          </tr>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>

                  {isLastPage && (
                    <>
                      <div
                        style={{
                          display: 'grid',
                          gridTemplateColumns: '48% 22% 28%',
                          gap: '1%',
                          marginTop: 8,
                          alignItems: 'start',
                        }}
                      >
                        <table style={legendTable}>
                          <thead>
                            <tr>
                              <th colSpan={6} style={{ ...legendTh, textAlign: 'center', fontWeight: 800 }}>
                                List and Code of Indicators under REMARKS column
                              </th>
                            </tr>
                            <tr>
                              <th style={legendTh}>Indicator</th>
                              <th style={legendTh}>Code</th>
                              <th style={legendTh}>Required Information</th>
                              <th style={legendTh}>Indicator</th>
                              <th style={legendTh}>Code</th>
                              <th style={legendTh}>Required Information</th>
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                            <tr>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Transferred Out</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}>T/O</td>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Public (P) / Private (PR) School &amp; Date</td>
                              <td style={legendTd}>CCT Recipient</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}>CCT</td>
                              <td style={legendTd}>CCT Control # &amp; Effectivity Date</td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Transferred In</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}>T/I</td>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Public (P) / Private (PR) School &amp; Date</td>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Balik-Aral</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}>B/A</td>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Name of school last attended &amp; Year</td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Dropped</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}>DRP</td>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Reason and Effectivity Date</td>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Learner w/ Disability</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}>LWD</td>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Specify condition</td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Late Enrollment</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}>LE</td>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Reason (beyond 1st Friday of June)</td>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Accelerated</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}>ACL</td>
                              <td style={legendTd}>Specify Level &amp; Effectivity Date</td>
                            </tr>
                          </tbody>
                        </table>

                        <table style={legendTable}>
                          <thead>
                            <tr>
                              <th style={legendTh}>REGISTERED</th>
                              <th style={legendTh}>BoSY</th>
                              <th style={legendTh}>EoSY</th>
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                            <tr>
                              <td style={{ ...legendTd, fontWeight: 700 }}>MALE</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}>{maleCount}</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}></td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr>
                              <td style={{ ...legendTd, fontWeight: 700 }}>FEMALE</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}>{femaleCount}</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}></td>
                            </tr>
                            <tr style={{ fontWeight: 900, backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9' }}>
                              <td style={legendTd}>TOTAL</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}>{totalCount}</td>
                              <td style={legendTdCenter}></td>
                            </tr>
                          </tbody>
                        </table>

                        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10, fontSize: '6.2pt' }}>
                          <div>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 14 }}>Prepared by:</div>
                            <div style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #000', textAlign: 'center', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase', paddingBottom: 1, minHeight: 13 }}>
                              {reportData.adviser_name}
                            </div>
                            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', fontSize: '5.5pt', marginTop: 2 }}>
                              (Signature of Adviser over Printed Name)
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          <div>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 14 }}>Certified Correct:</div>
                            <div style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #000', textAlign: 'center', fontWeight: 800, textTransform: 'uppercase', paddingBottom: 1, minHeight: 13 }}>
                              {schoolHead}
                            </div>
                            <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', fontSize: '5.5pt', marginTop: 2 }}>
                              (Signature of School Head over Printed Name)
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <DepEdReportFooter
                        sealUrl={globalSchool.school_logo}
                        address={reportData.school_address || globalSchool.address}
                        contactNumber={reportData.school_contact || globalSchool.contact_number}
                        email={reportData.school_email || globalSchool.email}
                        reportData={reportData}
                      />
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div
                  style={{
                    marginTop: 6,
                    paddingTop: 3,
                    borderTop: '0.8px dashed #000000',
                    display: 'flex',
                    justifyContent: 'space-between',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    fontSize: '5.6pt',
                    color: '#000000',
                  }}
                >
                  <span>
                    School Form 1 (SF1) — Page {pageIdx + 1} of {totalSheetCount}
                  </span>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    PRINTED: {auditMeta.printedAt} &nbsp;|&nbsp; TRACKING ID: {auditMeta.trackingId}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
      </ReportViewerShell>

      <PageSetupModal
        isOpen={isPageSetupOpen}
        currentConfig={pageConfig}
        onLiveChange={setPageConfig}
        onApply={(cfg) => setPageConfig(cfg)}
        onClose={() => setIsPageSetupOpen(false)}
        reportTitle="SF1 School Register"
      />
    </div>
  );
};

const sf1MainTable: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: '100%',
  borderCollapse: 'collapse',
  tableLayout: 'fixed',
  border: '1.2px solid #000000',
};

const thCell: React.CSSProperties = {
  border: '1px solid #000000',
  padding: '2px 1.5px',
  fontSize: '5.6pt',
  fontWeight: 800,
  textAlign: 'center',
  verticalAlign: 'middle',
  backgroundColor: '#f1f5f9',
  lineHeight: 1.08,
  wordBreak: 'break-word',
};

const subThText: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontSize: '4.7pt',
  fontWeight: 400,
};

const tdLeft: React.CSSProperties = {
  border: '1px solid #000000',
  padding: '1.5px 2.5px',
  fontSize: '5.8pt',
  textAlign: 'left',
  verticalAlign: 'middle',
  lineHeight: 1.12,

const PRESENT_STATUSES = new Set(['present', 'late', 'tardy', 'cutting', 'excused']);

const SVG_DIAGONAL_ONLY =
  'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="0" y1="16" x2="24" y2="0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.6"/></svg>'
  );

const SVG_ABSENT =
  'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="0" y1="16" x2="24" y2="0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.6"/><line x1="4" y1="2" x2="20" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="20" y1="2" x2="4" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>'
  );

const SVG_TARDY =
  'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" preserveAspectRatio="none"><polygon points="0,0 24,0 0,16" fill="#000000"/><line x1="0" y1="16" x2="24" y2="0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.75"/></svg>'
  );

  'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' +
  encodeURIComponent(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" preserveAspectRatio="none"><polygon points="24,0 24,16 0,16" fill="#000000"/><line x1="0" y1="16" x2="24" y2="0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.75"/></svg>'
  );

const AttendanceCell: React.FC<{ status?: string | number | null; isSchoolDay?: boolean }> = ({
  status,
  isSchoolDay = true,
}) => {
  if (!isSchoolDay) {
    return <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '16px', backgroundColor: '#ffffff' }} />;
  }

  const s = String(status ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
  let src = SVG_DIAGONAL_ONLY;
  let alt = 'Present';

  if (s === 'absent' || s === 'x' || s === '1' || s === 'a') {
    src = SVG_ABSENT;
    alt = 'Absent (X)';
  } else if (s === 'tardy' || s === 'late' || s === '2' || s === 't') {
    src = SVG_TARDY;
    alt = 'Late';
  } else if (s === 'cutting' || s === 'cc' || s === '3' || s === 'c') {
    src = SVG_CUTTING;
    alt = 'Cutting Classes';
  }

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: '100%',
        height: '16px',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
      }}
    >
      <img
        src={src}
        alt={alt}
        style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'block', objectFit: 'fill' }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

const sanitizeSearchText = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);

export const SF2ReportTab: React.FC<SF2ReportTabProps> = ({
  sectionId,
  activeReportId = 'sf2',
  onSelectReport,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { school: globalSchool } = useSchool();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const now = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);
  const yearOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const y = now.getFullYear();
    return [y - 1, y, y + 1];
  }, [now]);

  const cachedSectionsPayload = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.school.sections, { page_size: 250 });
  const initialSections: SectionOption[] = Array.isArray(cachedSectionsPayload)
    ? cachedSectionsPayload
    : cachedSectionsPayload?.results || [];

  const [sections, setSections] = useState<SectionOption[]>(initialSections);
  const [selectedSectionId, setSelectedSectionId] = useState<string>(
    sectionId ? String(sectionId) : initialSections[0] ? String(initialSections[0].id) : ''
  );
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<string>(
    () => MONTH_NAMES[now.getMonth()] || 'October'
  );
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<number>(now.getFullYear());
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');

  const [reportData, setReportData] = useState<SF2ReportData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isExportingPdf, setIsExportingPdf] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [auditMeta, setAuditMeta] = useState(() => buildAuditStamp('SF2'));
  const [pageConfig, setPageConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(DEFAULT_DEPED_LANDSCAPE_SETUP);
  const [isPageSetupOpen, setIsPageSetupOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const reportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const { widthIn: pageWidthInches, heightIn: pageHeightInches } = useMemo(
    () => resolvePaperDimensionsInches(pageConfig),
    [pageConfig]
  );

  const refreshAuditMeta = useCallback(() => {
    const next = buildAuditStamp('SF2', reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
    setAuditMeta(next);
    return next;
  }, [reportData?.school_id, globalSchool.school_id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sectionId) {
      setSelectedSectionId(String(sectionId));
    }
  }, [sectionId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.school.sections, {
        params: { page_size: 250 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const list: SectionOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.results || [];
        setSections(list);
        if (list.length > 0) {
          setSelectedSectionId((prev) => prev || String(list[0].id));
        } else {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load class sections.'));
        setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const fetchSF2 = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      if (!selectedSectionId) return;

      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const endpoint = `${API_ROUTES.reports.sf2}${encodeURIComponent(selectedSectionId)}/`;
      const baseParams = { month: selectedMonth, year: selectedYear };
      const warmHit = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<SF2ReportData>(endpoint, baseParams) : undefined;

      if (warmHit) {
        setReportData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<SF2ReportData>(endpoint, {
          params: bypassCache ? { ...baseParams, nocache: 1 } : baseParams,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setReportData(res.data);
        const stamp = buildAuditStamp('SF2', res.data?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
        setAuditMeta(stamp);
        void logOfficialReportAudit({
          reportName: 'SF2',
          trackingId: stamp.trackingId,
          printedAt: stamp.printedAt,
          action: 'VIEW',
          sectionId: selectedSectionId,
        });
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not generate DepEd SF2 Daily Attendance Report.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [selectedSectionId, selectedMonth, selectedYear, globalSchool.school_id]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchSF2(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchSF2]);

  useEffect(() => {

    const handleAfterPrint = () => {
      setIsPrinting(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
    window.addEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    return () => {

    };
  }, [refreshAuditMeta]);

  const cleanSearch = useMemo(() => sanitizeSearchText(searchQuery).toLowerCase(), [searchQuery]);

  const males = useMemo(() => {

  const females = useMemo(() => {

    const combinedCount: number[] = new Array(maxCols).fill(0);

    if (!reportData?.school_days) {
      return { males: malesCount, females: femalesCount, combined: combinedCount };
    }

    reportData.school_days.forEach((day, idx) => {
      if (idx >= maxCols) return;
      let mPresent = 0;

      males.forEach((m) => {

        if (PRESENT_STATUSES.has(st)) mPresent++;
      });

      females.forEach((f) => {
        const st = String(f.attendance?.[day.dateNumber] ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (PRESENT_STATUSES.has(st)) fPresent++;
      });

      malesCount[idx] = mPresent;
      femalesCount[idx] = fPresent;
      combinedCount[idx] = mPresent + fPresent;
    });

    return { males: malesCount, females: femalesCount, combined: combinedCount };
  }, [reportData, males, females]);

                        <td colSpan={30} style={{ ...tdLeft, paddingLeft: 6 }}>FEMALE</td>
                      </tr>
                      {females.map((f, idx) => (
                        <tr key={`f-p2-${f.id}`}>
                          <td style={tdCenter}>{idx + 1}</td>
                          <td style={{ ...tdLeft, fontWeight: 700 }}>{f.name}</td>
                          {Array.from({ length: 25 }).map((_, i) => {
                            const day = schoolDays[i];
                            const st = day ? f.attendance?.[day.dateNumber] : undefined;
                            return (
                              <td key={`fp2-${f.id}-d-${i}`} style={tdDateCell}>
                                <AttendanceCell status={st} isSchoolDay={Boolean(day)} />
                              </td>
                            );
                          })}
                          <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontWeight: 700 }}>{f.total_absent || ''}</td>
                          <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontWeight: 700 }}>{f.total_tardy || ''}</td>
                          <td style={tdLeft}>{f.remarks || ''}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                      <tr style={subtotalRowStyle}>
                        <td colSpan={2} style={{ ...tdLeft, fontWeight: 800 }}>&larr; FEMALE | TOTAL Per Day &rarr;</td>
                        {Array.from({ length: 25 }).map((_, i) => (
                          <td key={`fp2-tot-${i}`} style={{ ...tdCenter, fontWeight: 800 }}>
                            {schoolDays[i] ? dailyAttendanceTotals.females[i] : ''}
                          </td>
                        ))}
                        <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontWeight: 800 }}>{females.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.total_absent || 0), 0)}</td>
                        <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontWeight: 800 }}>{females.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.total_tardy || 0), 0)}</td>
                        <td style={tdCenter} />
                      </tr>

                      <tr style={{ ...subtotalRowStyle, backgroundColor: '#e2e8f0' }}>
                        <td colSpan={2} style={{ ...tdLeft, fontWeight: 900 }}>Combined TOTAL PER DAY</td>
                        {Array.from({ length: 25 }).map((_, i) => (
                          <td key={`cp2-tot-${i}`} style={{ ...tdCenter, fontWeight: 900 }}>
                            {schoolDays[i] ? dailyAttendanceTotals.combined[i] : ''}
                          </td>
                        ))}
                        <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontWeight: 900 }}>
                          {males.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.total_absent || 0), 0) +
                            females.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.total_absent || 0), 0)}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontWeight: 900 }}>
                          {males.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.total_tardy || 0), 0) +
                            females.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.total_tardy || 0), 0)}
                        </td>
                        <td style={tdCenter} />
                      </tr>
                    </tbody>
                  </table>

                  {renderSummaryFooter()}
                </div>

                <div style={auditFooterStyle}>
                  <span>School Form 2 (SF2) — Page 2 of 2</span>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700 }}>
                    PRINTED: {auditMeta.printedAt} &nbsp;|&nbsp; TRACKING ID: {auditMeta.trackingId}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          ))}
      </ReportViewerShell>

      <PageSetupModal
        isOpen={isPageSetupOpen}
        currentConfig={pageConfig}
        onLiveChange={setPageConfig}
        onApply={(cfg) => setPageConfig(cfg)}
        onClose={() => setIsPageSetupOpen(false)}
        reportTitle="SF2 Daily Attendance"
      />
    </div>
  );
};

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'January',
  'February',
  'March',
  'April',
  'May',
  'June',
  'July',
  'August',
  'September',
