const INITIAL_FORM = {
  username: '',
  employee_id: '',
  first_name: '',
  middle_name: '',
  last_name: '',
  suffix: '',
  email: '',
  contact_number: '',
  department: 'Junior High School',
  position: 'Faculty I',
  role: 'FACULTY',
  is_teaching: true,
  is_active: true,
  password: '',
  photo: null as string | null,
};

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 150): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const extractUsers = (raw: unknown): SystemUser[] => {
  if (Array.isArray(raw)) return raw as SystemUser[];
  if (raw && typeof raw === 'object' && Array.isArray((raw as { results?: SystemUser[] }).results)) {
    return (raw as { results: SystemUser[] }).results;
  }
  return [];
};

export const UsersTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const currentLoggedUsername = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') || '').trim().toLowerCase();

  const cachedUsers = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.accounts.users, { page_size: 'ALL' });

  const [users, setUsers] = useState<SystemUser[]>(() => extractUsers(cachedUsers));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !cachedUsers);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState<string>('');
  const [teachingFilter, setTeachingFilter] = useState<string>('');

  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [editingUser, setEditingUser] = useState<SystemUser | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState(INITIAL_FORM);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const activeAbortController = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const validateAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const copyTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const [liveErrors, setLiveErrors] = useState<{
    username?: string;
    email?: string;
    password?: string;
  }>({});
  const [isCheckingUsername, setIsCheckingUsername] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      activeAbortController.current?.abort();
      validateAbortRef.current?.abort();
      if (copyTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
        copyTimerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // Real-time client validation
  useEffect(() => {
    const newErrors: { username?: string; email?: string; password?: string } = {};

    if (formData.username) {
      if (/\s/.test(formData.username)) {
        newErrors.username = 'Username cannot contain spaces.';
      } else if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$/.test(formData.username)) {
        newErrors.username = 'Use only letters, numbers, dots, dashes, or underscores.';
      } else if (formData.username.length < 3) {
        newErrors.username = 'Username must be at least 3 characters.';
      }
    }

    if (formData.email.trim() && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(formData.email.trim())) {
      newErrors.email = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
    }

    if (formData.password) {
      if (formData.password.length < 8) {
        newErrors.password = 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.';
      } else if (!/[A-Za-z]/.test(formData.password) || !/[0-9]/.test(formData.password)) {
        newErrors.password = 'Password must include both letters and numbers.';
      }
    }

    setLiveErrors((prev) => ({
      ...newErrors,
      username: newErrors.username || (prev.username?.includes('already') ? prev.username : undefined),
    }));
  }, [formData.username, formData.email, formData.password]);

  // Real-time server uniqueness check for username with AbortController cleanup
  useEffect(() => {
    const cleanUser = sanitizeInput(formData.username, 64);
    if (!isModalOpen || cleanUser.length < 3 || /\s/.test(cleanUser)) {
      validateAbortRef.current?.abort();
      setIsCheckingUsername(false);
      return;
    }

    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      validateAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      validateAbortRef.current = controller;

      try {
        setIsCheckingUsername(true);
        const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.validateField, {
          params: {
            field: 'username',
            value: cleanUser,
            exclude_id: editingUser?.id,
            nocache: 1,
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

        if (res.data?.is_taken) {
          setLiveErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, username: res.data.message || 'Username already taken.' }));
        } else {
          setLiveErrors((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            username: prev.username?.includes('already') ? undefined : prev.username,
          }));
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore transient network errors or aborts during typing
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setIsCheckingUsername(false);
        }
      }
    }, 400);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      validateAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [formData.username, editingUser, isModalOpen]);

  const hasLiveErrors = Boolean(liveErrors.username || liveErrors.email || liveErrors.password);

  const handleCopy = async (text: string, id: string) => {
    if (!text) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setCopiedKey(id);
      if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
      copyTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setCopiedKey((prev) => (prev === id ? null : prev));
        copyTimerRef.current = null;
      }, 2000);
    } catch {
      // Ignore clipboard failure
    }
  };

  const fetchUsers = useCallback(async (query = '', silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
    activeAbortController.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    activeAbortController.current = controller;

    const cleanQuery = sanitizeInput(query, 80);
    const baseParams: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = {
      search: cleanQuery || undefined,
      page_size: 'ALL',
    };

    if (!bypassCache) {
      const warm = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.accounts.users, baseParams);
      if (warm !== undefined) {
        setUsers(extractUsers(warm));
        setLoading(false);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      }
    } else if (!silent) {
      setLoading(true);
    }
    setError(null);

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.users, {
        params: {
          ...baseParams,
          ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
        },
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      setUsers(extractUsers(res.data));
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
        return;
      }
      if (!silent) {
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Unable to load user accounts. Administrator permissions required.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted && !silent) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      void fetchUsers(search, false, false);
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [search, fetchUsers]);

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Unsupported Image',
        message: 'Only JPG, PNG, and WebP images are allowed.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'File Too Large',
        message: 'Profile picture must be 2.5 MB or smaller.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      const b64 = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      if (!isSafeImageUrl(b64)) {
        showAlert({
          title: 'Invalid Image',
          message: 'Selected file could not be verified as a safe image.',
          type: 'error',
        });
        return;
      }
      setPhotoPreview(b64);
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: b64 }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingUser(null);
    setFormData(INITIAL_FORM);
    setLiveErrors({});
    setPhotoPreview(null);
    setShowPassword(false);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (user: SystemUser) => {
    const rawRole = (user.current_role || user.role || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
    const isTeach =
      rawRole === 'PARENT'
        ? false
        : user.is_teaching !== undefined
          ? Boolean(user.is_teaching)
          : user.can_teach !== undefined
            ? Boolean(user.can_teach)
            : true;

    const effectiveRole = rawRole === 'ADMIN' && isTeach ? 'FACULTY_ADMIN' : rawRole;
    const safeRole = RBAC_ROLES.some((r) => r.value === effectiveRole) ? effectiveRole : 'FACULTY';
    const phoneVal = user.phone_number || user.contact_number || '';
    const existingPic = user.photo_url || user.photo || null;

    setEditingUser(user);
    setLiveErrors({});
    setFormData({
      username: user.username || '',
      employee_id: user.employee_id || user.username || '',
      first_name: user.first_name || '',
      middle_name: user.middle_name || '',
      last_name: user.last_name || '',
      suffix: user.suffix || '',
      email: user.email || '',
      contact_number: phoneVal,
      department: user.department || (safeRole === 'PARENT' ? 'Parent / Guardian' : 'Junior High School'),
      position: user.position || (safeRole === 'PARENT' ? 'Parent / Guardian' : 'Faculty I'),
      role: safeRole,
      is_teaching: isTeach,
      is_active: user.is_active ?? true,
      password: '',
      photo: null,
    });
    setPhotoPreview(isSafeImageUrl(existingPic) ? existingPic : null);
    setShowPassword(false);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (hasLiveErrors) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Form Notice',
        message: liveErrors.username || liveErrors.email || liveErrors.password || 'Please fix the highlighted errors.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    const cleanUsername = sanitizeInput(formData.username, 64).replace(/\s+/g, '');
    if (!cleanUsername) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Username Required',
        message: 'Username cannot be blank or contain spaces.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!editingUser && formData.password.trim().length < 8) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Password Required',
        message: 'Initial password must be at least 8 characters long.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    const isParentRole = formData.role === 'PARENT';
    const cleanPhone = sanitizeInput(formData.contact_number, 20);

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
        username: cleanUsername,
        employee_id: (sanitizeInput(formData.employee_id, 40) || cleanUsername).toUpperCase(),
        first_name: sanitizeInput(formData.first_name, 100),
        middle_name: sanitizeInput(formData.middle_name, 100),
        last_name: sanitizeInput(formData.last_name, 100),
        suffix: sanitizeInput(formData.suffix, 20),
        email: sanitizeInput(formData.email, 150).toLowerCase(),
        contact_number: cleanPhone,
        phone_number: cleanPhone,
        department: isParentRole ? 'Parent / Guardian' : sanitizeInput(formData.department, 100),
        position: isParentRole ? 'Parent / Guardian' : sanitizeInput(formData.position, 100),
        role: formData.role,
        is_teaching: isParentRole ? false : formData.is_teaching,
        is_active: formData.is_active,
      };

      if (formData.password.trim()) {
        payload.password = formData.password.trim().slice(0, 128);
      }

      if (formData.photo !== null) {
        if (formData.photo === '') {
          payload.photo = null;
        } else if (isSafeImageUrl(formData.photo)) {
          payload.photo = formData.photo;
        }
      }

      if (editingUser) {
        await apiClient.put(`${API_ROUTES.accounts.users}${editingUser.id}/`, payload);
        showAlert({
          title: 'Account Saved',
          message: `Saved updates for @${cleanUsername}. Role and permissions are now synced.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.accounts.users, payload);
        showAlert({
          title: 'Account Registered',
          message: `@${cleanUsername} is registered. ${
            payload.is_teaching
              ? 'This faculty member now appears in the Faculty tab.'
              : 'Account is active for mobile or web portal login.'
          }`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      }

      setIsModalOpen(false);
      await fetchUsers(search, true, true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Save Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to save user account.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const promptDelete = (user: SystemUser) => {
    if (user.username.trim().toLowerCase() === currentLoggedUsername) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Action Denied',
        message: 'You cannot delete your own active administrator account.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete User Account',
      message: `Permanently delete account "@${user.username}"? Associated faculty and class list assignments will be unlinked.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete Account',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${API_ROUTES.accounts.users}${user.id}/`);
          setUsers((prev) => prev.filter((u) => u.id !== user.id));
          showAlert({
            title: 'Account Removed',
            message: `User @${user.username} was deleted.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Delete Error',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Unable to delete user account.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const filteredUsers = useMemo(() => {
    const q = sanitizeInput(search, 80).toLowerCase();
    return users.filter((u) => {
      const name = `${u.first_name || ''} ${u.last_name || ''}`.toLowerCase();
      const phone = (u.phone_number || u.contact_number || '').toLowerCase();
      const matchesSearch =
        !q ||
        (u.username || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (u.email || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (u.employee_id || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        phone.includes(q) ||
        name.includes(q);

      const matchesRole = !roleFilter || (u.current_role || u.role || '').toUpperCase() === roleFilter;

      let matchesTeaching = true;
      if (teachingFilter === 'CAN_TEACH') {
        matchesTeaching = Boolean(u.is_teaching ?? u.can_teach);
      } else if (teachingFilter === 'CANT_TEACH') {
        matchesTeaching = !Boolean(u.is_teaching ?? u.can_teach);
      }

      return matchesSearch && matchesRole && matchesTeaching;
    });
  }, [users, search, roleFilter, teachingFilter]);

  const { activeCount, canTeachCount, cantTeachCount } = useMemo(() => {
    let active = 0;
    let teach = 0;
    for (const u of users) {
      if (u.is_active) active += 1;
      if (u.is_teaching ?? u.can_teach) teach += 1;
    }
    return {
      activeCount: active,
      canTeachCount: teach,
      cantTeachCount: users.length - teach,
    };
  }, [users]);

  const errorTextStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    fontSize: '0.70rem',
    color: brand.danger,
    fontWeight: 600,
    marginTop: 3,
    display: 'block',
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2.5vw, 20px)' }}>
      {/* 1. System Account Summary */}
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 210px), 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
        <StatsCard
          label="TOTAL REGISTERED USERS"
          value={users.length}
          helpText="Faculty, leaders & parent accounts"
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="CAN TEACH (IN FACULTY TAB)"
          value={canTeachCount}
          valueColor={brand.primary}
          helpText="Visible in Faculty tab & class schedules"
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="NON-TEACHING & PARENTS"
          value={cantTeachCount}
          valueColor={tokens.textSecondary}
          helpText="Parents & non-teaching accounts"
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="ACTIVE ACCOUNTS"
          value={activeCount}
          valueColor={brand.success}
          helpText="Authorized for mobile & web login"
        />
      </div>

      {/* 2. Control Bar with Filters & Add Button */}
      <div
        style={{
          ...ui.card,
          padding: '10px 14px',
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 10,
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <select
            aria-label="Filter by role"
            value={roleFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setRoleFilter(e.target.value)}
            style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', minWidth: 170 }}
          >
            <option value="">All Roles</option>
            {RBAC_ROLES.map((r) => (
              <option key={r.value} value={r.value}>
                {r.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          <select
            aria-label="Filter by teaching status"
            value={teachingFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setTeachingFilter(e.target.value)}
            style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', minWidth: 180 }}
          >
            <option value="">All Status</option>
            <option value="CAN_TEACH">Can Teach (In Faculty Tab)</option>
            <option value="CANT_TEACH">Non-Teaching / Parent</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <Button
          variant="primary"
          size="md"
          type="button"
          onClick={handleOpenCreate}
          icon={<Plus size={15} />}
        >
          Register User / Faculty
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Main Users Table */}
      <div
        style={{
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderRadius: 12,
          border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
      >

/**
 * AttendSure - Resilient Modal Dialog
 * File: web/src/components/ui/AlertDialog.tsx
 *
 * Cybersecurity & Stability Hardening:
 * 1. Safe Child Parsing: Safely converts objects, errors, and arrays to text to prevent React rendering crashes.
 * 2. Focus & Escape Handling: Automatically focuses primary action and supports Escape dismissal.
 * 3. Quick Workflow (Auto-Close): Automatically dismisses non-critical success alerts after 3.5 seconds.
 * 4. Overflow Protection: Adds scroll constraints so long error messages never clip action buttons.
 */

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Info,
  XCircle,
  X,
  ArrowRight,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

export type AlertType = 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

export interface AlertDialogProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  title?: string;
  message: string | unknown;
  type?: AlertType;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  autoClose?: boolean; // Defaults to true for success, false for error/warning
  autoCloseDuration?: number; // Milliseconds (default: 3500ms)
  onAction?: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

/**
 * Defensive Sanitizer: Ensures message is always rendered as a safe, readable string.
 */
const sanitizeMessage = (msg: unknown): string => {
  if (msg === null || msg === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof msg === 'string') {
    const trimmed = msg.trim();
    if (trimmed.startsWith('<!DOCTYPE') || trimmed.startsWith('<html') || trimmed.includes('Traceback (most recent call last)')) {
      return 'Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.';
    }
    return trimmed;
  }
  if (typeof msg === 'number' || typeof msg === 'boolean') return String(msg);
  return extractApiError(msg, 'An unexpected notice was received. Please try again.');
};

export const AlertDialog: React.FC<AlertDialogProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  title,
  message,
  type = 'info',
  confirmLabel = 'Understood',
  actionLabel,
  autoClose,
  autoCloseDuration = 3500,
  onAction,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const confirmBtnRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const autoCloseTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
    if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
      autoCloseTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    onClose();
  }, [onClose]);

  // Handle Escape key and auto-focus for accessibility
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    const focusTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      confirmBtnRef.current?.focus();
    }, 50);

    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleClose();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);

    const shouldAutoClose = autoClose ?? (type === 'success' && !actionLabel);
    if (shouldAutoClose) {
      autoCloseTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        handleClose();
      }, autoCloseDuration);
    }

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(focusTimeout);
      if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
      }
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen, type, actionLabel, autoClose, autoCloseDuration, handleClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const config = {
    info: {
      icon: Info,
      color: brand.primary,
      buttonBg: brand.buttonBg,
      bgColor: brand.primarySoft,
      borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
      defaultTitle: 'Notice',
    },
    success: {
      icon: CheckCircle2,
      color: tokens.success,
      buttonBg: '#059669',
      bgColor: tokens.successBg,
      borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
      defaultTitle: 'Saved Successfully',
    },
    warning: {
      icon: AlertTriangle,
      color: tokens.warning,
      buttonBg: '#d97706',
      bgColor: tokens.warningBg,
      borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
      defaultTitle: 'Action Needed',
    },
    error: {
      icon: XCircle,
      color: tokens.danger,
      buttonBg: '#dc2626',
      bgColor: tokens.dangerBg,
      borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
      defaultTitle: 'Notice',
    },
  }[type];

  const IconComponent = config.icon;
  const safeMessage = sanitizeMessage(message);

  return (
    <div
      style={overlayStyle}
      onClick={handleClose}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="alert-dialog-title"
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          maxWidth: 420,
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderRadius: 12,
          boxShadow: '0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14)',
          border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Top Accent Color Line */}
        <div style={{ height: 4, backgroundColor: config.color, width: '100%' }} />

        <div style={{ padding: '20px 22px 18px 22px' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 14 }}>
            {/* Status Icon */}
            <div
              style={{
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                backgroundColor: config.bgColor,
                border: `1px solid ${config.borderColor}`,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                flexShrink: 0,
              }}
            >
              <IconComponent size={22} color={config.color} />
            </div>

            {/* Content Text */}
            <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, paddingTop: 1 }}>
              <div
                id="alert-dialog-title"
                style={{
                  fontSize: '0.96rem',
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  marginBottom: 6,
                }}
              >
                {title || config.defaultTitle}
              </div>
              <div
                style={{
                  fontSize: '0.82rem',
                  color: tokens.textSecondary,
                  lineHeight: 1.5,
                  maxHeight: '40vh',
                  overflowY: 'auto',
                  wordBreak: 'break-word',
                  paddingRight: 4,
                }}
              >
                {safeMessage}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Top Close Button */}

import React from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'dark' | 'ghost';
  size?: 'sm' | 'md';
  loading?: boolean;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}

export const Button: React.FC<ButtonProps> = ({
  children,
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  loading = false,
  icon,
  disabled,
  style,
  ...props
}) => {
  const { mode, tokens, brand, radius } = useTheme();

  const getVariantStyles = (): React.CSSProperties => {
    switch (variant) {
      case 'primary':
        return {
          backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg,
          color: '#ffffff',
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: brand.buttonBg,
          boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0, 75, 135, 0.22)',
        };
      case 'secondary':
        return {
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
          color: tokens.textPrimary,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: tokens.borderStrong,
        };
      case 'danger':
        return {
          backgroundColor: mode === 'dark' ? '#dc2626' : brand.danger,
          color: '#ffffff',
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: mode === 'dark' ? '#ef4444' : brand.danger,
        };
      case 'dark':
        return {
          backgroundColor: '#1e293b',
          color: '#ffffff',
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: '#334155',
        };
      case 'ghost':
        return {
          backgroundColor: 'transparent',
          color: tokens.textPrimary,
          borderWidth: 1,
          borderStyle: 'solid',
          borderColor: 'transparent',
        };
    }
  };

  const sizeStyles: React.CSSProperties =
    size === 'sm'
      ? { padding: '5px 10px', fontSize: '0.78rem' }
      : { padding: '8px 14px', fontSize: '0.86rem' };

  return (
    <button
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      style={{
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        gap: 7,
        fontWeight: 700,
        borderRadius: radius.md,
        cursor: disabled || loading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer',
        opacity: disabled ? 0.6 : 1,
        transition: 'background-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, opacity 0.15s ease',
        ...sizeStyles,
        ...getVariantStyles(),
        ...style,
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      {loading ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={16} /> : icon}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

export interface SwitchOption<T extends string> {
  value: T;
  label?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  badge?: number | string;
  title?: string;
}

interface ControlSwitchProps<T extends string> {
  options: ReadonlyArray<SwitchOption<T>>;
  value: T;
  onChange: (next: T) => void;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md';
  compactIconsOnly?: boolean;
  ariaLabel?: string;
}

export function ControlSwitch<T extends string>({
  options,
  value,
  onChange,
  size = 'md',
  compactIconsOnly = false,
  ariaLabel = 'View Switcher',
}: ControlSwitchProps<T>) {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts } = useTheme();

  return (
    <div
      role="tablist"
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      style={{
        display: 'inline-flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 2,
        padding: 3,
        borderRadius: compactIconsOnly ? 9999 : 10,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderStyle: 'solid',
        borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
        flexShrink: 0,
      }}
    >
      {options.map((opt) => {
        const active = opt.value === value;
        return (
          <button
            key={opt.value}
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            aria-selected={active}
            title={opt.title || opt.label || opt.value}
            onClick={() => onChange(opt.value)}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              gap: 5,
              padding: compactIconsOnly ? 0 : size === 'sm' ? '4px 10px' : '6px 12px',
              width: compactIconsOnly ? 28 : undefined,
              height: compactIconsOnly ? 28 : undefined,
              borderRadius: compactIconsOnly ? '50%' : 7,
              borderWidth: 0,
              borderStyle: 'none',
              backgroundColor: active ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent',
              color: active ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textSecondary,
              boxShadow: active ? '0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)' : 'none',
              fontFamily: fonts.sans,
              fontSize: size === 'sm' ? fonts.size.xs : fonts.size.sm,
              fontWeight: active ? 800 : 600,
              cursor: 'pointer',
              transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
              whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            }}
          >
            {opt.icon}
            {!compactIconsOnly && opt.label && <span>{opt.label}</span>}
            {opt.badge !== undefined && opt.badge !== '' && Number(opt.badge) > 0 && (
              <span
                style={{
                  padding: '1px 6px',
                  borderRadius: 9999,
                  fontSize: '0.62rem',
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  backgroundColor: active ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)' : tokens.primaryLight,
                  color: active ? '#ffffff' : brand.primary,
                }}
              >
                {opt.badge}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

          borderRadius: 9999,

/**

import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

interface ModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  maxWidth?: string;
}

export const Modal: React.FC<ModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  title,
  children,
  maxWidth = '540px',
}) => {
  const { tokens, fonts, radius } = useTheme();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label={title}
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.58)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(3px)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        zIndex: 9999,
        padding: 16,
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
      }}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          maxWidth,
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          color: tokens.textPrimary,
          borderRadius: radius.lg,
          border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
          overflow: 'hidden',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          maxHeight: '90vh',
          fontFamily: fonts.sans,
        }}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div
          style={{
            padding: '14px 20px',
            borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
            gap: 12,
          }}
        >
          <h3
            style={{
              margin: 0,
              fontSize: fonts.size.md,
              fontWeight: fonts.weight.extrabold,
              color: tokens.textPrimary,
            }}
          >
            {title}
          </h3>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close dialog"
            style={{
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              color: tokens.textMuted,

/**
 * AttendSure - Global Alert & Confirmation System (Referentially Stable)
 * File: web/src/context/AlertContext.tsx
 */

import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  useCallback,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle, Info, X, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { extractApiError } from '../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from './ThemeContext';

export type AlertType = 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';

export interface AlertOptions {
  title: string;
  message: string | unknown;
  type?: AlertType;
  actionLabel?: string;
  autoCloseDuration?: number;
  onAction?: () => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
}

export interface ConfirmOptions {
  title: string;
  message: string | unknown;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  isDestructive?: boolean;
  onConfirm: () => Promise<void> | void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
}

interface AlertContextType {
  showAlert: (options: AlertOptions) => void;
  showConfirm: (options: ConfirmOptions) => void;
  closeAlert: () => void;
  closeConfirm: () => void;
}

const AlertContext = createContext<AlertContextType | undefined>(undefined);

const toSafeString = (val: unknown): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof val === 'string') {
    const trimmed = val.trim();
    if (trimmed.startsWith('<!DOCTYPE') || trimmed.startsWith('<html') || trimmed.includes('Traceback (most recent call last)')) {
      return 'Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.';
    }
    return trimmed;
  }
  if (typeof val === 'number' || typeof val === 'boolean') return String(val);
  return extractApiError(val, 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.');
};

export const AlertProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [alertData, setAlertData] = useState<AlertOptions | null>(null);
  const [confirmData, setConfirmData] = useState<ConfirmOptions | null>(null);
  const [isConfirmLoading, setIsConfirmLoading] = useState(false);

  const alertDataRef = useRef<AlertOptions | null>(null);
  const confirmDataRef = useRef<ConfirmOptions | null>(null);
  const confirmLoadingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const autoCloseTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  alertDataRef.current = alertData;
  confirmDataRef.current = confirmData;
  confirmLoadingRef.current = isConfirmLoading;

  const closeAlert = useCallback(() => {
    if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
      autoCloseTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    const current = alertDataRef.current;
    alertDataRef.current = null;
    setAlertData(null);
    current?.onClose?.();
  }, []);

  const closeConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    if (confirmLoadingRef.current) return;
    const current = confirmDataRef.current;
    confirmDataRef.current = null;
    setConfirmData(null);
    current?.onCancel?.();
  }, []);

  const showAlert = useCallback(
    (options: AlertOptions) => {
      if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
        autoCloseTimerRef.current = null;
      }

      const normalized: AlertOptions = {
        ...options,
        title: toSafeString(options.title) || 'Notification',
        message: toSafeString(options.message),
      };
      alertDataRef.current = normalized;
      setAlertData(normalized);

      if (options.type === 'success' && !options.actionLabel) {
        const duration = options.autoCloseDuration ?? 3500;
        autoCloseTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          closeAlert();
        }, duration);
      }
    },
    [closeAlert]
  );

  const showConfirm = useCallback((options: ConfirmOptions) => {
    const normalized: ConfirmOptions = {
      ...options,
      title: toSafeString(options.title) || 'Confirm Action',
      message: toSafeString(options.message),
    };
    confirmDataRef.current = normalized;
    setConfirmData(normalized);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (autoCloseTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(autoCloseTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (confirmDataRef.current && !confirmLoadingRef.current) {
          closeConfirm();
        } else if (alertDataRef.current) {
          closeAlert();
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [closeAlert, closeConfirm]);

  const handleConfirmAction = async () => {
    const activeConfirm = confirmDataRef.current;
    if (!activeConfirm || confirmLoadingRef.current) return;
    try {
      setIsConfirmLoading(true);
      confirmLoadingRef.current = true;
      await activeConfirm.onConfirm();
      confirmDataRef.current = null;
      setConfirmData(null);
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Action Error',
        message: err,
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      confirmLoadingRef.current = false;
      setIsConfirmLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAlertAction = () => {
    alertDataRef.current?.onAction?.();
    closeAlert();
  };

  const getAlertIcon = (type: AlertType) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'success':
        return <CheckCircle2 size={24} color={tokens.success} />;
      case 'error':
        return <XCircle size={24} color={tokens.danger} />;
      case 'warning':
        return <AlertTriangle size={24} color={tokens.warning} />;
      case 'info':
      default:
        return <Info size={24} color={brand.primary} />;
    }
  };

  const getAlertColorTheme = (type: AlertType) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'success':
        return { bg: tokens.successBg, border: tokens.borderSubtle };
      case 'error':
        return { bg: tokens.dangerBg, border: tokens.borderSubtle };
      case 'warning':
        return { bg: tokens.warningBg, border: tokens.borderSubtle };
      case 'info':
      default:
        return { bg: brand.primarySoft, border: tokens.borderSubtle };
    }
  };

  const modalBoxStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    width: '100%',
    maxWidth: 420,
    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
    borderRadius: 12,
    padding: 18,
    boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)',
    border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
  };

  const primaryBtnStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg,
    color: '#ffffff',
    border: 'none',
    borderRadius: 6,
    padding: '7px 16px',
    fontSize: '0.80rem',
    fontWeight: 700,
    cursor: 'pointer',
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  };

  const secondaryBtnStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
    color: tokens.textPrimary,
    border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderInput}`,
    borderRadius: 6,
    padding: '7px 14px',
    fontSize: '0.80rem',
    fontWeight: 600,
    cursor: 'pointer',
  };

  const contextValue = useMemo(
    () => ({ showAlert, showConfirm, closeAlert, closeConfirm }),
    [showAlert, showConfirm, closeAlert, closeConfirm]
  );

  return (
    <AlertContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      {children}

      {alertData && (
        <div style={overlayStyle} role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
          <div style={modalBoxStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  ...iconContainerStyle,
                  backgroundColor: getAlertColorTheme(alertData.type || 'info').bg,
                  border: `1px solid ${getAlertColorTheme(alertData.type || 'info').border}`,
                }}
              >
                {getAlertIcon(alertData.type || 'info')}
              </div>

              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.96rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {alertData.title}
                </h3>
                <p
                  style={{
                    margin: '6px 0 0 0',
                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                    color: tokens.textSecondary,
                    lineHeight: 1.45,
                    wordBreak: 'break-word',
                  }}
                >
                  {String(alertData.message)}
                </p>
              </div>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={closeAlert}
                style={closeBtnStyle}
                title="Close"
                aria-label="Close alert"
              >
                <X size={16} color={tokens.textMuted} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 16 }}>
              {alertData.actionLabel ? (
                <>
                  <button type="button" onClick={closeAlert} style={secondaryBtnStyle}>
                    Dismiss
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={handleAlertAction} style={primaryBtnStyle}>
                    {alertData.actionLabel}
                  </button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <button type="button" onClick={closeAlert} style={primaryBtnStyle}>
                  Okay
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {confirmData && (
        <div style={overlayStyle} role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
          <div style={modalBoxStyle}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  ...iconContainerStyle,

                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                }}
              >
                {confirmData.isDestructive ? (
                  <AlertTriangle size={24} color={tokens.danger} />
                ) : (
                  <Info size={24} color={brand.primary} />
                )}
              </div>

              <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.96rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  {confirmData.title}
                </h3>
                <p
                  style={{
                    margin: '6px 0 0 0',
                    fontSize: '0.82rem',
                    color: tokens.textSecondary,
                    lineHeight: 1.45,
                    wordBreak: 'break-word',
                  }}
                >

                </p>
              </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 18 }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isConfirmLoading}
                onClick={closeConfirm}
                style={secondaryBtnStyle}
              >
                {confirmData.cancelLabel || 'Cancel'}
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={isConfirmLoading}
                onClick={handleConfirmAction}
                style={{
                  ...primaryBtnStyle,
                  backgroundColor: confirmData.isDestructive ? '#dc2626' : brand.buttonBg,
                }}
              >
                {isConfirmLoading ? (
                  <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} />
                ) : null}
                {confirmData.confirmLabel || 'Confirm'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </AlertContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAlert = () => {
  const context = useContext(AlertContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAlert must be used within an AlertProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

interface ComplianceContextValue {
  complianceMode: ComplianceMode;
  setComplianceMode: (mode: ComplianceMode) => void;
  toggleComplianceMode: () => void;
  isGlobalMode: boolean;
  locale: SupportedLocale;
  setLocale: (lang: SupportedLocale) => void;
  t: (key: string, fallback?: string) => string;
  term: (globalLabel: string, depedLabel: string) => string;
}

const ComplianceContext = createContext<ComplianceContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

export const ComplianceProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [complianceMode, setComplianceModeState] = useState<ComplianceMode>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_compliance_mode');
    return saved === 'DEPED_PH' || saved === 'GLOBAL' ? saved : 'GLOBAL';
  });

  const [locale, setLocaleState] = useState<SupportedLocale>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_locale') as SupportedLocale | null;
    return saved && saved in TRANSLATIONS ? saved : 'en';
  });

  const setComplianceMode = useCallback((mode: ComplianceMode) => {
    setComplianceModeState(mode);
    localStorage.setItem('attendsure_compliance_mode', mode);
  }, []);

  const toggleComplianceMode = useCallback(() => {
    setComplianceModeState((prev) => {
      const next: ComplianceMode = prev === 'GLOBAL' ? 'DEPED_PH' : 'GLOBAL';
      localStorage.setItem('attendsure_compliance_mode', next);
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const setLocale = useCallback((lang: SupportedLocale) => {
    setLocaleState(lang);
    localStorage.setItem('attendsure_locale', lang);
  }, []);

  const t = useCallback(
    (key: string, fallback?: string): string => {
      return TRANSLATIONS[locale]?.[key] || TRANSLATIONS.en[key] || fallback || key;
    },
    [locale]
  );

  const term = useCallback(
    (globalLabel: string, depedLabel: string): string => {
      return complianceMode === 'GLOBAL' ? globalLabel : depedLabel;
    },
    [complianceMode]
  );

  const value = useMemo<ComplianceContextValue>(
    () => ({
      complianceMode,
      setComplianceMode,
      toggleComplianceMode,
      isGlobalMode: complianceMode === 'GLOBAL',
      locale,
      setLocale,
      t,
      term,
    }),
    [complianceMode, setComplianceMode, toggleComplianceMode, locale, setLocale, t, term]
  );

  return <ComplianceContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ComplianceContext.Provider>;
};

export const useCompliance = (): ComplianceContextValue => {
  const ctx = useContext(ComplianceContext);
  if (!ctx) {
    throw new Error('useCompliance must be used within a ComplianceProvider');
  }
  return ctx;
};

export default ComplianceContext;

/**
 * AttendSure - Global School Settings & Branding Context
 * File: web/src/context/SchoolContext.tsx
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache } from '../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES } from '../api/routes';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../theme/tokens';

export interface SchoolData {
  school_id: string;
  deped_school_id?: string;
  school_name: string;
  short_name: string;
  region: string;
  division: string;
  district: string;
  address: string;
  contact_number: string;
  email: string;
  principal_name: string;
  principal_title: string;
  academic_year: string;
  latitude: number | null;
  longitude: number | null;
  geofence_radius_meters: number | null;
  geofence_radius?: number | null;
  radius_meters?: number | null;
  school_logo: string | null;
  left_logo: string | null;
  right_logo: string | null;
  is_configured: boolean;
}

export interface SchoolContextValue {
  school: SchoolData;
  loading: boolean;
  refreshSchool: () => Promise<void>;
  updateSchoolInstantly: (partial: Record<string, unknown> | Partial<SchoolData>) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'attendsure_school_branding_v2';

const EMPTY_SCHOOL: SchoolData = {
  school_id: '',
  deped_school_id: '',
  school_name: '',
  short_name: '',
  region: '',
  division: '',
  district: '',
  address: '',
  contact_number: '',
  email: '',
  principal_name: '',
  principal_title: '',
  academic_year: '',
  latitude: null,
  longitude: null,
  geofence_radius_meters: null,
  geofence_radius: null,
  radius_meters: null,
  school_logo: null,
  left_logo: null,
  right_logo: null,
  is_configured: false,
};

const sanitizeText = (val: unknown, maxLen = 180): string =>
  String(val ?? '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLen);

const pickNonEmpty = (primary: unknown, fallback: string, maxLen = 180): string => {
  const cleaned = sanitizeText(primary, maxLen);
  return cleaned || fallback;
};

const safeLogo = (val: unknown): string | null => {
  const str = typeof val === 'string' ? val.trim() : '';
  return str && isSafeImageUrl(str) ? str : null;
};

const normalizeSchoolPayload = (
  raw: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
  prev: SchoolData
): SchoolData => {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return prev;

  const resolvedId = pickNonEmpty(
    raw.school_id || raw.deped_school_id || raw.code,
    prev.school_id,
    40
  );
  const resolvedName = pickNonEmpty(raw.school_name || raw.name, prev.school_name, 180);
  const resolvedShort = pickNonEmpty(raw.short_name, prev.short_name, 40);
  const resolvedRegion = pickNonEmpty(raw.region, prev.region, 100);
  const resolvedDivision = pickNonEmpty(raw.division, prev.division, 120);
  const resolvedDistrict = pickNonEmpty(raw.district, prev.district, 120);
  const resolvedAddress = pickNonEmpty(raw.address || raw.school_address, prev.address, 240);
  const resolvedContact = pickNonEmpty(
    raw.contact_number || raw.school_contact,
    prev.contact_number,
    60
  );
  const resolvedEmail = pickNonEmpty(raw.email || raw.school_email, prev.email, 120);
  const resolvedPrincipal = pickNonEmpty(
    raw.principal_name || raw.school_head,
    prev.principal_name,
    140
  );
  const resolvedPrincipalTitle = pickNonEmpty(
    raw.principal_title || raw.school_head_title,
    prev.principal_title,
    100
  );
  const resolvedAcademicYear = pickNonEmpty(
    raw.academic_year || raw.active_school_year || raw.school_year,
    prev.academic_year,
    30
  );

  const parsedLat =
    raw.latitude !== undefined && raw.latitude !== null && raw.latitude !== ''
      ? Number(raw.latitude)
      : prev.latitude;
  const parsedLng =
    raw.longitude !== undefined && raw.longitude !== null && raw.longitude !== ''
      ? Number(raw.longitude)
      : prev.longitude;

  const rawRad = raw.geofence_radius_meters ?? raw.geofence_radius ?? raw.radius_meters;
  const parsedRad =
    rawRad !== undefined && rawRad !== null && rawRad !== ''
      ? Number(rawRad)
      : prev.geofence_radius_meters;
  const cleanRad = typeof parsedRad === 'number' && Number.isFinite(parsedRad) ? parsedRad : null;

  const schoolLogo =
    raw.school_logo !== undefined || raw.school_logo_url !== undefined
      ? safeLogo(raw.school_logo_url ?? raw.school_logo)
      : prev.school_logo;

  const leftLogo =
    raw.left_logo !== undefined || raw.left_logo_url !== undefined
      ? safeLogo(raw.left_logo_url ?? raw.left_logo)
      : schoolLogo || prev.left_logo;

  const rightLogo =
    raw.right_logo !== undefined || raw.right_logo_url !== undefined
      ? safeLogo(raw.right_logo_url ?? raw.right_logo)
      : prev.right_logo;

  const isConfigured =
    typeof raw.is_configured === 'boolean'
      ? raw.is_configured
      : Boolean(resolvedId || resolvedName);

  return {
    school_id: resolvedId,
    deped_school_id: resolvedId,
    school_name: resolvedName,
    short_name: resolvedShort,
    region: resolvedRegion,
    division: resolvedDivision,
    district: resolvedDistrict,
    address: resolvedAddress,
    contact_number: resolvedContact,
    email: resolvedEmail,
    principal_name: resolvedPrincipal,
    principal_title: resolvedPrincipalTitle,
    academic_year: resolvedAcademicYear,
    latitude: typeof parsedLat === 'number' && Number.isFinite(parsedLat) ? parsedLat : null,
    longitude: typeof parsedLng === 'number' && Number.isFinite(parsedLng) ? parsedLng : null,
    geofence_radius_meters: cleanRad,
    geofence_radius: cleanRad,
    radius_meters: cleanRad,
    school_logo: schoolLogo,
    left_logo: leftLogo,
    right_logo: rightLogo,
    is_configured: isConfigured,
  };
};

const readWarmSchool = (): SchoolData => {
  try {
    const cachedSettings = peekApiCache<Record<string, unknown>>(API_ROUTES.school.settings);
    if (cachedSettings) {
      return normalizeSchoolPayload(cachedSettings, EMPTY_SCHOOL);
    }
    const cachedPublic = peekApiCache<Record<string, unknown>>(API_ROUTES.school.publicBranding);
    if (cachedPublic) {
      return normalizeSchoolPayload(cachedPublic, EMPTY_SCHOOL);
    }
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return EMPTY_SCHOOL;
    return normalizeSchoolPayload(JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, unknown>, EMPTY_SCHOOL);
  } catch {
    return EMPTY_SCHOOL;
  }
};

const SchoolContext = createContext<SchoolContextValue>({
  school: EMPTY_SCHOOL,
  loading: false,
  refreshSchool: async () => {},
  updateSchoolInstantly: () => {},
});

export const SchoolProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [school, setSchool] = useState<SchoolData>(readWarmSchool);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !school.school_name);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const updateSchoolInstantly = useCallback(
    (partial: Record<string, unknown> | Partial<SchoolData>) => {
      if (!partial || typeof partial !== 'object') return;
      setSchool((prev) => {
        const next = normalizeSchoolPayload(partial as Record<string, unknown>, prev);
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
        } catch {
          // Ignore storage quota limits
        }
        return next;
      });
    },
    []
  );

  const refreshSchool = useCallback(async () => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;

    const hasToken = Boolean(
      localStorage.getItem('attendsure_token') || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_access')
    );

    try {
      const endpoint = hasToken ? API_ROUTES.school.settings : API_ROUTES.school.publicBranding;
      const res = await apiClient.get<Record<string, unknown>>(endpoint, {
        params: { nocache: 1 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted || !res.data) return;

      setSchool((prev) => {
        const next = normalizeSchoolPayload(res.data, prev);
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
        } catch {
          // Ignore storage quota limits
        }
        return next;
      });
    } catch {
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      if (hasToken) {
        try {
          const fallbackRes = await apiClient.get<Record<string, unknown>>(
            API_ROUTES.school.publicBranding,
            { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal }
          );
          if (!controller.signal.aborted && fallbackRes.data) {
            setSchool((prev) => {
              const next = normalizeSchoolPayload(fallbackRes.data, prev);
              try {
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
              } catch {
                // Ignore storage quota limits
              }
              return next;
            });
          }
        } catch {
          // Retain last known branding when offline
        }
      }
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refreshSchool();
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [refreshSchool]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleCustomUpdate = () => {
      void refreshSchool();
    };
    window.addEventListener('attendsure:school-updated', handleCustomUpdate);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('attendsure:school-updated', handleCustomUpdate);
    };
  }, [refreshSchool]);

  return (
    <SchoolContext.Provider value={{ school, loading, refreshSchool, updateSchoolInstantly }}>
      {children}
    </SchoolContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useSchool = (): SchoolContextValue => useContext(SchoolContext);

/**
 * AttendSure - Theme Context & CSS Variable Engine
 * File: web/src/context/ThemeContext.tsx
 */

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  THEME_PALETTES,
  BRAND_COLORS,
  FONTS,
  RADIUS,
  createStyles,
  type ThemeMode,
  type ThemeTokens,
} from '../theme/tokens';

interface ThemeContextValue {
  mode: ThemeMode;
  setThemeMode: (mode: ThemeMode) => void;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  tokens: ThemeTokens;
  brand: typeof BRAND_COLORS.light;
  fonts: typeof FONTS;
  radius: typeof RADIUS;
  ui: ReturnType<typeof createStyles>;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextValue | undefined>(undefined);
const STORAGE_KEY = 'attendsure_theme_mode';

export const ThemeProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ThemeMode>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) as ThemeMode;
    return saved && THEME_PALETTES[saved] ? saved : 'light';
  });

  const setThemeMode = useCallback((nextMode: ThemeMode) => {
    setMode(nextMode);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, nextMode);
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage quota errors
    }
  }, []);

  const toggleTheme = useCallback(() => {
    setMode((prev) => {
      const order: ThemeMode[] = ['light', 'dark', 'high-contrast'];
      const next = order[(order.indexOf(prev) + 1) % order.length];
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, next);
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage quota errors
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const tokens = THEME_PALETTES[mode];
  const brand = BRAND_COLORS[mode];
  const ui = useMemo(() => createStyles(tokens, brand), [tokens, brand]);

  // Sync CSS variables onto <html> so CSS files and common components automatically change color
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', mode);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-app', tokens.bgApp);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-canvas', tokens.bgCanvas);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-surface', tokens.bgSurface);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-surface-subtle', tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle);
    root.style.setProperty('--bg-input', tokens.bgInput);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-primary', tokens.textPrimary);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-secondary', tokens.textSecondary);
    root.style.setProperty('--text-muted', tokens.textMuted);
    root.style.setProperty('--border-subtle', tokens.borderSubtle);
    root.style.setProperty('--border-input', tokens.borderInput);
    root.style.setProperty('--border-strong', tokens.borderStrong);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-primary', brand.primary);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-button-bg', brand.buttonBg);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-success', brand.success);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-warning', brand.warning);
    root.style.setProperty('--brand-danger', brand.danger);
    root.style.setProperty('--success', tokens.success);
    root.style.setProperty('--danger', tokens.danger);
    root.style.setProperty('--danger-bg', tokens.dangerBg);
    root.style.setProperty('--card-shadow', tokens.cardShadow);
    root.style.setProperty('--font-sans', FONTS.sans);
  }, [mode, tokens, brand]);

  // Keyboard shortcut: Alt + T cycles color themes
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.altKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 't') {
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleTheme();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [toggleTheme]);

  const contextValue = useMemo<ThemeContextValue>(
    () => ({ mode, setThemeMode, toggleTheme, tokens, brand, fonts: FONTS, radius: RADIUS, ui }),
    [mode, setThemeMode, toggleTheme, tokens, brand, ui]
  );

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useTheme = (): ThemeContextValue => {
  const ctx = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useTheme must be used inside ThemeProvider');
  return ctx;
};

/**
 * AttendSure - Zero-Lag SWR Data Hook (Instant Cache Hydration + Keep-Previous-Data)
 * File: web/src/hooks/useApiResource.ts
 */

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache, subscribeApiCache } from '../api/client';
import { extractApiError } from '../api/routes';

export function useApiResource<T>(
  endpoint: string,
  initialValue: T,
  params?: Record<string, unknown>
) {
  const paramsKey = JSON.stringify(params || {});
  const stableParams = useMemo<Record<string, unknown> | undefined>(
    () => (paramsKey === '{}' ? undefined : JSON.parse(paramsKey)),
    [paramsKey]
  );

  const initialCached = useMemo(
    () => peekApiCache<T>(endpoint, stableParams),
    [endpoint, stableParams]
  );

  const [data, setData] = useState<T>(() =>
    initialCached !== undefined ? initialCached : initialValue
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => initialCached === undefined);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const hasDataRef = useRef<boolean>(initialCached !== undefined);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return subscribeApiCache(endpoint, stableParams, (freshPayload) => {
      hasDataRef.current = true;
      setData(freshPayload as T);
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    });
  }, [endpoint, stableParams]);

  const reload = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const warmHit = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<T>(endpoint, stableParams) : undefined;
      if (warmHit !== undefined) {
        hasDataRef.current = true;
        setData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
      } else if (!silent && !hasDataRef.current) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }

      setError(null);

      try {
        const reqParams = bypassCache
          ? { ...(stableParams || {}), nocache: 1 }
          : stableParams;
        const res = await apiClient.get<T>(endpoint, {
          params: reqParams,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        hasDataRef.current = true;
        setData(res.data);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') return;
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Unable to load records.'));
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [endpoint, stableParams]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void reload(hasDataRef.current, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [reload]);

  return { data, setData, loading, refreshing, error, reload };
}

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP, MARGIN_PRESETS, PAPER_SIZES } from '../types/pageSetup';
import type {
  HeaderRepeatMode,
  LayoutMode,
  MarginPresetKey,
  PageOrientation,
  PageSetupConfig,
  PaperSizeKey,
} from '../types/pageSetup';

const GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY = 'attendsure_page_setup_default';
const HEX_COLOR_RE = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/;

const clampMargin = (val: unknown, fallback: number): number => {
  const num = Number(val);
  if (!Number.isFinite(num) || num < 0 || num > 4) return fallback;
  return num;
};

const sanitizePageSetup = (raw: unknown): PageSetupConfig => {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP;
  const r = raw as Partial<PageSetupConfig>;

  const layoutMode: LayoutMode =
    r.layoutMode === 'pages' || r.layoutMode === 'pageless'
      ? r.layoutMode
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.layoutMode;

  const orientation: PageOrientation =
    r.orientation === 'portrait' || r.orientation === 'landscape'
      ? r.orientation
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.orientation;

  const paperSize: PaperSizeKey =
    r.paperSize && r.paperSize in PAPER_SIZES
      ? r.paperSize
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.paperSize;

  const marginPreset: MarginPresetKey =
    r.marginPreset && r.marginPreset in MARGIN_PRESETS
      ? r.marginPreset
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.marginPreset;

  const headerRepeat: HeaderRepeatMode =
    r.headerRepeat === 'all_pages' || r.headerRepeat === 'first_page_only'
      ? r.headerRepeat
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.headerRepeat;

  const pageColor =
    typeof r.pageColor === 'string' && HEX_COLOR_RE.test(r.pageColor.trim())
      ? r.pageColor.trim()
      : DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.pageColor;

  const rawMargins = r.margins || DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins;
  const margins = {
    top: clampMargin(rawMargins.top, DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins.top),
    bottom: clampMargin(rawMargins.bottom, DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins.bottom),
    left: clampMargin(rawMargins.left, DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins.left),
    right: clampMargin(rawMargins.right, DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP.margins.right),
  };

  return {
    layoutMode,
    orientation,
    paperSize,
    pageColor,
    marginPreset,
    margins,
    headerRepeat,
  };
};

export const usePageSetup = (reportKey: string = 'general') => {
  const specificKey = `attendsure_page_setup_${reportKey}`;

  const loadInitial = useCallback((): PageSetupConfig => {
    try {
      const specific = localStorage.getItem(specificKey);
      if (specific) return sanitizePageSetup(JSON.parse(specific));

      const globalDefault = localStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY);
      if (globalDefault) return sanitizePageSetup(JSON.parse(globalDefault));
    } catch {
      // Ignore malformed storage values
    }
    return DEFAULT_PAGE_SETUP;
  }, [specificKey]);

  const [config, setConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(loadInitial);

  // Sync state if localStorage changes from another tab/window
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => {
      if (e.key === specificKey || e.key === GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY) {
        setConfig(loadInitial());
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
  }, [specificKey, loadInitial]);

  const saveConfig = useCallback(
    (newConfig: PageSetupConfig, setAsGlobalDefault: boolean = false) => {
      const safe = sanitizePageSetup(newConfig);
      setConfig(safe);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(specificKey, JSON.stringify(safe));
        if (setAsGlobalDefault) {
          localStorage.setItem(GLOBAL_DEFAULT_KEY, JSON.stringify(safe));
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage quota issues
      }
    },
    [specificKey]
  );

  return { config, saveConfig };
};

const SAFE_RASTER_DATA_URI = /^data:image\/(png|jpeg|jpg|webp|gif);base64,/i;

export const isSafeImageUrl = (url?: string | null): boolean => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  const clean = trimmed.toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || clean === 'null' || clean === 'undefined' || clean === 'none') return false;
  if (
    clean.startsWith('javascript:') ||
    clean.startsWith('vbscript:') ||
    clean.startsWith('file:') ||
    clean.startsWith('data:image/svg')
  ) {
    return false;
  }
  if (clean.startsWith('data:')) {
    return SAFE_RASTER_DATA_URI.test(trimmed);
  }
  if (clean.startsWith('/')) {
    return !clean.startsWith('//');
  }
  return clean.startsWith('http://') || clean.startsWith('https://') || clean.startsWith('blob:');
};

export const sanitizeText = (text: string, maxLength = 150): string => {
  return String(text || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);
};

/**

import apiClient from '../api/client';
